title.zh-TW: Vertex 支援快速模式，全球與美歐區域遭拒時退回標準速度備援
title.en: Vertex Supports Fast Mode, Falling Back to Standard Speed in Global, US, and EU Regions When Refused

body.zh-TW: 當你請 Claude 整理長篇技術文件或規劃專案架構時，等待模型生成內容的時間往往直接影響工作步調。現在這項工具在 Vertex（Google 旗下的雲端託管平台）正式加入快速模式。⟦跟搭乘商辦大樓的直達特快電梯一樣，以前專用電梯一旦拒載，乘客只能在閘門前被退回重新排隊；現在動線會自動換走每層皆停的一般電梯，行程絕不中斷。⟧這項設定目前已在 global 全球、us 美國與 eu 歐洲三個服務區域開放。Vertex 若拒絕快速模式，就退回標準速度。
body.en: When you ask Claude to organize long technical documents or plan project architecture, waiting for the model to generate content often directly affects your working pace. This tool now officially adds fast mode on Vertex (Google's managed cloud platform). ⟦Much like riding a direct express elevator in an office building, if the dedicated elevator previously refused boarding, passengers were turned away at the gate to line up all over again; now traffic automatically switches to a standard elevator that stops on every floor, ensuring the trip is never interrupted.⟧ This setting is currently available across three service regions: global, us, and eu. If Vertex refuses fast mode, it falls back to standard speed.

items.original: Added fast mode on Vertex in the global, us and eu regions, falling back to standard speed if Vertex refuses it

title.zh-TW: 預設模型切換為 Fable 5.2，快取計費與企業席位提示更新
title.en: Default Model Switches to Fable 5.2, Updating Cache Billing and Enterprise Seat Prompts

body.zh-TW: 想要在日常對話中調用超長文本，Claude Code 已將預設 Fable 模型升級至 `claude-fable-5-2`。⟦好比租借公事包時直接換上容量更大的旗艦款，開口能塞進厚重企劃案，重複翻閱舊頁時租金更便宜，企業方案用戶也不會再收到額外扣抵點數的通知。⟧新模型具備 1M 上下文長度，每百萬 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）輸入價格是 8 美元、輸出 40 美元。使用快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）時，每百萬 token 讀取價格是 0.20 美元。原本已包含 Fable 的企業版席位在切換後，不再跳出扣除額度點數的提示。原本儲存使用 Fable 5.1 的設定會自動切換為 `fable`，Pro 與 Max 方案立刻生效，Team 與 Enterprise 則待組織允許；若想切回舊版可輸入 `/model claude-fable-5-1`。
body.en: To work with extra-long context in everyday conversations, Claude Code has upgraded its default Fable model to `claude-fable-5-2`. ⟦Picture renting a briefcase and immediately upgrading to a flagship model with greater capacity: its opening fits bulky proposals, browsing through old pages costs less in rental fees, and enterprise plan users no longer receive alerts about extra deducted credits.⟧ The new model features a 1M context window, with pricing at $8 for input and $40 for output per million tokens (units of text processed and billed by the AI). For cache reads, the price is $0.20 per million tokens. Enterprise seats that already include Fable no longer show the "Draws from usage credits" note after switching. Saved settings using Fable 5.1 automatically switch to `fable`, taking effect immediately on Pro and Max plans and on Team and Enterprise plans once your organization allows it. To switch back to the older version, you can enter `/model claude-fable-5-1`.

items.original:
Added Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
Fixed the "Draws from usage credits" note showing after a switch to Fable on Enterprise seats whose plan includes Fable
Changed saved Fable 5.1 model picks to move to `fable`: on Pro and Max plans at once, on Team and Enterprise plans once your organization allows it; use `/model claude-fable-5-1` to switch back

title.zh-TW: 工作階段回饋與升級選項納入 Ultra，登入說明涵蓋所有付費方案
title.en: Session Feedback and Upgrade Options Add Ultra, Login Descriptions Cover All Paid Plans

body.zh-TW: 如果你正在查看帳號方案或調整團隊設定，介面文字現在已將新的 Ultra 方案完整納入。⟦恰似健身房在會員公告牌上補齊頂級會員級別，所有櫃檯說明書與續約按鈕都同步列出新標籤，安全守則字樣也對齊總店公告。⟧在工作階段回饋訊息與 `allowedProviders` 設定說明裡，Ultra 已與 Pro 和 Max 並列顯示。升級選項由原本的升級至 Max 改為「Upgrade to Max or Ultra」。`forceLoginMethod` 的設定說明擴大涵蓋所有付費方案。觸發網路安全防護攔截時，畫面顯示的 Cyber Verification Program 提示文字已對齊 claude.ai 官方站台的措辭。
body.en: If you are reviewing account plans or adjusting team settings, interface text now fully incorporates the new Ultra plan. ⟦Think of a gym adding a top-tier membership tier to its announcement board: every front-desk pamphlet and renewal button displays the new label in sync, while safety guideline wording aligns with the main branch notice.⟧ In the session-feedback message and the `allowedProviders` setting description, Ultra is now listed alongside Pro and Max. The upgrade option has changed from upgrading to Max to "Upgrade to Max or Ultra". The description for `forceLoginMethod` has expanded to cover all paid plans. When a cyber safeguard block triggers, the Cyber Verification Program message on the screen now uses the same wording as the official claude.ai website.

items.original:
Updated the session-feedback message and the `allowedProviders` setting description to name Ultra alongside Pro and Max, and the `forceLoginMethod` description to cover every paid Claude plan
Updated the "Upgrade to Max" options to say "Upgrade to Max or Ultra"
Changed the Cyber Verification Program sentence on a cyber safeguard block to use the same words as claude.ai

title.zh-TW: 快速模式連線受阻退回同模型標準速，模型選單新增未編號展開列
title.en: Fast Mode Falls Back to Standard Speed on Same Model, Model Menu Adds Unnumbered Expansion Row

body.zh-TW: 在終端機切換快速模式或挑選模型時，回應與選單的互動方式有了調整。⟦好似快捷櫃檯客滿時，服務員先請你在同一個窗口改走一般排隊動線，而不會將你轉介到其他業務櫃檯，目錄底部的更多項目展開時也不會打亂原本排好的號碼牌。⟧當快速伺服遇到限流、過載或故障時，不再遺失回覆或重試數分鐘，而是優先切換至同一個模型的標準速度。輸入 `/model` 時，「More models」改為置於最下方的未編號選項，展開舊模型時不會改變其他項目的編號。在 `/fast`、`/config` 與 `/model` 的標籤中，只要目前模型支援快速模式就會直接標註名稱，並移除了 VS Code 列上的「(Opus only)」註記。第一順位模型若在回覆前遭阻擋，備援模型（fallback，主要模型失效時接手處理的替代模型）不再誤稱回覆已被中止。模型回覆包含工具呼叫時，提示建議也不會再發出額外的請求。
body.en: When switching fast mode or selecting models in the terminal, response handling and menu interactions have been adjusted. ⟦Imagine an express counter where staff redirect you to regular queuing at the very same window instead of sending you to another counter, and expanding extra catalog items leaves existing ticket numbers untouched.⟧ When fast serving encounters rate limits, overloading, or failures, it no longer loses replies or retries for minutes, trying standard speed on the same model first. When entering `/model`, "More models" is now an unnumbered option placed at the very bottom, and expanding older models does not change the numbering of other items. In `/fast`, `/config`, and `/model` labels, your current model is explicitly named whenever it supports fast mode, and "(Opus only)" has been removed from the VS Code row. If the first-choice model is blocked before replying, fallback models (backup models that take over when the primary model fails) no longer mistakenly claim that the response was stopped. When a model response includes a tool call, prompt suggestions no longer make extra requests.

items.original:
Fixed the fallback model sometimes declining a request or mentioning a stopped response when the first model was blocked before replying
Fixed fast mode losing replies, switching models or retrying for minutes when fast serving is rate-limited, overloaded or failing; it now tries standard speed on the same model first
Fixed prompt suggestions making extra API requests when the model replied with a tool call
Improved the `/model` picker: "More models" is now an unnumbered row below every other, and older models open under it without renumbering the rest
Changed the fast mode labels in `/fast`, `/config` and `/model` to name your current model when it supports fast mode, and removed "(Opus only)" from the VS Code row

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 支援載入獨立設定檔，鎖定工作目錄並強化初次執行提示
title.en: Remote Control Supports Loading Dedicated Settings Files, Locks Working Folders, and Clarifies First-Run Prompts

body.zh-TW: 使用遠端操控管理多個工作階段時，現在可以為所有連線統一套用固定的組態環境。⟦宛如巡迴值勤前配發固定公事包，值勤期間不得擅自更換巡邏基地，遇上無人應答的確認單時也會清楚註明下一步該找哪位窗口。⟧執行 `claude remote-control --settings <file>` 可以指定設定檔並套用至啟動的每個工作階段；如果該設定檔在執行期間變更，必須重新啟動遠端操控才會建立新工作階段。連線進來的客戶端無法再將工作階段搬移到其他資料夾。針對首次執行的確認提示，未回答的訊息現在會直接說明下一步該做什麼，並修正了終端機輸入結束時直接將未按 Enter 的「y」誤判為同意的問題。
body.en: When managing multiple sessions with Remote Control, you can now apply a fixed configuration environment across all connections. ⟦Security guards receive a designated briefcase before patrol and cannot switch duty stations midway, while unanswered confirmation forms clearly state which contact to approach next.⟧ Running `claude remote-control --settings <file>` lets you specify a settings file that applies to every session it starts. If that settings file changes during runtime, no new session will start until you restart `claude remote-control`. Connected clients can no longer move a session to another folder. For first-run confirmation prompts, unanswered messages now explain what to do next. An issue where terminal input ending would misinterpret a `y` typed without Enter as consent has also been resolved.

items.original:
Added `--settings <file>` to `claude remote-control`, which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart `claude remote-control`
Fixed `claude remote-control` accepting a `y` typed without Enter at its first-run question when the terminal's input ended
Improved `claude remote-control`'s messages for an unanswered first-run question: each now says what to do next
Changed Remote Control sessions to keep the folder they were started in: a connected client can no longer move a session to another folder

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 修復延後排隊機制，連線中斷與登入過期狀態回報更準確
title.en: Remote Control Fixes Delayed Queuing, Accurately Reporting Disconnections and Expired Logins

body.zh-TW: 透過網頁、手機或桌面應用程式使用遠端操控時，訊息排隊與連線狀態不再產生混淆。⟦跟郵局收發包裹一樣，寄件人勾選等候通知時信件就不會在處理中途被硬塞進櫃檯，窗口連線切斷時也不會繼續亮著服務燈。⟧在網頁與行動版上，`/compact` 選項不再重複顯示兩次。桌面應用程式若短暫無法遞交授權令牌（token，驗證身分的數位憑證），遠端操控不會在連線正常時誤報登入已過期。選擇「Queue for later」暫存的訊息，不會在目前回合執行途中提前遞交給 Claude。當工作階段的歷史紀錄仍在背景上傳但連線已徹底關閉時，介面不再繼續顯示為已連線。若執行行程發生當機，遠端操控工作階段能更快重新接收並處理新訊息。
body.en: When using Remote Control across web, mobile, or desktop applications, message queuing and connection status no longer cause confusion. ⟦A post office handling packages avoids cramming hold-for-pickup mail onto active counters, and counter service lights do not stay lit once a terminal disconnects.⟧ On web and mobile, the `/compact` option no longer appears twice. If the desktop app is briefly unable to hand over sign-in tokens (digital credentials used to verify identity), Remote Control no longer falsely reports that login expired while the connection remains up. Messages held using "Queue for later" do not reach Claude early in the middle of a running turn. When session history is still uploading in the background but the connection has closed for good, the interface no longer continues showing as connected. If a process crashes, the Remote Control session can pick up and process new messages sooner.

items.original:
Fixed `/compact` showing twice in Remote Control on web and mobile
Fixed a case where Remote Control showed as off with "login expired" in the desktop app while its connection was still up, because the app was briefly unable to hand over a sign-in token
Fixed a Remote Control message sent with "Queue for later" reaching Claude in the middle of the running turn
Fixed Remote Control showing as connected after its connection closed for good while the session's history was still uploading
Improved how soon a Remote Control session whose process crashed can pick up a new message

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具轉址防護敏感金鑰，修復名稱衝突斷線與重載空白
title.en: MCP Tool Redirections Guard Sensitive Keys, Fixing Name Collision Disconnects and Empty Reloads

body.zh-TW: 為專案串接外部工具時，MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）在重導向與連線載入時不再產生安全疑慮。⟦就像寄送機密文件遇上轉址時快遞員會取下附帶的保管箱鑰匙，工具清單在重新入庫時也不會因為搬動辦公桌而遺失登記欄位。⟧伺服器轉址時，OAuth 流程不再將更新憑證洩漏給其他主機。登入註冊過的伺服器時，`claude mcp login` 不再反覆跳出 SEP-2352 警示。在桌面版 Code 標籤頁工作階段中，伺服器不再因與桌面應用同名而中斷連線。載入工具途中重新連線或變更目錄，伺服器不再誤顯示為無可用工具。stdio 與 HTTP 伺服器的掛鉤輸出若超過 16 MiB，會直接拒絕該工具呼叫。登入紀錄若為空值，啟動時不再畫面空白或 `claude mcp list` 輸出無內容。
body.en: When connecting external tools to a project, MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) no longer raises security concerns during redirections and connection loading. ⟦Couriers rerouting confidential documents remove any attached safe keys, while cataloging tools during a reorganization prevents registration fields from vanishing when desks move.⟧ During server redirections, the OAuth flow no longer leaks refresh credentials to other hosts. When signing in to a registered server, `claude mcp login` no longer repeatedly displays the SEP-2352 warning. In a Claude Desktop Code tab session, servers no longer disconnect due to sharing the same name as a desktop application. If a server reconnects or the directory changes while tools are still loading, it no longer falsely displays as having no available tools. When hook output on stdio and HTTP servers exceeds 16 MiB, the tool call is refused directly. If a sign-in record is null, startup no longer displays a blank screen and `claude mcp list` output is no longer empty.

items.original:
Fixed MCP OAuth requests sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them
Fixed `claude mcp login` printing a SEP-2352 issuer warning each time you sign in again to a server that Claude Code registered with
Fixed a project's MCP server being disconnected after the first message in a Claude Desktop Code tab session when the desktop app has an MCP server or extension of the same name
Fixed an MCP server sometimes showing as connected with no tools after it was reconnected or the session's directory changed while its tools were still loading
Fixed `PreToolUse` `mcp_tool` hooks on stdio and HTTP MCP servers being skipped when their answer was over 16 MiB; the tool call is now refused
Fixed a blank screen or no answer at startup, and empty `claude mcp list` output, when a stored MCP sign-in record was null

title.zh-TW: Bash 檔案寫入與路徑比對修正，複製移動指令套用統一防護規則
title.en: Bash File Writes and Path Matching Corrected, Applying Uniform Protection to Copy and Move Commands

body.zh-TW: 排查批次執行的檔案操作時，終端機對目錄位置與保護規則的判定標準已完成對齊。⟦恰如警衛在核對倉庫進出單據，搬移箱子進特定庫房時一律逐件檢查封條，換到新隔間作業時也不會遺漏登記正確的房號。⟧以前 Bash 權限檢查有時會從錯誤的資料夾判斷檔案寫入，導致未能適時發出提問，這個問題已經修好。當使用 `cp` 或 `mv` 指令將檔案移入目錄時，該寫入動作現在會確實受到拒絕規則與保護檔案提問的約束。連續發送多個 Bash 指令且前方指令更換過目錄時，後續指令不會再跑去錯誤的資料夾執行。輸入 `grep -r foo "$PWD/src"` 這類含有環境變數的讀取指令時，行為與直接打出完整路徑一致，不再額外跳出提問。使用 `/bin/cp` 這類帶有絕對路徑的指令時，檢查標準也已與一般的 `cp` 保持相同。
body.en: When troubleshooting batch file operations, terminal evaluation standards for directory locations and protection rules are now aligned. ⟦Warehouse guards verifying shipment manifests inspect every seal whenever boxes move into secure storage, while shifting to a new bay never causes the wrong room number to be logged.⟧ Bash permission checks previously judged a file write from the wrong folder and failed to prompt in time, which has now been fixed. When using `cp` or `mv` commands to move files into a directory, the write action is now strictly bound by deny rules and protected-file prompts. When sending several Bash commands in sequence and an earlier command changes folders, subsequent commands no longer run in the wrong folder. Entering read commands containing environment variables, such as `grep -r foo "$PWD/src"`, now behaves consistently with typing out the full path and no longer prompts extra. Using path-specified commands like `/bin/cp` now applies the same inspection standards as standard `cp`.

items.original:
Fixed a case where Bash permission checks judged a file write from the wrong folder and didn't prompt
Fixed deny rules and protected-file prompts not applying to the file that a `cp` or `mv` into a directory writes
Fixed Bash commands sometimes running in the wrong folder when Claude sent several at once and an earlier one changed folders
Fixed Bash reads such as `grep -r foo "$PWD/src"` asking for permission when the same command with the path typed out runs without asking
Changed `cp` and `mv` spelled by a path, such as `/bin/cp`, to get the same path checks as `cp` and `mv`

title.zh-TW: 修正自動模式權限設定與沙盒防護，放行常態排程命令
title.en: Auto Mode Permissions and Sandbox Protection Fixed, Allowing Routine Scheduled Commands

body.zh-TW: 調整權限設定檔或執行自動排程時，終端機的提問邏輯與指令回傳維持正常秩序。⟦如同大門守衛只嚴查同時帶有通訊錄與派送單的特殊包裹，其他日常巡邏公文則正常放行，修改通行證預設值時也不再跳出不相干的選項。⟧在 `/config` 設定畫面中，新工作階段在自動模式啟動時不會再誤將 Manual 標為預設，在「Auto (default)」上按下空白鍵現在會正確儲存為 Don't Ask。唯讀的 Bash 指令若在沙盒外執行，不再發生跳過權限提問的情況。對於在 `.zshrc` 中啟用 `KSH_OPTION_PRINT` 的使用者，指令執行結果不會再回傳空值。帳號電子郵件檢查現在僅針對同時包含郵件地址並指名 User-Agent 的指令直接拒絕，其餘命令與排程任務不再停下來詢問。權限提問與背景任務引發的偶發崩潰也已獲得解決。
body.en: When adjusting permission profiles or running automated schedules, terminal prompt logic and command responses maintain normal order. ⟦Gate guards inspect only suspicious packages bearing both an address book and a delivery slip while waving through routine patrol paperwork, and adjusting default badge settings never surfaces unrelated options.⟧ In the `/config` settings screen, starting new sessions in auto mode no longer mistakenly flags Manual as default. Pressing Space on "Auto (default)" now correctly saves Don't Ask. Read-only Bash commands running outside the sandbox no longer skip permission prompts. For users enabling `KSH_OPTION_PRINT` in `.zshrc`, command execution results no longer come back empty. Account email checks now directly refuse only commands that simultaneously contain an email address and name a User-Agent, so other commands and scheduled tasks no longer stop to prompt. Rare crashes triggered by permission prompts and background tasks have also been resolved.

items.original:
Fixed a case where a read-only Bash command ran outside the sandbox without a permission prompt
Fixed `/config` showing Manual as the default permission mode when new sessions start in auto mode; pressing Space on "Auto (default)" now saves Don't Ask, not Plan
Fixed a rare crash on permission prompts and background tasks
Fixed Bash commands coming back empty for zsh users whose `.zshrc` sets `KSH_OPTION_PRINT`
Changed the account email check to refuse only a shell command that holds your email and names a User-Agent, without asking, so other commands and scheduled runs no longer stop at its prompt

title.zh-TW: 自訂模組於自動模式免提問載入，無頭模式支援檔案即時重載
title.en: Custom Mods Load Without Prompts in Auto Mode, Headless Sessions Support Live File Reloading

body.zh-TW: 讓 Claude 撰寫擴充模組並在後台無人值守執行時，模組的載入與授權變得更加流暢。⟦宛若給駐場技師派發經認證的專用工具袋，在維修通道內換裝零組件不必每次反覆向主控台申請審核，只要零件圖面一更新技師便即刻換上。⟧在 auto 與 bypass 模式下，Claude 撰寫的模組會直接啟用而不跳出提問，即使設有禁止非沙盒指令或限定網域的政策也一樣，但在 `dontAsk` 模式下則不載入。模組內部發起的工具呼叫（例如 `$.tool.call` 與 `$.mcp.call`）不再觸發權限提問，不過組織政策與明確的拒絕規則依然有效。在無頭模式（沒有視窗畫面的執行模式）的工作階段中，`.claude/skills` 內的模組檔案若有變更會自動重新載入，若想關閉此偵測，可將環境變數設為 `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH=0`。
body.en: When having Claude author extension mods for unattended background runs, mod loading and authorization are noticeably smoother. ⟦Equipping on-site technicians with certified tool bags lets them replace components inside maintenance corridors without repeatedly asking dispatch for approval, swapping in fresh parts the moment blueprints update.⟧ In auto and bypass modes, mods written by Claude activate directly without prompts, even under policies prohibiting unsandboxed commands or restricting domains, but they do not load in `dontAsk` mode. Tool calls initiated by mods themselves (`$.tool.call` and `$.mcp.call`) no longer trigger permission prompts, though organization policies and explicit deny rules remain in effect. In headless sessions (an execution mode without a visual interface), mod files in `.claude/skills` reload automatically when changed. To turn off this detection, you can set the environment variable to `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH=0`.

items.original:
Changed mods Claude writes to turn on without asking in auto and bypass modes, even with managed `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false` or `allowManagedDomainsOnly`, and not to load in `dontAsk` mode
Changed mods' own tool calls (`$.tool.call`, `$.mcp.call`) to raise no permission prompt, even under your own ask rules or in `dontAsk` and `-p` runs; deny rules and organization policy still apply
Changed headless sessions to reload mods in `.claude/skills` when their files change; set `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH=0` to turn this off

title.zh-TW: 網路共享路徑筆記本與文字編輯修復，改動失敗如實回報狀態
title.en: Notebook and Text Edits on Network Paths Fixed, Accurately Reporting Failed Changes

body.zh-TW: 經由區域網路共享、WSL 資料夾或遠端掛載編輯 Jupyter 筆記本時，檔案內容不再遭到意外破壞。⟦猶如在圖書館遠端借閱裝訂資料夾，翻修內頁時不會因為沒指定頁碼就塗掉封面，若在等待簽核時文件被其他人抽換，系統也會老實登記修改失敗。⟧在網路路徑（包含 UNC 共享、WSL 資料夾與 `/net` 掛載）上使用 `NotebookEdit` 時，以前未指定單元格可能導致首個單元格被刪除或覆寫，現在已修復。使用一般編輯工具時，也不會再因為網路路徑而誤把筆記本當純文字編輯、在字串空白時替換整份檔案，或錯誤修改多筆相符中的第一筆。若筆記本在權限提問視窗開啟時於外部被更動而導致修改失敗，`NotebookEdit` 不會再向掛鉤與遙測紀錄虛報成功。
body.en: When editing Jupyter notebooks across local network shares, WSL folders, or remote mounts, file contents are no longer accidentally corrupted. ⟦Borrowing bound folders remotely from a library ensures that refurbishing inner pages never erases the cover when page numbers are omitted, and records faithfully log failed edits if someone swaps the document while approval is pending.⟧ When using `NotebookEdit` on network paths (including UNC shares, WSL folders, and `/net` mounts), an issue where omitting a cell name could delete or overwrite the first cell has been resolved. Standard editing tools on network paths also no longer mistakenly edit notebooks as plain text, replace an entire file on an empty string, or erroneously modify the first of several matches. If an edit fails because the notebook was altered externally while the permission prompt was open, `NotebookEdit` no longer falsely reports success to hooks and telemetry.

items.original:
Fixed `NotebookEdit` deleting or overwriting a notebook's first cell when the call named no cell, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, `/net` mounts)
Fixed Edit changing the first of several matches, replacing a whole file on an empty `old_string`, or editing a notebook as text, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, `/net` mounts)
Fixed NotebookEdit reporting success to hooks and telemetry when the edit failed, for example when the notebook changed while the permission prompt was open

title.zh-TW: Windows 啟動速度加快，檔案監控修復磁碟代號問題
title.en: Windows startup accelerates, while file monitoring fixes drive letter issue

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統開啟終端機時，工具啟動與首個指令的響應速度變得更加迅速。⟦就像計程車司機記住了常用導航路線，出車時不再反覆重啟額外的定位儀器，檢查門牌號碼時也不會因為英文字母大小寫不同而停止哨戒。⟧在搜尋環境變數中的程式時，不再啟動輔助行程，直接在主要流程中尋找目標。對於標準的 Git for Windows 環境，每次啟動不再反覆檢查要使用哪一個 git 執行檔。尋找內部啟動程式時，會略過相對路徑、網路共享捷徑與 UNC 路徑，並能即時套用設定檔中的路徑變更。當工作階段的工作目錄包含小寫磁碟機代號時，`watchPaths` 監聽路徑在第一個命令執行後 `FileChanged` 掛鉤停止運作的問題也已獲得修復。
body.en: When opening the terminal on Windows, tool startup and response times for the first command become faster. ⟦Taxi drivers memorize routine navigation routes, skipping the repeated reboot of extra GPS gear when rolling out, and never drop watch over house numbers simply because letter casing differs.⟧ When searching for programs in environment variables, it no longer starts a helper process, finding targets directly in the main flow instead. For a standard Git for Windows environment, it no longer repeatedly checks which git executable to run on every launch. When looking for internally started programs, it skips relative paths, network share shortcuts, and UNC paths, while immediately applying path changes from configuration files. An issue where `FileChanged` hooks stopped working after the first command for paths monitored via `watchPaths` when the session's working directory contained a lowercase drive letter has also been fixed.

items.original:
Windows: Fixed `FileChanged` hooks stopping for paths set through `watchPaths` after the first shell command, when the session's working directory had a lowercase drive letter
Windows: Improved startup and first-command time by finding programs on PATH without starting a helper process
Windows: Improved startup time with a standard Git for Windows install by no longer checking which git.exe to run on every launch
Windows: Changed how Claude Code finds programs it starts itself, such as git, to skip relative and UNC PATH entries and links onto a network share, and to pick up PATH changes from settings

title.zh-TW: VS Code 擴充套件新增金鑰衝突警示，遮蔽字元套件統一標註名稱
title.en: VS Code extension adds key conflict warning, while plugins with hidden characters adopt unified naming

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 中開啟 Claude 進行提問時，介面會及時提醒憑證設定上的衝突。⟦正如大樓門禁同時感應到兩張通行卡時會主動亮燈提醒，登記名冊若遇到無法辨識的字元也會直接貼上標準訪客標籤。⟧當你在編輯器環境中同時設定了授權金鑰與 API 金鑰時，輸入框上方現在會跳出警示提示，與終端機啟動時的警告保持一致。如果有外掛套件的名稱包含不可見的隱藏控制字元，權限請求視窗不再顯示殘缺字元，而是統一標明為「a plugin」。
body.en: When opening Claude to ask questions in VS Code, the interface provides timely alerts regarding conflicts in credential settings. ⟦Much as a building access gate lights up an alert when sensing two access cards simultaneously, the visitor log attaches a standard guest label whenever encountering unrecognizable characters.⟧ When both an authorization token and an API key are configured in the editor environment, a warning alert now appears above the prompt box, matching the warning shown at terminal startup. If a plugin's name contains invisible hidden control characters, the permission request window no longer displays broken characters, reading "a plugin" instead.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a warning above the prompt box when both an auth token and an API key are set, matching the terminal's startup warning
[VSCode] Fixed a plugin's permission request showing a name with hidden characters: it now reads "a plugin"

title.zh-TW: 外掛套件更新避免跨目錄重複下載，受管市集強化來源管控
title.en: Plugin updates avoid duplicate downloads across directories, while managed marketplaces tighten source controls

body.zh-TW: 管理專案自訂外掛或市集來源時，目錄配置與版本更新的規則完成統整。⟦恰似社區訂閱報紙時由管理室統一收發，各分戶不再各自重複訂購同一份刊物，未經認證的攤商想要頂替既有名號時也會被直接隔絕並封存貨品。⟧自動更新與 `/plugin` 市集更新不再為同一個儲存庫的工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）或個別資料夾重複下載外掛。使用 `--plugin-dir` 載入目錄時，不再將內建外掛的型別檔誤寫入 `builtin` 資料夾。在 `~/.claude/plugins` 底下的檔案上工作時，該處內層的 `.claude/skills` 資料夾不再載入。受管市集名稱不可被外部來源冒用，遭未宣告來源接管時，已存資料會被隔開保留 `cleanupPeriodDays` 天，選項與機密則保留到執行 `claude plugin restore-set-aside` 為止。
body.en: When managing custom plugins or marketplace sources for a project, rules for directory layouts and version updates have been unified. ⟦In a residential community subscribing to newspapers, the front office handles centralized distribution so individual households never reorder duplicate copies, while uncertified vendors trying to impersonate established stalls are quarantined and their goods sealed.⟧ Automatic updates and `/plugin` marketplace updates no longer download plugins repeatedly for separate folders or worktrees (Git's feature for running multiple parallel copies of the same project) within the same repository. When loading directories using `--plugin-dir`, generated type files for built-in plugins are no longer mistakenly written into a `builtin` folder. When working on files under `~/.claude/plugins`, nested `.claude/skills` folders there no longer load. Managed marketplace names cannot be impersonated by external sources, and if taken over by an undeclared source, saved data is quarantined for `cleanupPeriodDays` days, while options and secrets are retained until running `claude plugin restore-set-aside`.

items.original:
Fixed `--plugin-dir .` and `--plugin-dir ./builtin` writing generated type files for Claude Code's built-in plugins into a `builtin` folder
Fixed plugin auto-updates and `/plugin` marketplace updates downloading a plugin again for each worktree or folder of a repository
Changed nested skill loading: `.claude/skills` folders inside `~/.claude/plugins` no longer load when Claude works on files there
Changed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces`: a declared name can't be added from another source, an entry from elsewhere is hidden, and plugins the declared marketplace lists are reinstalled from it
Changed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces` take-overs from an undeclared source: saved data is set aside for `cleanupPeriodDays`, and options and secrets until `claude plugin restore-set-aside`

title.zh-TW: 背景子代理回報支援合併答覆，修復對話壓縮與中斷重啟遺失
title.en: Background subagent reports support consolidated answers, fixing loss during conversation compaction and interrupted restarts

body.zh-TW: 指派多個背景子代理同時執行複雜任務時，進度彙整與工作階段回復變得更可靠。⟦恰如專案主管在辦公室彙整多位外勤調查員的便條，多張便條會在一封信件中一併批覆，開會重新整理桌面時也不會弄丟剛送達的最新報告。⟧在無頭模式、桌面應用與 VS Code 中，同時等待的多個子代理進度回報現在會像終端機一樣合併在單次模型呼叫中一併回答。如果工作階段在 Claude 回應前執行了對話壓縮，自動模式不會再丟失剛開啟新回合的子代理報告。當使用者手動中止後有多個報告等待時，單一請求不會再塞入超出預期的回報量。子代理進度摘要在模型回覆工具呼叫後，不再將請求一路執行到結束。雲端工作階段若遭服務中斷，子代理不再被誤記為手動停止而拒絕恢復，重啟後發送至主對話的訊息也會確實獲得答覆。
body.en: When assigning multiple background subagents to execute complex tasks concurrently, progress consolidation and session recovery become more dependable. ⟦A project supervisor collates notes from multiple field investigators in the office, answers multiple slips in a single dispatch, and never misplaces a newly arrived report while clearing the desk during meetings.⟧ In headless mode, the desktop application, and VS Code, progress reports from multiple concurrently waiting subagents are now answered together in a single model call, matching the behavior in the terminal. If a session undergoes conversation compaction before Claude responds, auto mode no longer loses subagent reports that had just started a new turn. When multiple reports are waiting after a user manually stops an operation, a single request will no longer take in more reports than expected. Subagent progress summaries no longer execute a request all the way to completion after the model responds with a tool call. If a cloud session is interrupted by a service issue, subagents are no longer mistakenly marked as manually stopped and refused resumption, and messages sent to the main conversation after restart are reliably answered.

items.original:
Fixed auto mode losing a background subagent's report that had started a turn when the conversation was compacted before Claude answered it
Fixed one request carrying far more background agent reports than intended after Claude was stopped while several were waiting
Fixed sub-agent progress summaries running a request to its end after the model replied with a tool call
Fixed background agents being reported as stopped by the user, and refused a resume, when a service interrupted a cloud session and nobody pressed Stop
Fixed a restarted cloud session leaving a subagent's message to the main conversation unanswered
Improved auto mode in headless sessions, the desktop app and VS Code: reports from background subagents that wait together are answered in one model call, as in the terminal

title.zh-TW: Git 分支暫存後保留專案技能，代理人檢視完整顯示工作樹錯誤
title.en: Project skills persist after Git branch stashing, while agent view displays complete worktree errors

body.zh-TW: 利用 Git 工作樹切換不同分支時，專案自訂的指令與技能不會無故消失。⟦好比工匠在不同工作台之間切換時，工具架上的刻度名牌始終保持在視野範圍內，若副工作台架設失敗也會直接印出完整的錯誤原因。⟧以前當專案技能資料夾因為執行 `git stash` 暫存變更而短暫消失又回復時，技能與自訂代理人會在選單中持續遺失，現在即使進入工作樹也能正常載入。在桌面應用與 SDK 工作階段中，專案指令也不再因切入工作樹而從選單消失。執行 `claude agents` 時，若命令列同時帶有 `--verbose`，打在主指令前方的 `--model` 等參數不再遭到忽略。名稱中帶有易造成字體空白的巴姆字母的技能會被直接拒絕。在代理人檢視畫面中，若背景工作樹架設失敗，錯誤訊息改由開頭完整列出，不再只截取後段字元。
body.en: When switching across branches using Git worktrees, custom project commands and skills no longer vanish unexpectedly. ⟦When an artisan moves between different workbenches, marked nameplates on the tool rack remain clearly in view, and any failure to set up an auxiliary bench prints the full underlying reason directly.⟧ Previously, when a project skills folder temporarily disappeared and returned due to running `git stash`, skills and custom agents remained missing from menus, but they now load normally even after entering a worktree. In desktop application and SDK sessions, project commands also no longer disappear from menus after switching into a worktree. When executing `claude agents`, if the command line also includes `--verbose`, options such as `--model` typed before the primary command are no longer ignored. Skills whose names contain Bamum letters that frequently render as blank in certain fonts are rejected directly. In the agent view, if setting up a background worktree fails, the error message is displayed completely from the start rather than showing only trailing characters.

items.original:
Fixed project skills, commands and agents staying missing after their folder was removed and came back mid-session, such as with `git stash`, including after entering a worktree
Fixed project skills, commands and agents disappearing from the menu in SDK and desktop sessions after Claude entered a worktree
Fixed `claude agents` ignoring `--permission-mode`, `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, `--model`, `--effort` or `--agent` typed before `agents` when a flag such as `--verbose` was also on the line
Fixed skill and command names holding a Bamum letter that some fonts draw as blank: they are now refused
Improved the agent view's row for a `claude --bg --worktree` session that couldn't set up its worktree: it now shows the error from its beginning, not an internal tag or its last 200 characters

title.zh-TW: 背景指令修復逾時通知與父行程比對，工作流暫停即時同步狀態
title.en: Background commands fix timeout notices and parent process matching, while workflow pauses sync status in real time

body.zh-TW: 安排長時間執行的背景任務時，進程管理與狀態同步更貼合實際運行情況。⟦好似工廠監控看板精準掌握流水線動態，停工時立刻切換顯示燈號，長篇的工作回報單只保留頭尾摘要，搜尋運轉機台時也不會誤扣總部主機。⟧在非互動模式下，背景指令若在 10 分鐘後中止，不會再向 Claude 誤報擁有 30 分鐘執行時間。在雲端工作階段中，使用 `pkill` 或 `pgrep` 等進程管理命令時，不會再誤比對到該工作階段自身的父行程。當你停止或暫停正在運行的工作流程時，Claude 會即時得知最新狀態，不再誤稱流程仍在繼續。遇到超過 1000 字元的超長背景指令，通知訊息只保留指令開頭與結尾以節省上下文長度。背後代理伺服器連線延遲時，Chrome 與電腦操作伺服器進程在父行程結束後不會再持續滯留在系統中。
body.en: When scheduling long-running background tasks, process management and status synchronization align more closely with actual runtime conditions. ⟦Factory monitoring boards track assembly line dynamics with precision, flipping indicator lights the instant operations halt, keeping only head-and-tail summaries for lengthy job sheets, and never misidentifying headquarters mainframes when scanning for active machinery.⟧ In non-interactive mode, if a background command terminates after 10 minutes, it no longer mistakenly reports to Claude that it has 30 minutes of runtime. In cloud sessions, using process management commands such as `pkill` or `pgrep` no longer mistakenly matches the session's own parent processes. When you stop or pause an active workflow, Claude receives the latest status immediately and no longer claims that the workflow is still continuing. When encountering extra-long background commands exceeding 1,000 characters, notification messages keep only the beginning and end of the command to save context length. When connections to an upstream proxy stall, Chrome and computer use server processes no longer linger on the system after their parent process exits.

items.original:
Fixed `claude -p` sometimes telling Claude that background commands get 30 minutes when they are stopped after 10
Fixed `pkill`, `pgrep` and `pidwait` in cloud sessions matching the session's own parent processes
Fixed Claude in Chrome and computer use server processes staying alive after their parent exits behind a proxy that stalls connections
Fixed Claude not being told when you stop or pause a running workflow, so it no longer says the workflow is still running
Changed background command notifications and TaskStop results to show Claude only the start and end of a command over 1,000 characters, which saves context

title.zh-TW: 修復掛鉤輸出檔案覆寫與攔截衝突，重放授權答案不再中斷
title.en: Hook output file overwrites and interception conflicts resolved, while replaying authorization answers stops hanging

body.zh-TW: 於工作流程中部署自動化掛鉤時，多個小程式之間的事件處理與回傳順序獲得梳理。⟦跟輸送帶上的多重感應器一樣，兩道檢查同時要求確認時原因不會彼此覆蓋，重啟機器重放記錄時也不會被前方的柵欄再次擋下。⟧同一次工具呼叫若有多個掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）輸出大容量內容，不會再發生路徑指向同一檔案的錯誤。嵌入 Claude Code 的應用程式在多個掛鉤同時發出詢問時，能正確保留外部掛鉤的提問原因，延後處理的請求也不會導致提問遺失。遠端工作階段重啟重放先前的授權答覆時，不再觸發 `UserPromptSubmit` 掛鉤而造成無回應。在雲端協作階段中，後置掛鉤無法再擅自竄改使用者的回答或既定計畫。非互動工作階段在 Bash 與 PowerShell 呼叫後，`num_hooks` 與 `num_success` 兩個欄位也不再計入兩個內建掛鉤。
body.en: When deploying automated hooks within workflows, event processing and return ordering across multiple scripts have been straightened out. ⟦Parallel sensors along a conveyor belt ensure that two simultaneous checks requesting confirmation never overwrite each other's reasons, nor does restarting machinery to replay logs get halted by earlier barricades.⟧ When multiple hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) output large payloads during the same tool call, paths no longer mistakenly point to the same file. Applications embedding Claude Code now correctly preserve the prompt reason from an external hook when multiple hooks ask questions simultaneously, and deferred requests no longer cause inquiries to be lost. When a remote session restarts and replays prior authorization responses, it no longer triggers `UserPromptSubmit` hooks and becomes unresponsive. In cloud collaboration sessions, post-tool hooks can no longer arbitrarily modify user answers or finalized plans. Following Bash and PowerShell invocations in non-interactive sessions, the `num_hooks` and `num_success` fields no longer count two built-in hooks.

items.original:
Fixed a large hook output pointing Claude to a file that held another hook's output from the same tool call
Fixed apps that embed Claude Code getting their own PreToolUse hook's `ask` reason instead of another hook's when both asked
Fixed a PreToolUse hook's `ask` being lost when another hook's `defer` finished first and could not be honored
Fixed remote sessions giving no reply after a restart when a `UserPromptSubmit` hook blocked a replayed permission answer; these hooks no longer run on that replay
Changed OpenTelemetry hook events in non-interactive sessions to leave two built-in hooks out of `num_hooks` and `num_success` after Bash and PowerShell calls
Changed Cowork cloud sessions: a PostToolUse hook can no longer replace the answer to AskUserQuestion or the plan in ExitPlanMode's result; Claude reads the originals

title.zh-TW: Claude Desktop 跨視窗通訊放寬至二十則，偵測個人應用程式目錄
title.en: Claude Desktop cross-window messaging expands to twenty, with personal application directory detection

body.zh-TW: 在桌面應用程式使用 Code 標籤頁與其他對話視窗聯動時，跨工作階段的訊息往返額度獲得放寬。⟦猶如辦公室內部對講機放寬單次通話句數上限，說話途中若切換其他對話窗也不會卡住頻道，尋找安裝應用程式時連同個人抽屜也一併清查。⟧Code 標籤頁發送給其他工作階段的訊息數量限制，在等待你再次打字前由原本的 10 則提高至 20 則。在 Claude 仍在運作時如果打字輸入，先前發送給其他視窗的訊息不會再被無故暫停。在 macOS 上輸入 `/desktop` 時，安裝於個人目錄 `~/Applications` 的桌面應用現在能被正確辨識。在預先啟動的處理程序中，追蹤版本控制庫的遙測屬性不再缺失。桌面環境提供的 Chrome 連接工具也已改為依循組織設定的防護政策。
body.en: When using the Code tab in the desktop application to interact with other conversation windows, message allowances across sessions have been expanded. ⟦Office intercom systems expand their line limits per conversation, leaving channels unblocked if someone switches chats mid-dialogue, while scans for installed apps examine personal desk drawers as well.⟧ The limit on messages that a Code tab can send to other sessions before waiting for you to type again has been increased from 10 to 20. If you type while Claude is still actively working, messages previously sent to other windows will no longer remain paused without cause. On macOS, entering `/desktop` now correctly recognizes desktop applications installed in the personal directory `~/Applications`. In pre-started processes, telemetry attributes tracking version control repositories are no longer missing. Chrome connection tools provided in desktop environments have also been updated to follow organizational protection policies.

items.original:
Fixed `/desktop` on macOS saying Claude Desktop is not installed when it is in `~/Applications`
Fixed OpenTelemetry repository attributes (`vcs.*`) missing from Claude Desktop sessions that start on a pre-started process
Fixed messages from a Claude Desktop Code tab session to your other sessions staying paused after you typed while Claude was still working
Changed the number of messages a Claude Desktop Code tab session can send to your other sessions before it waits for you to type again from 10 to 20
Changed Claude in Chrome tools that an app running Claude Code provides, such as the Claude desktop app's Code tab, to follow your organization's Claude in Chrome policy

title.zh-TW: 螢幕閱讀器強化按鍵判斷，介面面板關閉後正常恢復顯示
title.en: Screen reader refines keystroke checks, while interface panels restore properly after closing

body.zh-TW: 依賴無障礙輔助功能或頻繁開啟彈出選單的使用者，介面焦點與顯示狀態更為穩定。⟦就像播音系統在時鐘校正時依舊準點報時，詢問意願時絕不把無意間滑過的雜音當作同意，關閉彈出視窗後底層的控制台也能立刻浮現。⟧在螢幕閱讀器模式下，若系統時鐘在啟動時向後微調，輸入提示不會再延遲出現；從代理人檢視切換回一般對話時，螢幕閱讀器設定不會被意外關閉。提問是非題時，如果在視窗開啟瞬間輸入文字，結尾意外殘留的「y」字元不再被草率判定為同意。在終端機關閉對話框後，指令面板（panel）有時消失直到下一次重繪才恢復的問題已修正。代理人檢視介面在空文字狀態下重啟更新時，也不會再洗掉另一個視窗已儲存的輸入草稿。
body.en: For users relying on accessibility features or frequently opening popup menus, interface focus and display stability have been reinforced. ⟦Public address systems continue chiming on the hour even through clock adjustments, never mistaking accidental static for consent during inquiries, while the underlying console resurfaces immediately after popups close.⟧ In screen reader mode, if the system clock steps backward during startup, input prompts no longer experience delayed appearances, and switching back to regular conversations from the agent view no longer unintentionally disables screen reader settings. When answering yes-or-no questions, typing at the exact moment the dialog opens will no longer hastily interpret a stray trailing "y" as confirmation. In the terminal, an issue where command panels occasionally disappeared after closing a dialog until the next redraw has been resolved. When the agent view restarts for updates while no text is entered, it no longer wipes out input drafts saved in another window.

items.original:
Fixed screen reader mode delaying the prompt at startup when the system clock moved back while Claude Code was starting
Fixed a command's panel sometimes not coming back after a dialog closed, leaving no panel or prompt on screen until the next redraw
Fixed screen reader mode turning off when you return to a conversation from agent view
Fixed screen reader mode y/n questions taking as yes a stray "y" at the end of text typed as the question opened
Fixed agent view erasing another agent view's saved input text when it restarted for an update with nothing typed

title.zh-TW: 網路中斷保留部分回覆並自動重試，加快根憑證載入提升啟動速度
title.en: Network interruptions retain partial replies with automatic retries, accelerating root certificate loading for faster startup

body.zh-TW: 遇到網路不穩或代理伺服器連線遲緩時，對話不會再因為加密握手失敗而直接崩潰。⟦宛如收音機調頻時遇上短暫雜訊，設備會先播放已接收到的清晰段落並嘗試重連，開機時也能迅速自憑證存根夾調出許可名單，不再空等回應。⟧當模型回覆到一半連線中斷時，不再直接丟出 TLS 握手失敗的 API 錯誤而結束回合，而是會保留已產生的部分回覆，或自動重新嘗試請求。如果網路端接受了連線卻遲遲不完成加密握手，登入、權杖更新與登出流程不再無限期空等發呆。透過加快從憑證存放區（存放根憑證的地方）讀取受信任憑證的速度，工具整體的開機啟動時間也獲得了縮短。
body.en: When encountering unstable networks or sluggish proxy connections, conversations will no longer crash outright due to failed cryptographic handshakes. ⟦Radios tuning through momentary static play whatever clear segments they already captured while attempting reconnection, and rapidly pull authorized rosters from credential binders at boot rather than idling indefinitely.⟧ When a connection drops midway through a model response, the turn no longer terminates abruptly by throwing an API error for a TLS handshake failure; instead, it preserves the partially generated reply or automatically retries the request. If the network endpoint accepts the connection but persistently stalls on completing the cryptographic handshake, sign-in, token refresh, and sign-out flows no longer hang indefinitely. By accelerating how trusted certificates load from the certificate store (where the system keeps root certificates), the tool's overall startup time has also been shortened.

items.original:
Fixed a turn ending with "API Error: EPROTO: The TLS handshake failed" when the connection broke partway through a reply; the partial reply is kept or the request is retried, as before 2.1.302
Fixed sign-in, token refresh and logout waiting indefinitely when something on the network accepts the connection but never answers the TLS handshake
Improved start-up time by loading trusted TLS certificates faster

title.zh-TW: 雲端檔案上傳遭遇容量錯誤自動重試，磁碟配額耗盡落實報錯
title.en: Cloud file uploads automatically retry on storage errors, and exhausted disk quotas properly report failures

body.zh-TW: 在雲端環境或遠端掛載目錄進行大量檔案交換時，傳輸失敗與磁碟耗盡的防範機制落實防護。⟦恰似物流中心在貨架滿載退件時主動二次遞送，遇上包裹名牌夾帶混淆字元則拒絕收件，倉庫容量用罄時也不會假裝入庫成功而默默掩蓋錯誤。⟧當代理伺服器回傳 HTTP 507 空間不足時，檔案上傳會自動重試第二次。檔名若藏有文字方向或控制字元，過去在 Claude 應用程式會顯示成不同名稱，現在 Claude 會直接拒絕傳送。在 Linux 上以 `claude -p` 執行時，若因 NFS 配額用盡遺失對話紀錄，不再靜默回傳 0，而是印出錯誤並回傳狀態碼 1。雲端連接器遇到超長資源名稱時不再引發記憶體耗盡當機；代理伺服器無法連線時也不再誤報主機未被允許。雲端工作階段若在首次回覆前重啟，含大型圖片的訊息不再被遺棄。
body.en: When exchanging large volumes of files in cloud environments or remotely mounted directories, safeguards against transfer failures and disk exhaustion now provide reliable protection. ⟦A distribution center automatically attempts a second delivery when full shelves reject packages, refuses parcels whose name tags conceal confusing characters, and never silently covers up errors by pretending storage succeeded when warehouse capacity is depleted.⟧ When a proxy server returns HTTP 507 insufficient storage, file uploads now automatically retry a second time. If a file name conceals text-direction or control characters, it previously appeared under a different name in the Claude apps, but Claude now refuses to send it. When running `claude -p` on Linux, losing transcript lines due to exhausted NFS quotas no longer silently exits with 0, but instead prints an error and returns exit code 1. Cloud connectors listing resources with excessively long names no longer trigger out-of-memory crashes, and cloud sessions no longer falsely report that a host is disallowed when a proxy server fails to connect. If a cloud session restarts before the first reply, messages containing large images are no longer dropped.

items.original:
Fixed a hang or out-of-memory crash when a connector in a cloud session lists resources with very long names
Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude that a host is probably not allowed when it is allowed and the network proxy could not connect to it
Fixed files Claude sends from cloud and Remote Control sessions failing at once when an upload gets an HTTP 507 from a proxy; the upload now gets a second try
Fixed a sent file showing under a different name in the Claude apps when its name hid text-direction or control characters; Claude now refuses to send such a file
Fixed `claude -p` on Linux exiting 0 in silence when a full NFS export or a used-up NFS quota lost transcript lines: it now prints an error and, in text and json output, exits 1
Fixed a restarted cloud session dropping a message with a large image when the restart came before Claude's first reply to it

title.zh-TW: 閘道消費額度以本機時間顯示重設點，隱藏內部變數與登入密碼
title.en: Gateway spend limits display reset times in local time, concealing internal settings and login passwords

body.zh-TW: 企業團隊透過應用程式閘道控管用量時，額度警示與帳號安全訊息的呈現形式同步改善。⟦宛若銀行在對帳單上將額度結算週期換算為當地時間，發出警訊時主動抹除帳號密碼與內部管理代號，高承載時也能即時記錄每一筆扣款。⟧達到消費額度上限時，重設時間現在會自動轉換為你的本機時區顯示（例如顯示下午四點重設）。在高承載的閘道複本上，系統減少了跳過檢查的次數，並能更即時地記錄消費金額。在 Claude Code 與 `/device` 頁面跳出登入限制訊息時，不再印出閘道內部設定鍵的名稱。錯誤訊息中顯示閘道網址時，會主動過濾掉使用者名稱與密碼。如果閘道政策中未包含特定的程式碼規則，桌面應用程式現在依然能正常看見消費額度的預警提示。
body.en: When enterprise teams manage usage through an applications gateway, the presentation of limit warnings and account security messages has improved in parallel. ⟦Banking institutions convert credit settlement cycles into local time on billing statements, strip account passwords and internal admin codes from alert notices, and promptly log every charge even under heavy loads.⟧ When reaching the spend limit, the reset time now automatically converts to your local time zone (such as showing a reset at 4 PM). On a busy gateway replica, the system skips fewer checks and records spend amounts more promptly. When sign-in limit messages appear in Claude Code and on the `/device` page, they no longer print the names of internal gateway settings. When error messages display the gateway address, usernames and passwords are now actively filtered out. Even if gateway policies do not include specific code rules, the desktop application can now properly display spend limit warnings.

items.original:
Fixed Claude Desktop not showing spend limit warnings behind a Claude apps gateway whose policy has no `code:` rules
Gateway: Improved spend limits on a busy replica, which now skips fewer checks and records spend sooner
Improved the Claude apps gateway's sign-in limit messages in Claude Code and on the `/device` page: they no longer name gateway settings, which the gateway's own log still names
Improved Claude apps gateway error messages to show the gateway's address without any user name or password
Improved the Claude apps gateway's spend limit error: the reset now shows in your local time, such as "resets 4pm (America/Los_Angeles)"

title.zh-TW: 閘道支援未知欄位向下相容，雲端上游獨立設定專用端點
title.en: Gateways support backward compatibility for unknown fields, and cloud upstreams configure dedicated endpoints independently

body.zh-TW: 維護企業閘道伺服器時，跨版本的設定檔相容性與雲端平台路由得到了釐清。⟦如同海關查驗通道在遇到新規章的欄位時先發出通告並放行，各家航空公司的專屬貨運路線也各自指定收發碼頭，不再受總機環境變數干擾。⟧當桌面設定中包含比閘道版本更新的欄位時（例如受管 MCP 伺服器的 `oauth.omitResource`），閘道不再直接拒絕啟動，而是發出警告後繼續正常服務。在啟用多層政策模式時，受管的 MCP 伺服器會在符合的每項政策中累加，讓升級後的閘道能支援更多工具。針對 Bedrock、Vertex 與 Foundry 等上游服務，閘道已改為忽略環境變數中的 Anthropic 網址設定；若需要切換至特定端點，直接在上游配置中設定 `base_url` 即可。
body.en: When maintaining enterprise gateway servers, cross-version configuration compatibility and cloud platform routing have been clarified. ⟦Customs inspection lanes issue a notice and grant passage upon encountering fields from newer regulations, while dedicated airline cargo routes designate their own terminals without interference from main switchboard environment variables.⟧ When desktop settings contain fields newer than the gateway version (such as a managed MCP server's `oauth.omitResource`), the gateway no longer refuses to start, but instead issues a warning and continues normal service. When layered policy mode is enabled, managed MCP servers accumulate across every matching policy, allowing the upgraded gateway to serve more tools. For upstream services such as Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, the gateway now ignores Anthropic URL settings in environment variables; to switch to a specific endpoint, configure `base_url` directly in the upstream configuration.

items.original:
Fixed Claude apps gateway refusing to start when a `desktop` setting holds a field newer than the gateway, such as a managed MCP server's `oauth.omitResource`; it now warns and serves it
Changed `policy_mode: layered` in the Claude apps gateway: managed MCP servers now add up over every matching policy, `match: {}` included, so a gateway already on it serves more after the upgrade
Gateway: Changed Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry upstreams to ignore the `ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL` variables in the gateway's environment. Set `base_url` on the upstream to use another endpoint

title.zh-TW: Artifact 大型資料庫改採分頁排序，跨組織存取提供副本位置指引
title.en: Large Artifact databases adopt paginated sorting, and cross-organization access guides copy locations

body.zh-TW: 產出互動成品或調閱歷史產出物時，資料庫處理與字型排版有了新的規範。⟦好似圖書館在檢索龐大目錄時引導讀者逐頁翻找再行歸納，查詢外館館藏時只對本人提供登入選項，並主動提示移交後的副本收藏處。⟧當成品的資料庫集合過於龐大而無法一次完成排序時，Artifact 工具不再建議 Claude 套用過濾條件，而是改為提示它採取逐頁讀取的方式取得資料後再整理結果。如果存取的產出物屬於其他組織，系統只會在該資產屬於你名下時才提供 `/login` 登入建議，並會在帳號遷移後主動告知副本可能的存放位置。在產出物的外觀設計建議中，系統也正式將 Inter 與 Space Grotesk 列為預設的推薦排版字型。
body.en: When generating interactive artifacts or reviewing historical outputs, database handling and typographic layout follow new guidelines. ⟦Librarians guide readers to browse page by page before compiling results when searching massive catalogs, offer sign-in options only to account holders querying outside collections, and proactively point out where transferred copies are archived.⟧ When an artifact's database collection is too large to sort all at once, the Artifact tool no longer suggests that Claude apply filters, but instead prompts it to read the data page by page and sort the results. If an accessed artifact belongs to another organization, the system only suggests logging in with `/login` if the asset is under your own account, and proactively indicates where a copy might reside after an account migration. In artifact visual design guidance, the system officially recommends Inter and Space Grotesk as default typographic typefaces.

items.original:
Fixed the Artifact tool telling Claude to add filters when an artifact's database collection is too large to sort; it now says to read the collection page by page and sort the results
Improved the messages shown when an artifact is in another organization: `/login` is offered only if it's one of yours, and Claude now says where a copy may be after an account move
Changed artifact design guidance to treat Inter and Space Grotesk as good default typefaces

title.zh-TW: 修復單行讀取記憶體膨脹，啟動階段如實通報 Git 狀態
title.en: Single-line reads resolve memory bloat, and session startup truthfully reports Git status

body.zh-TW: 在大型專案中長時間開啟對話時，上下文用量估算與記憶體佔用修正失準問題。⟦好比工程師翻閱厚重藍圖時不再把整卷圖紙全攤在桌面上，清點庫存失敗時也如實標註狀態未明，而非假裝全部貨物都已清點妥當。⟧在長時間的工作階段中反覆讀取大檔案的單一行數時，記憶體佔用過高的問題已經獲得修復。在讀取歷史對話紀錄若發生記憶體不足，不會再導致新訊息無法儲存或造成命令列、SDK 與 VS Code 連線當死。當無法取得精確的文字計算時，上下文估算不再高估工具定義的佔用量。在工作階段剛啟動時，若 `git status` 執行失敗，系統會如實向 Claude 標記為無法取得，而非誤報為乾淨；暫存區的檔案狀態也不會再錯誤將未暫存的第一個檔案標為已暫存。
body.en: During prolonged conversations in large projects, context usage estimates and excessive memory consumption have been corrected. ⟦Engineers no longer spread entire rolls of blueprints across the table when referencing thick schematics, and faithfully flag inventory counts as undetermined upon failure rather than pretending all goods were properly tallied.⟧ High memory usage in long sessions that repeatedly read single lines from large files has been fixed. Running out of memory while reading transcript history no longer prevents new messages from being saved or causes command-line, SDK, and VS Code sessions to hang. When exact text calculations are unavailable, context estimates no longer overestimate the footprint of tool definitions. At session startup, if `git status` fails, the system faithfully marks it as unavailable to Claude rather than falsely reporting it as clean; staged file status also no longer mistakenly marks the first unstaged file as staged.

items.original:
Fixed context usage estimates overcounting tool definitions when exact token counts are unavailable
Fixed high memory use in long sessions that repeatedly read single lines from large files
Fixed the git status given to Claude at session start reading as clean when git status failed; it now reads as unavailable
Fixed the git status given to Claude at session start showing the first listed file as staged when its changes were not staged
Fixed new messages not being saved, and `claude -p`, SDK and VS Code sessions hanging, when memory ran out while the transcript was being read

title.zh-TW: 網頁讀取未回傳內容時明確報錯，多圖工作階段限制重複讀取
title.en: Web fetches explicitly report errors when content is missing, and multi-image sessions restrict repeat reads

body.zh-TW: 請 Claude 抓取網頁內容或分析多張介面截圖時，資料載入的判斷不再模稜兩可。⟦宛如研究助理調閱微縮膠卷，遇到空白膠卷時直接回報讀取失敗而非把系統錯誤當成文稿，同一批參考照片看過之後便做好標記避免重複翻閱。⟧使用 WebFetch 擷取網頁時，若負責讀取頁面的模型沒有傳回任何文字，不再將內部錯誤訊息當作網頁內容餵給 Claude，而是直接回傳明確的失敗錯誤。在圖片數量超出單次請求容量的工作階段中，Claude 會得知某張被捨棄的圖片是否曾經看過，並限制對未變更圖片的重複讀取。內建的資料視覺化技能也更新了建議規則，當多個比例各自擁有上限時，推薦採用每行一項的儀表清單形式呈現。
body.en: When asking Claude to fetch web content or analyze multiple interface screenshots, data loading determinations are no longer ambiguous. ⟦Research assistants examining microfilm directly report a read failure upon encountering blank film instead of treating system errors as manuscripts, and tag referenced photos once viewed to prevent redundant browsing.⟧ When fetching web pages with WebFetch, if the model reading the page returns no text, internal error messages are no longer fed to Claude as page content; the call now fails directly with a clear error. In sessions where the number of images exceeds single-request capacity, Claude is informed whether a dropped image was previously seen, and repeat reads of unchanged images are limited. The bundled data visualization skill has also updated its recommendations, suggesting a list of meters with one row per item when multiple ratios each have their own limit.

items.original:
Fixed WebFetch passing "No response from model" to Claude as page content when the model reading the page returned no text; the call now fails with a clear error
Improved sessions with more images than fit in one request: Claude is told whether it has already seen a dropped image, and repeat reads of an unchanged image are limited
Updated the bundled dataviz skill to suggest a list of meters, one row per item, for several ratios that each have their own limit

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器非必要任務正常結束，全螢幕外掛輸出與安裝加速
title.en: Self-hosted runners exit cleanly on unneeded tasks, while fullscreen plugin outputs and installations speed up

body.zh-TW: 在伺服器部署自動化執行器或初次安裝工具時，腳本運行與全螢幕終端機的錯誤得到排除。⟦如同自動化調度機在任務已取消時安靜返回待命區而非發出警報，安裝程序精簡了繁瑣手續，讀取企業設定逾時也能明確指出等待過久。⟧自架執行器若因為工作階段結束、暫停或工單已被取代而遭伺服器拒絕時，程式結束代碼改為正常的 0 而非報錯的 1。在某些外掛的全螢幕視窗中，工具輸出內容變短並滾動出螢幕頂端時不再引發崩潰。在 macOS 讀取 MDM 設定偏慢時，會自動重試一次，超時也會如實回報逾時。執行 `claude install` 及安裝腳本的時間縮短了 2 到 4 秒。在命令列與 SDK 工作階段中，`AskUserQuestion` 會直接拒絕帶有未記載 `afkTimeoutMs` 欄位的授權答覆。
body.en: When deploying automated runners on servers or installing tools for the first time, script execution and fullscreen terminal errors have been resolved. ⟦Automated dispatch units quietly return to standby rather than sounding alarms when tasks are cancelled, installation procedures streamline cumbersome steps, and enterprise setting timeouts explicitly report excessive waits.⟧ When a self-hosted runner is refused by the server because the session ended, paused, or the work order was superseded, the exit code changes to a normal 0 instead of an error 1. In fullscreen sessions with certain plugins, a tool output that has shortened and scrolled off the top of the screen no longer causes a crash. When macOS is slow to read MDM settings, it automatically retries once, and a timeout is now faithfully reported as a timeout. Running `claude install` and installation scripts now finishes 2 to 4 seconds faster. In command-line and SDK sessions, `AskUserQuestion` directly denies permission answers that contain the undocumented `afkTimeoutMs` input field.

items.original:
macOS: Fixed "Unable to read managed policy settings" at startup when a valid MDM profile was slow to read: the read is retried once, and a timeout is now reported as a timeout
Fixed fullscreen sessions with some plugins ending with an error when a tool result that had got shorter scrolled off the top of the screen
Improved `claude install` and the install scripts: they finish 2 to 4 seconds sooner
Self-hosted runner: Changed an on-demand runner that the server refuses because it is not needed (session ended or paused, work order superseded) to exit 0 instead of 1
Changed `AskUserQuestion` in `claude -p` and SDK sessions to deny a host's permission answer that sets the undocumented `afkTimeoutMs` input field

title.zh-TW: 自動模式關閉遙測時改走詢問或拒絕，外部關閉後專案無法擅自重啟
title.en: Auto mode asks or denies when telemetry is disabled, and projects cannot reopen checks turned off outside

body.zh-TW: 在停用遙測或功能旗標的環境下使用自動模式，只要伺服器無法執行安全審查，呼叫就會直接改為詢問你或予以拒絕，不再備援（fallback）回內建分類器。Bedrock、Vertex 與 Foundry 行為維持不變，設 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` 可沿用舊機制。在大型語言模型閘道後方，設 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1`，即使指定 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` 也會啟用伺服器檢查；若後者由受管設定指定，前者也須設在受管設定。閘道網址只設於受管設定、且無法取得伺服器受管設定時，該處的啟用值被忽略的問題已修好。此外，一旦在專案外關閉檢查，個別專案設定或外掛無法擅自重新開啟。⟦保全總機關掉主控鎖後，以前房內開關還能覆寫，現在各房間無法自行重開。⟧
body.en: When using auto mode with telemetry or feature flags disabled, calls the server cannot review for safety are now asked about or denied directly, without falling back to the built-in classifier. Behavior on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry remains unchanged, and setting `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` keeps the legacy mechanism. Behind an LLM gateway, setting `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` turns on server-side checks even if `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` is specified. If the latter is set by managed settings, the former must also be configured in managed settings. A bug has been fixed where `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` in managed settings was ignored behind an LLM gateway when the gateway URL was configured only there and server-managed settings could not be fetched. In addition, once you switch off the check outside a project, individual project settings or plugins can no longer turn it back on. ⟦Picture a central security desk locking the master switch: while room switches could previously override it, individual rooms can no longer reopen the lock on their own.⟧

items.original:
Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier; set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` to keep using it (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
Changed auto mode behind an LLM gateway: `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` turns on the server-side check even with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set; if managed settings set the latter, they must set the `1` too
Fixed a case where `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` in managed settings was ignored behind an LLM gateway when the gateway's URL is set only there and server-managed settings can't be fetched
Changed auto mode so that a project's settings files or a plugin can no longer switch its server-side check back on once you have switched it off outside the project

title.zh-TW: 自動模式拒絕動作後修正退出狀態，修復狀態誤報與規則過長拒絕
title.en: Auto mode fixes exit status on denied actions, rectifying status misreports and oversized-rule refusals

body.zh-TW: 在指令列以非互動模式執行 `claude -p` 時，若動作原本已因缺乏安全檢查而遭拒絕，純文字與 JSON 格式輸出的退出狀態代碼現在都會正確設為 1，不再錯誤回傳代表成功的 0。當客戶端連續發送切換模型與啟用自動模式的請求時，過去容易被系統誤判拒絕，這項問題已經排除。如果在大型語言模型閘道背後發生審查無法送達工作階段的情況，輸入 `/status` 也不再錯誤顯示伺服器端已啟用。當權限規則或 `autoMode` 設定內容極度龐大時，過去會在沒有說明原因的情況下拒絕執行；現在會明確給出解釋，且除非已明定 `autoMode` 拒絕規則，否則會在終端機提示詢問你。⟦貨物原本就被海關拒收，以前回條卻誤印「成功」，現在改印「失敗」；退件結果沒變，改的是回條不再報錯狀態。⟧
body.en: When running `claude -p` non-interactively on the command line, if actions are refused because no safety check was available, the exit status code for text and JSON outputs is now properly set to 1 instead of mistakenly returning 0 for success. An issue where auto mode was wrongly refused when a client sent a model change and a request for auto mode back to back has been resolved. Entering `/status` also no longer incorrectly displays that the server side is enabled when reviews fail to reach the session behind an LLM gateway. When permission rules or `autoMode` settings are extremely large, executions previously refused without explanation now provide a clear reason, and prompt you in the terminal unless `autoMode` deny rules are explicitly configured. ⟦Think of customs rejecting a shipment where the receipt mistakenly printed "Success" in the past: it now prints "Failure," leaving the rejected outcome unchanged while ensuring the slip no longer misreports the status.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 in auto mode when its actions were refused because no safety check was available: text and JSON output now exit 1
Fixed a case where auto mode was wrongly refused when a client sent a model change and a request for auto mode back to back
Fixed `/status` showing "Auto mode server: Enabled" when the server-side review isn't reaching the session, for example behind an LLM gateway that drops it
Fixed auto mode refusing actions without saying why when permission rules or `autoMode` settings are very large: it now explains and, unless `autoMode` deny rules are set, asks you in the terminal

title.zh-TW: 終端機支援 MCP 任務背景執行，提供環境變數切換等待模式
title.en: Terminal supports background execution for MCP tasks, offering an environment variable to toggle waiting mode

body.zh-TW: 當你透過終端機呼叫 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，若工具將呼叫當成任務執行，Claude Code 會立刻將它移至背景運作，並在完成時主動回報結果給 Claude。這項功能現在無須抓取功能旗標即可在終端機運作，包含 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry、大型語言模型閘道以及停用遙測的環境都能直接使用。如果你希望工具呼叫維持在前景等待任務完成，可以設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND`。若完全不想使用這項機制，則可將 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS` 設為 `1` 來予以停用。⟦如同將繁瑣的送印差事交給影印部，以前整個人必須守在影印機旁乾等成品；現在單據一送出即可轉身處理其他事務，印妥時櫃檯自會派員遞送通知。⟧
body.en: When you call an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) server through the terminal, if a tool executes the call as a task, Claude Code immediately moves it to the background and reports the result to Claude upon completion. This capability now works in the terminal without fetching feature flags, making it directly available across Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, LLM gateways, and environments with telemetry disabled. If you prefer the tool call to stay in the foreground waiting for the task to complete, you can configure the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND` environment variable. If you do not want to use this mechanism at all, set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS` to `1` to turn it off. ⟦A clerk delivers a bulky print job to the copy center: where you previously had to wait right by the copier for the output, you can now hand over the slip and attend to other work, receiving a desk delivery once printing finishes.⟧

items.original:
Added support for MCP tasks in the terminal: when an MCP server runs a tool call as a task, Claude Code moves it to the background right away and tells Claude the result when it finishes
Added the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND` environment variable to make Claude Code wait for an MCP task inside its tool call instead of moving it to the background right away
Changed MCP tasks to work in the terminal without feature-flag fetching (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, LLM gateways, `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`); set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS=1` to turn them off

title.zh-TW: 修復舊版 MCP 握手協定連線、恢復工作階段後的結果回傳與桌面版規則
title.en: Fixes for legacy MCP handshake connections, post-resume result delivery, and Desktop rules

body.zh-TW: 當你連線至採用舊版握手協定的外部工具伺服器時，過去可能因為宣告了新伺服器專用的擴充項目而連線失敗或傳回空結果，這個問題已經修復。針對連接 claude.ai 連接器的長時間工具呼叫，過去在恢復工作階段後有時會遺失結果回報，現在已能正常取得。若在執行 `claude -p --resume` 帶有提示詞時缺少對應的工具伺服器，執行程序會以代碼 1 退出，並保留該次呼叫且拒絕後續輸入，避免延後執行的工具呼叫憑空遺失。在 Claude Desktop，以 `mcp__claude_ai_Slack` 這類連接器終端名稱撰寫的拒絕與詢問規則、`disallowedTools` 禁用工具清單及 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）匹配器被略過的問題也已修正，但須待桌面版納入此版本才生效。
body.en: When connecting to external tool servers that use an older handshake, failures to connect or empty results caused by declaring extensions reserved for newer servers have now been fixed. For long-running tool calls on claude.ai connectors, where result reports were sometimes lost after resuming a session, results are now properly retrieved. When running `claude -p --resume` with a prompt while the corresponding tool server is missing, the process now exits with code 1, keeps the call, and refuses subsequent input to prevent deferred tool calls from vanishing. In Claude Desktop, an issue where deny and ask rules, `disallowedTools` entries, and hook (small programs triggered by specific events) matchers written with connector terminal names like `mcp__claude_ai_Slack` were ignored has also been corrected, though this takes effect once the desktop version incorporates this release.

items.original:
Fixed MCP servers on the older handshake failing to connect, or returning empty results, because Claude Code declared an extension that it only uses with newer servers
Fixed a long-running MCP tool call on a claude.ai connector sometimes never reporting its result after `--resume`
Fixed `claude -p --resume` with a prompt losing a deferred tool call when its MCP server is missing: the run now exits 1, keeps the call and refuses later input
Fixed a case where deny and ask rules, hook matchers and `disallowedTools` entries written with a claude.ai connector's terminal name (`mcp__claude_ai_Slack`) were ignored in Claude Desktop (takes effect once Claude Desktop includes this version)

title.zh-TW: 權限提示支援直接拒絕設定，廣義拒絕規則優先於特定詢問
title.en: Permission prompts support direct denial, prioritizing broad deny rules over specific asks

body.zh-TW: 在終端機工作階段、子代理或協作隊友中執行工具時，若不想讓流程卡在權限詢問畫面，可啟用 `permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting` 設定。開啟後，原本需要等待手動確認的工具呼叫會直接遭到拒絕，並讓輪次繼續往下執行。當 Bash 或 PowerShell 的指令同時符合特定詢問規則與更廣泛的拒絕規則時，工具會直接拒絕執行該指令，不再跳出詢問提示。另外，Bash 工具在執行 `which` 指令時，只要參數超出一般的查詢與顯示旗標範圍，便會主動要求授權許可。⟦好似自動售票機切換為夜間直通模式，遇到不支援的冷門支付方式直接退幣跳過，不再卡在付款畫面等待專人排除障礙，以前必須手動逐一確認，現在自動化直接判定。⟧
body.en: When running tools in terminal sessions, subagents, or teammates, if you do not want workflows getting stuck on permission prompts, you can enable the `permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting` setting. Once turned on, tool calls that would otherwise wait for manual confirmation are denied immediately, allowing the turn to continue. When a Bash or PowerShell command matches both a specific ask rule and a broader deny rule, the tool directly refuses to execute the command rather than presenting a prompt. In addition, the Bash tool now actively requests permission before running `which` whenever flags fall outside a standard lookup and display set. ⟦Consider a ticket kiosk switching to direct night mode: when encountering an unsupported obscure payment method, it spits out the coin and moves on instead of freezing on the payment screen for an attendant, replacing manual confirmation with immediate automated decisions.⟧

items.original:
Added `permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting` setting: a tool call that would wait on a permission prompt is denied and the turn continues, in terminal sessions, subagents and teammates
Changed a session's exact Bash or PowerShell ask rule to be refused, not asked about, when a broader deny rule covers the command
Changed the Bash tool to ask for permission before running `which` with flags outside a lookup/display set

title.zh-TW: 修復 Bash 權限檢查引號漏判、環境變數前綴繞過與逾時唯讀確認
title.en: Fixes for Bash permission check quote misses, environment prefix bypasses, and timeout read-only prompts

body.zh-TW: 當你在安全規則中限制 Bash 指令時，多種指令解析漏洞已獲得修復。過去包含引號字詞的指令可能會脫離拒絕與詢問規則的過濾範圍，精心構造的環境變數前綴也可能將部分指令隱藏起來繞過檢查，這些漏判情況都已修復。在接受編輯模式與自動模式下，先前特定 `sed` 指令可能跳過權限檢查的漏洞也已補強。同時，唯讀指令外面加上單純的 `timeout DURATION`，例如 `timeout 30 rg foo`，不再出現多餘的權限詢問。以前唯讀指令包一層 `timeout` 就會被多問一次，含引號或帶環境變數前綴的指令也可能溜過拒絕規則；現在這幾個漏洞都已修好。
body.en: When restricting Bash commands in security rules, several command-parsing loopholes have now been fixed. Previously, commands containing quoted words could slip past deny and ask rules, while a crafted environment variable prefix could hide parts of a command from inspection; both gaps have now been resolved. A vulnerability where specific `sed` commands could skip permission checks under accept-edits and auto mode has also been patched. At the same time, wrapping read-only commands in a plain `timeout DURATION`, such as `timeout 30 rg foo`, no longer triggers needless permission prompts. Where read-only commands wrapped in `timeout` were previously prompted an extra time and commands with quotes or environment variable prefixes could slip past deny rules, these flaws are now all fixed.

items.original:
Fixed a case where Bash deny and ask rules missed commands written with quoted words
Fixed needless permission prompts for read-only commands wrapped in a plain `timeout DURATION`, such as `timeout 30 rg foo`
Fixed a case where a `sed` command could skip the permission check in accept-edits and auto mode
Fixed a Bash permission bypass where a crafted environment prefix could hide part of a command from permission checks

title.zh-TW: 代理伺服器支援 TLS 檢驗握手修復，明確限制環境變數宣告位置
title.en: Proxy support adds TLS inspection handshake repair, clarifying environment variable locations

body.zh-TW: 在代理後方且本機沒有 DNS（查詢網域位址的服務）時，設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS` 後，Monitor 的 WebSocket 監控不再出現無法解析主機名稱的錯誤。主機管理網路時，該變數須設於處理程序環境，不能由設定檔指定。Monitor 遇到 Bash 拒絕規則就禁止監控；遇到詢問規則，對 Monitor 的允許、略過權限模式及自動模式都不能跳過詢問。在 TLS 檢驗代理後方，設 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` 時，憑證失敗後會與設定的 API 主機進行 TLS 握手，若有設定 `http://` 代理才經由它連線，不發送 API 請求。自動憑證修復不再於僅設 `ALL_PROXY` 時觸發，須將 `HTTPS_PROXY` 設為代理的 `http://` 位址。
body.en: Behind a proxy where the local machine has no DNS (a service that resolves domain names), setting `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS` prevents Monitor's WebSocket watch from failing with host resolution errors. Where the host manages the network, this variable must be set in the process environment and can no longer be defined by settings files. When Monitor encounters a Bash deny rule, it refuses the watch. Under an ask rule, an allow on Monitor, bypass permissions mode, and auto mode can no longer skip the prompt. Behind a TLS-inspecting proxy, when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` is set, Claude Code performs a TLS handshake with the configured API host following a certificate failure—connecting through your `http://` proxy if one is configured—without sending any API request. Automatic certificate repair no longer triggers when `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy variable set; you must set `HTTPS_PROXY` to the proxy's `http://` address instead.

items.original:
Fixed Monitor's WebSocket watch failing with "could not resolve" behind a proxy when `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS` is set and the machine has no DNS of its own
Fixed a case where certificate errors behind a TLS-inspecting proxy persisted when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` was set. With it set, Claude Code now makes a TLS handshake with the configured API host after a certificate failure, through your http:// proxy if one is set; it sends no API request
Changed Monitor's WebSocket watch to follow a rule on every Bash command: a deny refuses it, and under an ask rule an allow on Monitor, bypass mode or auto mode no longer skips the prompt
Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS` so that settings files can no longer set it where the host manages the network; set it in the process environment
Changed the automatic certificate repair behind a TLS-inspecting proxy: it no longer runs when `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy variable set. Set `HTTPS_PROXY` to the proxy's http:// URL instead

title.zh-TW: 新增 API 延遲最佳化指令，同步管理型代理設定範本
title.en: Adds API latency optimization command, synchronizing Managed Agents configuration templates

body.zh-TW: 當你著手調整 Claude API 程式碼時，現在只要輸入 `/claude-api latency-optimize`，工具就會協助找出程式中造成使用者等待的瓶頸，並根據你的評估集測試更快的設定組合。針對管理型代理工作階段，修正了技能說明中聲稱主控台網頁設定不適用的錯誤，並收緊了相關憑證與權限範例。此外，`/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` 中的模板已對齊主控台規格，移除 Performance tuner 範本，重新命名兩項範本，並在五個提示詞不需要網路功能的範本中關閉了搜尋與網頁讀取。⟦恰似車廠技師拿著調校儀器診斷引擎管線，針對耗損嚴重的組件替換輕量零件，去除車內多餘載重以縮短起步加速時間。⟧
body.en: When tuning Claude API code, entering `/claude-api latency-optimize` now helps find bottlenecks that make people wait and tests faster configuration combinations against your eval. For Managed Agents sessions, an error in the skill description claiming Console web settings do not apply has been corrected, and its credential and permission examples have been tightened. Additionally, templates in `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` now match Claude Console specifications, removing the Performance tuner template, renaming two others, and disabling web search and fetch across five templates whose prompts do not require network access. ⟦A garage mechanic runs diagnostic instruments across engine piping: replacing worn parts with lightweight components and stripping excess vehicle weight cuts down initial acceleration time.⟧

items.original:
Added `/claude-api latency-optimize` to find where your Claude API code makes people wait and try faster settings against your eval
Fixed the `/claude-api` skill saying Console web settings don't apply to Managed Agents sessions, and tightened its credential and permission examples
Updated `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` templates to match the Claude Console: removed Performance tuner, renamed two, and turned off web search and fetch in five whose prompts don't use them

title.zh-TW: 設定檔存檔不再變成空檔，支援單獨關閉功能旗標抓取
title.en: Config saves no longer leave empty files, supporting standalone disabling of feature-flag fetching

body.zh-TW: 當你想維持遙測但停止抓取實驗性開關時，現在可設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAGS`，讓每項功能旗標直接套用內建預設值。過去在寫入設定檔數秒內進行的手動修改常被忽略，這個問題已修好。家目錄若殘留舊版檔名而有兩份設定檔，會在標準錯誤輸出說明正在用哪一份。在唯讀資料夾或綁定掛載檔案遇到磁碟寫滿時（一次由一個工作階段存檔），`~/.claude.json`、設定檔與正在編輯的檔案不再變成空檔或被截斷。Windows 平台儲存設定時則會延長等待其他程式釋放檔案的時間，降低存檔期間程序被終止後 `~/.claude.json` 變成空檔的機率。
body.en: When you want to retain telemetry while stopping the retrieval of experimental toggles, you can now set the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAGS` environment variable so that every feature flag directly applies its built-in default. A bug where manual edits made within a few seconds of writing a settings file were ignored has now been resolved. If your home directory holds two configuration files due to a lingering legacy filename, Claude Code now explains on stderr which one is currently in use. When disk space fills up during a save inside a read-only folder or to a bind-mounted file (with one session saving at a time), `~/.claude.json`, settings files, and edited files no longer end up empty or cut off. On Windows, config saves now wait longer for other programs to release the file, reducing the likelihood that terminating the process during a save leaves `~/.claude.json` empty.

items.original:
Added the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAGS` environment variable, which stops feature-flag fetching without turning off telemetry; every flag then uses its built-in default
Fixed edits to a settings file being ignored when made within a few seconds of Claude Code writing that file
Fixed a config file left at the legacy name hiding your setup with no warning: Claude Code now says on stderr when a home holds two config files, and which is in use
Fixed `~/.claude.json`, settings and edited files ending up empty or cut off when the disk fills during a save in a read-only folder or to a bind-mounted file (one session saving at a time)
Improved config saves on Windows: Claude Code waits longer for a file another program has open, so a kill during a save is less likely to leave `~/.claude.json` empty

title.zh-TW: Claude Apps 閘道支援群組共用預算排程、JSON 日誌與登入公告
title.en: Claude Apps gateway supports pooled group budgets, JSON logs, and login notices

body.zh-TW: 企業透過 Claude Apps 閘道管理團隊使用時，帳務與維運控制獲得更完整的支援。若開發者隸屬多個群組，管理員可透過 `admin.pooled_conflict_rule` 與 `admin.pooled_priority_order` 設定優先扣款的群組預算。閘道執行此版本或更新版本、且開發者無花費上限時，輸入 `/usage` 可查詢本日、本週與本月開銷。閘道新增 `login_notice` 可在驗證與登入頁面展示公告；指定 `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_LOG_FORMAT=json`，維運日誌會轉為 JSON，包含 `severity` 等級、`time` 時間與 `message` 訊息，供從欄位讀取等級的日誌收集器使用。達上限時，錯誤訊息會顯示重設日期；若設定了 `admin.blocked_message`，才會附上自訂封鎖說明。
body.en: When organizations manage team usage through the Claude apps gateway, billing and operational controls receive more comprehensive support. If a developer belongs to multiple groups, administrators can use `admin.pooled_conflict_rule` and `admin.pooled_priority_order` to configure which pooled group budget pays first. When the gateway runs this version or later and a developer has no spend limit, entering `/usage` allows checking spend for today, this week, and this month. The gateway adds `login_notice` to display announcements on verification and sign-in pages. By specifying `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_LOG_FORMAT=json`, operational logs become JSON containing `severity` level, `time`, and `message` fields for log collectors that read severity levels from structured fields. When reaching the limit, the error message displays the reset date, appending a custom block notice only if `admin.blocked_message` is set.

items.original:
Added spend for today, this week and this month to `/usage` for developers behind a Claude apps gateway who have no spend limit, when the gateway runs this version or later
Added `admin.pooled_conflict_rule` and `admin.pooled_priority_order` to the Claude apps gateway, to set which pooled group budget pays first for a developer in several groups
Added an optional `login_notice` setting to the Claude apps gateway that shows an operator-defined message on the gateway's browser verification page and on Claude Code's sign-in screen
