Added `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_LOG_FORMAT=json` to the Claude apps gateway: operational log lines become JSON with `severity`, `time` and `message`, for log collectors that read the level from a field
Improved the Claude apps gateway's spend limit error: it reads "spend limit reached · resets Dec 1", then `admin.blocked_message` if one is set

title.zh-TW: Claude Apps 閘道強化啟動警示，明確標註上游名稱與模型設定
title.en: Claude Apps Gateway Strengthens Boot Warnings, Explicitly Labeling Upstream Names and Model Settings

body.zh-TW: 部署 Claude Apps 閘道時，可留意啟動警告。其他策略的 `availableModels` 也允許某策略具名列出的自訂模型識別碼時，會警告。策略缺少 `desktopHome`，卻依賴 `coworkTabEnabled: false` 或 `chatSessionRetentionDays` 時，會在 Claude Desktop 11 月 10 日變更前警告。AWS GovCloud 與其他上游混用，或閘道環境含基礎網址變數，也會警告。受管設定標頭列出閘道不轉發的 Amazon Bedrock 防護欄，且沒有任何 `bedrock` 上游設定 `guardrail`，啟動日誌也會警告。呼叫失敗的警告會點名上游，不再只顯示提供者。全數上游為 Amazon Bedrock 時，Claude Desktop 不再提供必然失敗的網路搜尋工具。
body.en: When deploying the Claude apps gateway, note several new startup warnings. The gateway now warns when another policy's `availableModels` also allows a custom model id that one policy lists by name. It also warns ahead of Claude Desktop's November 10 change if policies have no `desktopHome` while relying on `coworkTabEnabled: false` or `chatSessionRetentionDays`. Warnings also trigger when upstreams mix AWS GovCloud with other upstreams, or when base URL variables exist in the gateway's environment. A startup log warning is also added when managed settings name an Amazon Bedrock guardrail in a header that the gateway does not forward, while no `bedrock` upstream sets a `guardrail`. Warnings about a failed upstream call now name the upstream rather than only its provider. Finally, Claude Desktop no longer offers a web search tool that always failed when every upstream is Amazon Bedrock.

items.original:
Added a Claude apps gateway boot warning for a case where another policy's `availableModels` also allows a custom model id that one policy lists by name
Added start-up warnings to the Claude apps gateway for policies with no `desktopHome` that rely on `coworkTabEnabled: false` or `chatSessionRetentionDays`, ahead of Claude Desktop's November 10 change
Improved the Claude apps gateway's warnings about a failed upstream call: each now names the upstream, not only its provider
Gateway: Added startup warnings for upstreams that mix AWS GovCloud with other upstreams, and for base URL variables in the gateway's environment
Gateway: Added a start-up log warning when managed settings name an Amazon Bedrock guardrail in a header, which the gateway doesn't forward, and no `bedrock` upstream sets a `guardrail`
Gateway: Fixed Claude Desktop offering a web search tool that always failed when every upstream is Amazon Bedrock

title.zh-TW: 帳號切換自動警示 Console 計費組織，修復 401 憑證刷新連鎖錯誤
title.en: Account Switching Warns of Console Billing Organization, Fixing Chained 401 Login Refresh Errors

body.zh-TW: 當你的個人帳號登入過期時，若系統自動改用 `ant auth login` 的登入狀態繼續執行，終端機會跳出警示，並在 Claude Code 啟動時指名費用將計入哪一個主控台組織。在登入機制方面，修復了持續遭遇 401 未授權錯誤的請求在每次重試時都會刷新登入，進而導致其他終端機工作階段同步引發 401 錯誤的連鎖問題。在 `/login` 成功畫面按下確認鍵後的半秒卡頓也已排除，對話框會立即關閉並在背景刷新。此外，若終端機在閘道的登入已過期，不再持續發送會被閘道拒絕並記錄無效權杖（invalid_token）的遙測與受管設定請求。以前一個卡住的請求會讓其他工作階段跟著出現 401；現在這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When your personal claude.ai login expires, if the system continues on the sign-in from `ant auth login`, the terminal displays a warning and names at startup which Claude Console organization is billed. For authentication, a bug was fixed where a request that kept failing with a 401 error refreshed your login on every retry, triggering a chain of 401 errors across your other terminal sessions. A half-second hang after pressing Enter on the `/login` success screen has also been resolved: the dialog dismisses immediately while the post-login refresh runs in the background. Furthermore, a terminal whose sign-in for the Claude apps gateway has expired no longer sends telemetry and managed-settings requests that the gateway refused and logged as `invalid_token`. Previously, one stuck request could cause 401s in other sessions; that issue is now fixed.

items.original:
Added a warning when your claude.ai login ends and Claude Code continues on the sign-in from `ant auth login`, which bills usage to your Claude Console organization
Added a line at startup naming the Claude Console organization that is billed in a case where Claude Code uses the sign-in from `ant auth login`
Fixed a request that kept failing with a 401 refreshing your login on every retry and causing 401s in your other sessions
Fixed a ~0.5s hang after pressing Enter on the `/login` success screen: the dialog now dismisses immediately and the post-login refresh runs in the background
Fixed a terminal whose Claude apps gateway sign-in had expired sending telemetry and managed-settings requests that the gateway refused and logged as `invalid_token`

title.zh-TW: 任務清單新增歷史子代理記錄，改善交回報告與安全防護回報
title.en: Task List Adds Historical Subagent History, Improving Hand-Back Reports and Safeguard Alerts

body.zh-TW: 輸入 `/tasks` 檢視任務清單時，現在多了「此工作階段稍早項目」區塊，完整列出已結束的子代理，即使項目已移出清單或重新啟動，你隨時都能重新打開並發送訊息。子代理交回報告在非詳細模式下展開時，過去會顯示內部標記與來源註記的問題已經修復。當對話完成歷程濃縮後，子代理不會再被告知去等待未曾負責的背景代理完成通知。若背景代理稍後的報告被拒絕，系統不再無聲丟失回報，而是會提示已被拒絕並告知如何索取。當安全防護措施阻擋了子代理時，Claude 收到的指示改為縮小提示詞範圍重試或主動告知你，不再自行接手該項工作。⟦就像客服中心的主管看板，過往結案的工單依然整齊陳列可隨時調閱追問，交接紀錄抹去內部代碼，出現異常時也能即時亮起警示。⟧
body.en: When running `/tasks` to view the task list, an "Earlier in this session" row is now added to fully list finished subagents, allowing you to reopen and message one at any time even after it leaves the list or you restart. A fix resolves an issue where subagent hand-back reports displayed an internal marker and provenance note when expanded outside verbose mode. Following context compaction, subagents are no longer told to expect a completion notice for background agents they neither started nor took over. If a background agent's later report is refused, the system no longer silently drops it, but instead notifies you that it was refused and explains how to request it. When safeguards stop a subagent, Claude is now instructed to retry with a narrower prompt or inform you directly, rather than taking over the work itself. ⟦Much like a support desk supervisor dashboard, closed tickets remain neatly listed for review or follow-up at any time, internal codes are cleared from handover notes, and warnings surface immediately whenever exceptions arise.⟧

items.original:
Added an "Earlier in this session" row to `/tasks` that lists finished subagents, so you can reopen one and message it even after it leaves the list or you restart
Fixed subagent hand-back reports showing an internal marker and provenance note when expanded outside verbose mode
Fixed subagents being told after compaction to expect a completion notice for background agents they neither started nor took over
Fixed a case where a background agent's later report was lost silently: the notification now says it was refused and how to ask for it
Changed what Claude is told after safeguards stop a subagent: retry with a narrower prompt or tell you, instead of doing the work itself

title.zh-TW: 循環指令支援容器生命週期警示，自定節奏結束時不再排定喚醒
title.en: Loop Command Adds Container Lifecycle Warnings, Ending Self-Paced Loops Without Wakeups

body.zh-TW: 在雲端工作階段設定 `/loop` 循環指令時，確認畫面現在會明確提醒你計時器將隨著容器終止而停止，並提供能在容器重啟後持續存活的循環選項。針對自定節奏的循環操作，若單次回合執行完畢且未重新排程，流程會直接結束，不再自動排定備援的喚醒程序；若你的自動化工作流仍依賴舊有機制，可將環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE` 設為 `1` 來維持原先行為。⟦好比廚房的倒數計時器，以前時間到了就算無人點單也會按時反覆響鈴，現在只要菜餚出餐完畢便自動歸零靜止，同時在離店前提醒你設備將隨店面打烊斷電。⟧
body.en: When setting up a `/loop` command in cloud sessions, the confirmation screen now clearly notes that a timer stops with its container, offering a loop option that survives restarts. For self-paced `/loop` operations, when a single turn finishes without rescheduling, the process ends directly instead of scheduling a fallback wakeup; if your automated workflows rely on the legacy behavior, set environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE=1` to preserve it. ⟦Like a kitchen countdown timer, it previously rang repeatedly on schedule even when no tickets arrived, but now resets and stays silent once dishes are served, while reminding you before leaving that equipment shuts off when the store closes.⟧

items.original:
Added a note to `/loop` confirmations in cloud sessions that a timer stops with its container, with an offer of a loop that survives
Changed self-paced `/loop` to end when a turn finishes without rescheduling, instead of scheduling a fallback wakeup; set `CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE=1` to keep the old behavior

title.zh-TW: 修復目錄包含 HEAD 檔案時的差異比對失敗與多輪編輯空白問題
title.en: Fix Diff Loading Failures with HEAD Files and Blank Panes in Multi-Turn Sessions

body.zh-TW: 檢視修改內容時，若 Claude Code 執行所在資料夾有名為 `HEAD` 的檔案或資料夾，claude.ai 與行動版原本會載不出工作階段的變更；若 Git 儲存庫最上層有這類檔案或資料夾，`/diff` 則會顯示無法使用。此外，在已有至少 64 個回合編輯過檔案的工作階段中，原本點開 `/diff` 面板可能呈現一片空白。上述載入失敗與空白面板問題已修好。
body.en: When inspecting modifications, if the folder where Claude Code runs contains a file or folder named `HEAD`, a session's diff previously failed to load on claude.ai and the mobile apps; if a Git repository has such a file or folder at its top level, `/diff` showed "Diff unavailable". In addition, in sessions where 64 or more turns edited files, the `/diff` pane could open completely blank. These loading failures and blank pane issues have now been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed a session's diff failing to load on claude.ai and the mobile apps when the folder Claude Code runs in has a file or folder named `HEAD`
Fixed `/diff` showing "Diff unavailable" when a git repository has a file or folder named `HEAD` at its top level
Fixed the `/diff` pane opening blank in sessions where 64 or more turns edited files

title.zh-TW: 修復程式碼回溯在分支建立前之還原錯誤，堵住目錄符號連結與工作樹漏洞
title.en: Fix Code Rewind Errors Before Branch Creation, Closing Symlink and Worktree Exploits

body.zh-TW: 當你想使用 `/rewind` 還原程式碼時，版本切換的安全性與穩定度獲得顯著強化。若嘗試將專案回復至執行 `/branch` 建立分支之前的檢查點，過去容易出現未還原任何檔案的錯誤，現在已能精準還原。在路徑處理上，可能透過目錄符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）還原或刪除檔案的問題已修好。同時，也修復了建立 worktree（工作樹，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時可能逃逸出安全沙盒的漏洞。以前執行回溯可能卡在分支邊界，現在跨分支還原的問題已經修好。
body.en: When using `/rewind` to restore code, version switching is significantly safer and more reliable. If you attempt to restore project code to a checkpoint from before running `/branch`, the command previously failed with "No files were restored", but now restores accurately. In path handling, an issue where `/rewind` could restore or delete a file through a directory symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location) has been fixed. Additionally, a vulnerability where creating a worktree (a Git feature allowing parallel copies of the same project) could escape the security sandbox was closed. Where rewinding previously stumbled at branch boundaries, restoring across branches is now resolved.

items.original:
Fixed `/rewind` failing with "No files were restored" when restoring code to a checkpoint from before `/branch`
Fixed a case where `/rewind` could restore or delete a file through a directory symlink
Fixed a sandbox escape when creating a worktree

title.zh-TW: 斜線指令支援前導空白，模型名稱錯字主動推薦正確選項
title.en: Slash Commands Support Leading Whitespace, Recommending Correct Model Names on Typos

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入指令時，打字體驗顯得更加寬容流暢。若你在輸入斜線指令前不小心夾帶了空格、定位鍵（Tab）或換行符號，過去會被當成一般純文字直接送出給 Claude，現在會正確辨識為指令並直接執行。當手滑打錯模型名稱時（例如輸入 `opus-5-5`），不再誤導你更新工具版本，而是會主動推薦你可能想輸入的正確名稱。在切換模型的 `/model` 選單中，舊款模型已收進「More models」分組。在使用螢幕報讀機模式回答問題時，輸入「其他」選項可隨時按 `Ctrl+G` 開外部編輯器。而若執行 `/rename` 時無法將新名稱寫入工作階段的對話記錄，也會主動警告新名稱可能無法保留。
body.en: Typing in the terminal is now more forgiving and fluid. If you accidentally include a leading space, tab, or newline before a slash command, it was previously sent to Claude as plain text, but is now recognized and executed as a command. When you mistype a model name (such as `opus-5-5`), the CLI no longer misleads you to update versions, actively suggesting the model you meant instead. In the `/model` picker, older models are now grouped under a "More models" row. When answering questions in screen reader mode, typing an "Other" answer lets you press `Ctrl+G` at any time to open the external editor. Finally, if `/rename` cannot save a new name to the session transcript, it now warns that the new name may not last.

items.original:
Fixed slash commands typed after a leading space, tab or newline being sent to Claude as plain text instead of running
Fixed a mistyped model name, such as `opus-5-5`, telling you to update Claude Code instead of suggesting the model you meant
Fixed Ctrl+G not opening the external editor while typing an "Other" answer to a question in screen reader mode
Fixed `/rename` reporting plain success when the new name could not be saved to the session transcript; it now warns that the new name may not last
Improved the `/model` picker: older models are now grouped under a "More models" row instead of being listed after the current ones

title.zh-TW: 終端機超連結支援跨行完整開啟，路徑拒絕提示大小寫拼法
title.en: Terminal Hyperlinks Open Across Wrapped Lines, Path Refusals Hint at Letter Casing

body.zh-TW: 終端機介面的可讀性與互動細節在多種終端機環境中獲得改善。在 Ghostty 終端機搭配 tmux（終端機多工器），且從代理管理檢視開啟的工作階段中，`Cmd+click` 無法打開連結的問題已解決。當 `/status` 狀態檢視或自動模式計費通知中的說明連結因為視窗寬度而折行時，先前只會開啟前半截網址的臭蟲也已修正。在 macOS 與 Windows 平台上，若存取工作目錄外部路徑遭到拒絕，而該路徑僅與工作目錄內的路徑有字母大小寫的差異，拒絕訊息現在會具體指出該內部路徑的拼法。此外，`/stats`、`/model` 與 `/sandbox` 中的提示說明、次要文字以及拒絕動作訊息，淺灰色對比度皆已提高。⟦跟圖書館翻新導覽標示一樣，以前長網址換行就斷裂失效，燈光太暗還看不清書目說明；現在標牌加深字體顏色，指引細節也更加清晰。⟧
body.en: Terminal readability and interaction details have been improved across multiple terminal environments. In Ghostty over tmux (a terminal multiplexer), an issue where `Cmd+click` could not open links in sessions launched from the agents view is now resolved. When help links in `/status` or auto mode billing notices wrap due to window width, a bug that opened only the first part of the address has been fixed. On macOS and Windows, when access to a path outside the working directories is refused and differs only by letter case from an internal path, the refusal message explicitly names that spelling. Furthermore, the contrast of faint gray secondary text—including hints, details in `/stats`, `/model`, `/sandbox`, and rejected-action messages—has been increased. ⟦In the manner of a library updating its directory signs, long addresses previously broke across line wraps while dim lighting obscured catalog notes; now signs deepen text contrast and directional cues become noticeably clearer.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Cmd+click not opening links in Ghostty over tmux in sessions opened from the agents view
Fixed help links in `/status` and the auto mode billing notice opening only part of the address when they wrap
Improved the refusal for a path outside the working directories on macOS and Windows: when only its letter case differs from a path inside them, the message names that spelling
Improved the contrast of faint gray secondary text, such as hints, details in `/stats`, `/model` and `/sandbox`, and rejected-action messages

title.zh-TW: `/context` 摘要表格精簡化，按需載入工具收納節省文字額度
title.en: Context Summary Table Compacted, Grouping On-Demand Tools to Conserve Token Usage

body.zh-TW: 當你想檢查目前對話的內容配置時，輸入 `/context` 檢視上下文後的開銷明顯降低。過去在終端機執行該指令後，後續每一次對話都會將完整的視覺化網格資訊全部傳送給模型，白白佔用大量 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）。現在已修正為僅讀取純文字表格。同時，這份表格的長度也經過精簡最佳化，每個清單最多僅保留占用空間前 10 大的項目，而按需載入的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具在真正被呼叫之前，同一個伺服器底下的工具只會合併列在一列。⟦如同開會報告財務報表，以前每次發言都把全套百頁帳冊反覆投影給與會者，現在只保留前十大開銷摘要，零星項目則併入所屬部門統一呈現。⟧
body.en: When checking current conversation usage, running `/context` incurs noticeably lower overhead. Previously, running the command in the terminal sent the full visual grid to Claude on every later turn, consuming substantial tokens (units of text processed and billed by AI). Claude is now fixed to read only the plain-text table. This table is also compacted so each list keeps only its 10 largest rows. Meanwhile, on-demand MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol connecting AI to external tools) tools share one row per server until called. ⟦Resembling a financial audit meeting, presenters previously projected full hundred-page ledgers on every remark, but now summarize only the top ten expenses while grouping scattered items under their parent departments.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/context` sending its full visual grid to Claude on every later turn; Claude now reads only the table
Improved `/context` at the terminal so the table Claude reads stays short: each list keeps its 10 largest rows, and MCP tools that load on demand share one row per server until they're called

title.zh-TW: 網路檔案系統啟動掃描修復，完善檔案寫入與背景指令輸出捕捉
title.en: Fix Network File System Startup Scans, Refining File Writes and Background Command Output Capture

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 平台的網路檔案系統（包含 NFS、SMB 與 Lustre 等）開啟專案時，啟動時無端列出專案所有檔案的異常已經排除。檔案寫入工具在覆寫檔案時，若讀取原檔失敗，不再將該回合直接視為拒絕執行。在指令執行方面，瞬時執行完畢的背景 Bash 指令過去容易在標記完成時丟失輸出內容，以及指令結束前一刻寫入的檔案被變更比對遺漏的問題，皆已獲得修正。使用筆記本編輯工具時，若在權限詢問畫面停留期間筆記本內容發生更動，已修正修改到錯誤儲存格的狀況。此外，`claude purge` 與舊工作階段清理，都會重試未能完整刪除的資料夾，仍存在時回報錯誤。
body.en: When opening projects on Linux over network file systems (including NFS, SMB, and Lustre), an issue where startup scanned and listed every project file has been eliminated. The Write tool no longer ends the turn as a refusal when failing to read the original file to overwrite. For command execution, fixes resolve issues where background Bash commands that finish almost instantly lost output when marked completed, as well as diffs missing files written just before command completion. When using the notebook editor (`NotebookEdit`), a bug where modifying the wrong cell occurred if notebook contents changed during permission prompts has been fixed. Additionally, `claude purge` and old session cleanup now retry folders that could not be fully deleted, reporting an error if they still remain.

items.original:
Fixed a case where Claude Code listed every project file at start on Linux for projects on a network file system (NFS, SMB, Lustre and similar)
Fixed Write ending the turn as a refusal when it couldn't read the file to overwrite
Fixed background Bash commands that finish almost instantly losing their output while being reported as completed
Fixed the Bash tool's diff of changed files missing a file that the command wrote just before it ended
Fixed a case where `NotebookEdit` changed the wrong cell when the notebook changed while a permission prompt was open
Improved `claude purge` and the clean-up of old sessions to retry a folder that could not be fully deleted, and to report it as an error if it remains

title.zh-TW: 伺服器拒收回饋後不再跳出問卷，第三方閘道不再草擬回饋
title.en: Surveys and feedback prompts stop appearing after server refusal, and third-party gateways stop drafting feedback

body.zh-TW: 伺服器拒絕接收你所屬組織的意見回饋後，終端機以前仍會持續跳出滿意度問卷、Claude 草擬的回饋以及 `/feedback`，這個問題已經修好。此外，在第三方閘道上回饋送不出去，Claude 也不再草擬這類回饋。⟦就像大樓門禁已註記謝絕訪客調查，以前各辦公室仍會被塞入問卷單，現在一律在櫃檯全數阻絕，讓工作環境徹底回歸清靜。⟧
body.en: After the server refuses feedback for your organization, satisfaction surveys, Claude-drafted feedback, and `/feedback` will no longer keep popping up in the terminal. In addition, Claude no longer drafts feedback on third-party gateways where it cannot be sent. ⟦A building's security desk notes a clear policy against visitor surveys: while forms previously still reached individual offices, the front desk now blocks them all to restore complete quiet to the work environment.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Claude-drafted feedback, surveys and `/feedback` continuing to appear after the server refused feedback for your organization
Fixed Claude drafting feedback on third-party gateways, where it can't be sent

title.zh-TW: Agent SDK 強化錯誤回報與遙測，中斷後才完成的工具仍觸發掛鉤
title.en: Agent SDK enhances error reporting and telemetry, running hooks for tools finished after interruptions

body.zh-TW: 使用 Agent SDK 開發自動化應用時，除錯與監控變得更加精準。發送給客戶端的通知訊息不再發生文字丟失，且當主機磁碟已滿時，能直接收到具體的失敗原因，而非籠統的退出代碼。遙測指標也更為準確，預先啟動的處理程序不再預先計入工作階段計數，只有在真正被宣告採用時才計數一次。詳細 beta 追蹤現在會向要求用戶端憑證的收集器提供 `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT`。新訊息中斷回合後才完成的工具呼叫，仍會執行 PostToolUse 掛鉤（工具完成後觸發的小程式），最多給掛鉤 10 秒完成。若先前在計畫模式中斷執行，當切換至其他權限模式恢復時，環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` 不會再無端重新執行該回合。
body.en: Debugging and monitoring are now more precise when developing automated applications with the Agent SDK. Informational messages sent to clients no longer drop text, and when a host disk is full, you receive the specific failure reason instead of a generic exit code. Telemetry metrics are also more accurate, as pre-started processes are no longer counted early in session counts, counting only once when they are actually claimed. Detailed beta tracing now provides `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT` to collectors that require client certificates. Tool calls that finish after a new message interrupts a turn still run PostToolUse hooks (small programs triggered after a tool completes), giving the hook up to 10 seconds to finish. If an execution was previously interrupted in plan mode, the environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` will no longer rerun that turn without reason when resuming in another permission mode.

items.original:
Fixed a case where text was dropped from informational messages sent to SDK clients
Fixed a case where Agent SDK hosts got a generic exit-code error instead of a failed run's own error message when the disk was full
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that was interrupted in plan mode when the session resumes in another permission mode
Fixed detailed beta tracing not presenting `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT` to collectors that require a client certificate
Fixed the OpenTelemetry `claude_code.session.count` metric counting Agent SDK `prewarm()` processes that were never claimed; a pre-started process now counts once, when it is claimed
Changed PostToolUse hooks to run, with up to 10 seconds to finish, on tool calls that finish after a new message interrupts the turn

title.zh-TW: 外掛更新自動安裝新相依套件，目錄獲信任後才登記外掛市集
title.en: Plugin updates automatically install new dependencies, and directories register marketplaces only after trust

body.zh-TW: 當你安裝的外掛發布新版本時，無論是背景自動升級、手動輸入 `claude plugin update`，或在 `/plugin` 選「Update now」，都會安裝新版新增的相依套件。透過 `--add-dir` 引入的目錄，要先接受它自己的信任對話框，才會登記外掛市集。外掛所提供的子代理狀態列指令現在能正確展開環境變數 `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`，方便直接參照外掛本身的腳本。而在執行外掛評估時，針對禁止呼叫的工具，不再建議永遠無法通過的 `max: 0`。
body.en: When an installed plugin releases a new version, newly added dependencies are installed whether through background auto-updates, manually entering `claude plugin update`, or choosing "Update now" in `/plugin`. Directories introduced via `--add-dir` register plugin marketplaces only after their own trust dialog has been accepted. A plugin-provided subagentStatusLine command now properly expands the environment variable `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`, making it convenient to reference the plugin's own scripts directly. When running plugin evaluations, warnings no longer suggest `max: 0` for tools that must not be called, which could never pass.

items.original:
Fixed `claude plugin eval` warnings suggesting `max: 0` for a tool that must not be called, which could never pass
Fixed background plugin auto-update not installing a dependency added by the updated plugin version
Fixed `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` not being substituted in a plugin-provided `subagentStatusLine` command, which can now reference the plugin's own scripts
Fixed `claude plugin update` and `/plugin` "Update now" not installing dependencies added by the new plugin version
Changed `--add-dir` directories to register plugin marketplaces only once that directory's own trust dialog has been accepted

title.zh-TW: mod 熱重載修正檔案監聽，沙盒模式限制巢狀目錄載入
title.en: Mod hot reloading fixes file watching, while sandbox mode restricts nested directory loading

body.zh-TW: 開發與除錯 mod（自訂模組）時，檔案剛出現就刪除、之後又放回，原本可能讓熱重載漏看。熱重載是不用重啟就套用變更的機制；在 `.claude/skills` 中，這兩種檔案變動現在都不再漏判。在雲端工作階段中，若連續發送三則訊息而未回答模組提問，也不會再導致該工作階段的 mod 熱重載意外關閉。另外，在啟用 Bash 沙盒的環境下，位於啟動目錄下層的技能資料夾不再預設自動載入，你必須在該子目錄啟動工具或透過 `/cd` 指令切換至該處才會載入。
body.en: When developing and debugging mods (custom modules), hot reload previously could miss a file that was deleted right after appearing as well as its return. Hot reload is the mechanism that applies changes without restarting; in `.claude/skills`, neither of these file changes is missed now. In cloud sessions, typing three consecutive messages instead of answering a module's question will no longer cause mod hot reload to turn off unexpectedly for that session. In addition, with the Bash sandbox enabled, skill folders below the starting folder no longer load automatically by default, requiring you to start the tool in that subdirectory or switch there using `/cd` to load them.

items.original:
Fixed a mod's hot reload in `.claude/skills` missing a file that was deleted just after it appeared, and missing its return
Fixed mod hot-reloading turning off for the session when you typed three messages instead of answering its question in a cloud session
Changed nested skill loading: with the Bash sandbox on, skills in `.claude/skills` folders below the starting folder load only if you start Claude Code there or `/cd` there

title.zh-TW: Artifact 資料庫寫入新增標記保護，網頁抓取提示貼上分享對話
title.en: Artifact database writes gain marker protection, while web fetching prompts pasting shared chats

body.zh-TW: 使用 Artifact 資料庫功能時，多項操作提示與檔案保護機制獲得改善。當讀取資料庫並以 `out_dir` 指定儲存至目標資料夾時，先前遭到拒絕的問題已修復；更新不存在的文件，或服務暫停反覆遭拒的寫入時，錯誤訊息能更具體指引處理方向。針對可能被其他人寫入的資料列，存檔時會建立隱藏標記檔案，若既有檔案缺少該標記（包含舊版匯出的檔案），會予以保留並主動回報。未配備資料庫的 Artifact 也不再徒勞重試資料庫呼叫，並會明確提示重新發布是否有所助益。此外，當使用網頁讀取工具抓取 claude.ai 的分享對話連結時，不再誤報為空白頁面，而是會清楚告知無法讀取並建議直接將對話內容貼至輸入框。
body.en: Multiple operational hints and file protection mechanisms have been improved when using the Artifact database feature. A previously refused issue when reading the database and saving to a destination folder using `out_dir` has been resolved; error messages now provide more specific guidance when updates target nonexistent documents or when the service pauses repeated refused writes. When saving rows that others may have written, a hidden marker file is created, and existing files lacking this marker (including exports from earlier versions) are left alone and reported. Artifacts without a database no longer futilely retry database calls and clearly indicate whether republishing helps. In addition, fetching claude.ai shared chat links with the web-fetching tool no longer misreports them as empty pages, but clearly states they cannot be read and suggests pasting the conversation directly into the input box.

items.original:
Fixed WebFetch describing claude.ai shared-chat links as empty pages; it now says shared chats can't be read and to paste the conversation instead
Fixed Artifact database calls being re-sent to artifacts without a database; errors now say whether republishing helps
Fixed a case where artifact database reads that save to a folder (`out_dir`) were refused
Improved the artifact database error when an update targets a document that does not exist, and when the service pauses repeated refused writes
Changed artifact database saves of rows others may have written: each file gets a hidden marker file, and existing files without one, earlier versions' exports among them, are left alone and reported

title.zh-TW: 代理管理介面保留未送出草稿，修復背景對話回覆與預覽格式
title.en: Agent management view preserves unsent drafts, fixing background session replies and preview formatting

body.zh-TW: 在終端機的多代理管理檢視中，切換與操作不同工作階段的體驗獲得改善。當背景工作階段正停留在權限詢問提示時，在管理檢視發送回覆不再誤以為已經送出；你的輸入內容會保留在文字框中，並主動提示你切換進入該工作階段進行回覆。多個管理檢視視窗在同目錄執行時，其中一個視窗離開或因更新而重啟時，不會再誤刪或載入其他視窗儲存的草稿文字。在指令預覽方面，過長的指令、執行結果與狀態列（statusLine，顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）在截斷時會加上省略號，等待核可指令中的粗體、反引號與標籤格式也獲得完整保留。上述回覆、草稿與預覽問題已修好。
body.en: In the terminal's multi-agent management view, the experience of switching and operating across different sessions has been improved. When a background session is waiting at a permission prompt, sending a reply in the management view no longer appears as if it was sent; your input stays in the text box with a prompt to open that session and reply. When multiple management views run in the same directory, one view exiting or restarting for an update will no longer mistakenly delete or load draft text saved by another view. For command previews, long commands, results, and status lines (bars displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) now include an ellipsis when truncated, while bold text, backticks, and tags are fully preserved in commands waiting for approval. These reply, draft, and preview issues have been resolved.

items.original:
Fixed the agents view appearing to send a reply to a background session waiting on a permission prompt; the reply now stays in the box with a hint to open the session and answer
Fixed agent view removing a draft saved by another agent view in the same directory when exiting
Fixed a case where agent view came back with another agent view's input text after restarting itself for an update
Fixed the agents view preview cutting off long commands, results and status lines without an ellipsis, and dropping `**`, backticks and tags from commands waiting for approval

title.zh-TW: Chrome 擴充功能連線中斷自動檢查，JavaScript 工具結果留存對話
title.en: Chrome extension auto-checks interrupted connections, retaining JavaScript tool results in conversation

body.zh-TW: 使用 Claude in Chrome 瀏覽器外掛時，中斷復原與網頁操作流程獲得改善。若在操作過程中發生連線中斷，工具不再武斷判定為未連線，而是在重試可能已執行的動作前主動檢查網頁現況，並在短暫斷線後最多等待 6 秒讓該工作階段原本的瀏覽器恢復，之後才會選擇另一個瀏覽器。執行 JavaScript 工具 `javascript_tool` 的回傳內容長度放寬至 60,000 個字元以內，都會直接留存在當前對話中，不再強制存入外部檔案。此外，內建工具移除了 `shortcuts_list` 與 `shortcuts_execute`，兩者原本可列出與執行擴充功能中儲存的捷徑。⟦恰似網購付款時遇上網路瞬斷，系統重新連線後先核對交易紀錄而非重複扣款，短暫等候原連線恢復，交易明細也直接顯示在螢幕無需另開收據。⟧
body.en: Interruption recovery and web workflows have been improved when using the Claude in Chrome browser extension. If a connection drops mid-action, the tool no longer arbitrarily reports the extension as disconnected; instead, it checks the current page state before repeating an action that may have already executed, and waits up to 6 seconds after a brief disconnect for the session's original browser to return before selecting another. Returned content from the JavaScript tool `javascript_tool` of up to 60,000 characters now stays directly in the current conversation instead of being forced into an external file. In addition, built-in tools no longer include `shortcuts_list` and `shortcuts_execute`, which previously listed and launched shortcuts saved in the extension. ⟦An online shopper encounters a sudden connection drop during payment: upon reconnecting, the system first verifies transaction records rather than charging twice, waits briefly for the initial connection to recover, and displays details right on screen without needing a separate receipt.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Claude in Chrome reporting the extension as not connected when the connection dropped mid-action; Claude now checks the page before repeating an action that may have run
Improved Claude in Chrome after a brief disconnect: it waits up to 6 seconds for the session's own browser to return before picking another
Improved Claude in Chrome: `javascript_tool` results of up to 60,000 characters now stay in the conversation instead of being saved to a file
Removed `shortcuts_list` and `shortcuts_execute`, which listed and started shortcuts saved in the extension, from Claude Code's built-in Claude in Chrome tools

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制初次啟動互動判斷，無換行管線支援與額度解除同步
title.en: Remote control handles first-run prompts, accepts piped y without a trailing newline, and syncs externally lifted usage limits

body.zh-TW: 透過終端機執行 `claude remote-control` 進行遠端連線時，腳本與自動化整合的錯誤處理獲得補強。在初次啟動遇到提問卻未獲得回應時（例如在背景服務、批次作業或按下中斷鍵中執行），工具不再靜默退出且傳回代表成功的 0，而是會清楚說明原因並回傳錯誤代碼 1；若透過管線輸入未附帶換行符號的字母 y，現在也能正確視為同意確認。在跨裝置體驗上，當用量限制在外部解除後，其他裝置上的遠端工作階段不再持續卡在「達到限制」狀態；Claude 傳送單一檔案時，iOS App 偶爾缺少檔案卡片的問題已修好。此外，修復了透過環境變數導向閘道啟動的閒置背景工作階段，在更新後意外脫離閘道連線的狀況。
body.en: Error handling for scripts and automation integrations has been reinforced when connecting remotely with `claude remote-control`. When a first-run question receives no response (such as when running in background services, batch jobs, or pressing Ctrl+C), the tool no longer silently exits with status 0 representing success, but explains why and exits with status 1. Passing a piped letter y without a trailing newline is now also correctly treated as confirmation. Across devices, when a usage limit is lifted externally, remote sessions on other devices no longer stay stuck on "Limit reached". An issue where the Claude iOS app occasionally missed the file card when Claude sent a single file has also been fixed. Additionally, idle background sessions started through environment-variable gateway routing no longer disconnect from the gateway unexpectedly after an update.

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control sessions still showing "Limit reached" on other devices after a usage limit was lifted outside the session
Fixed the file card sometimes missing in the Claude iOS app when Claude sent a single file
Fixed a case where idle background sessions started through a shell-exported LLM gateway left the gateway after an update
Fixed `claude remote-control` exiting silently with status 0 when a first-run question gets no answer (scripts, services, batch jobs, Ctrl+C); it now says why and exits 1
Fixed `claude remote-control` ignoring a piped `y` that has no newline after it at the first-run question; it now counts as a yes

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器工作區隔離命名，非信任環境停用掛鉤與提早自檢
title.en: Self-hosted runner isolates workspace naming, disables untrusted hooks, and exits early on failed self-checks

body.zh-TW: 在企業自託管環境中維護執行器時，安全隔離與多專案處理機制獲得加強。當指定 `--trust-workspace false` 時，除原有防護外，現在也會一併阻擋儲存庫設定檔與技能中的掛鉤程式執行。以 `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` 或 `--configure-git` 啟動的執行器，若啟動自檢失敗，現在會先退出，不再先向伺服器註冊。若伺服器持續拒絕展延模型存取權限，執行器會加快重試頻率並在工作階段張貼警告。設定 `CLAUDE_RUNNER_CHECKOUT_PATH` 時，同一個工作階段中的每個儲存庫都會獲得專屬資料夾，重名目錄會自動以數字尾碼區隔。此外，工作階段結束後不再上傳除錯日誌；失敗工作階段的日誌會留在執行器主機，除非設定 `--remove-session-state`。
body.en: Security isolation and multi-project handling mechanisms have been strengthened when maintaining runners in enterprise self-hosted environments. Specifying `--trust-workspace false` now also prevents hooks in repository configuration files and skills from running, in addition to existing protections. Runners started with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` or `--configure-git` will now exit first if a startup self-check fails, rather than registering with the server beforehand. If the server repeatedly refuses to renew model access, the runner retries sooner and posts a warning in the session. When `CLAUDE_RUNNER_CHECKOUT_PATH` is configured, each repository within the same session receives its own dedicated folder, with duplicate folder names automatically separated by numeric suffixes. Furthermore, debug logs are no longer uploaded after a session ends; logs from failed sessions remain on the runner host unless `--remove-session-state` is set.

items.original:
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions failing with no explanation when the server keeps refusing to renew model access: the runner now retries sooner and posts a warning in the session
Fixed self-hosted runners: `--trust-workspace false` now also stops hooks in the repository's settings files and skills from running
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a runner started with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` or `--configure-git` registering before a failed startup check made it exit; it now exits first
Self-hosted runner: Changed `CLAUDE_RUNNER_CHECKOUT_PATH` so that each repository in a session gets its own folder: a folder name already taken in the session gets `-2`, `-3`, … at the end
Self-hosted runner: Removed the end-of-session upload of a session's debug log; a failed session's log stays on the runner host unless `--remove-session-state` is set

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段節點轉移維持權限原則，背景代理在等待發送時持續運行
title.en: Cloud sessions preserve permission rules across node migrations, keeping background agents running during pending sends

body.zh-TW: 在雲端執行工作階段時，容器調度與權限規則的銜接防護獲得提升。當工作階段搬移至新的工作節點時，修復了遺失工作階段特定拒絕與詢問規則的缺失；若這類拒絕與詢問規則無法全部保留，就會捨棄工作階段的允許規則，所以你可能會再被詢問一次。輸入 `/permissions` 不再只回報無法使用，而是會清楚指引規則存放位置與修改方式。在等待訊息清單中點擊立即送出時，正在背景運行的代理不再被強制終止。排程任務遇到名為 memory 的連接器時，現在會自動加上短後綴完成掛載予以保留。此外，自託管環境停滯警告的連結現在會優先選取並具名指出組織預設或具有運作中執行器的環境。
body.en: Container scheduling and permission rule transitions receive stronger safeguards when running sessions in the cloud. An issue that caused session-specific deny and ask rules to be lost when a session moved to a new worker node has been fixed. If such deny and ask rules cannot all be preserved, the session's allow rules are dropped, meaning you may be asked again. Entering `/permissions` no longer merely reports that it is unavailable, but clearly indicates where rules reside and how to modify them. Clicking Send now on a waiting message no longer terminates agents running in the background. Scheduled tasks encountering a connector named memory now automatically attach a short suffix to complete mounting and retain it. Additionally, links in stalled-setup warnings for self-hosted environments now prefer and explicitly name your organization's default environment or one with an active runner.

items.original:
Fixed `/permissions` in cloud sessions replying only that it isn't available; it now says where the session's rules live and how to change them
Fixed cloud sessions losing session-scoped deny and ask permission rules, such as those a PermissionRequest hook adds, when the session moves to a new worker
Changed cloud sessions to drop session-scoped allow rules at a move to a new worker when their deny and ask rules can't all be kept, so you may be asked again
[Cloud sessions] Fixed scheduled tasks silently dropping a connector named memory: runs now keep it, mounted under that name plus a short suffix
[Cloud sessions] Fixed Send now on a waiting message in cloud sessions ending running background agents; they now keep running
[Cloud sessions] Improved the stalled-setup warning on self-hosted environments: its link now prefers your organization's default or an environment with a live runner, and names it

title.zh-TW: 清除畫面保留運作中背景任務，同步網頁任務清單與斜線選單
title.en: Clearing the screen preserves running background tasks, syncing the web task list and slash menu

body.zh-TW: 當你想在終端機整理視野時，輸入 `/clear` 清除對話畫面不再誤殺正在運作的任務。背景代理、協作隊友、持續運行的工作流程，以及背景代理與協作隊友所屬的前景子代理，其正在執行的指令都會安全保留。在網頁端介面上，背景任務於 `/clear` 後從清單消失、直到另一項任務開始或結束才恢復的問題已修好。在行動版與網頁版的雲端工作階段中，原本不應公開的隱藏指令不再錯誤出現在斜線選單裡。此外，在無法直接顯示方案限額的雲端工作階段中輸入 `/usage`，現在會主動提供前往網站設定頁面檢視用量的超連結。⟦好比擦拭辦公室白板時只抹除過期筆記，後方工廠正在運轉的生產線與儀表監控依然持續作業，看板清單也與各部門同步維持連線。⟧
body.en: When you want to tidy your view in the terminal, entering `/clear` to clear the conversation screen no longer accidentally kills running tasks. Running commands are safely preserved for background agents, teammates, workflows that keep running, and foreground subagents belonging to background agents and teammates. On the web interface, the issue where background tasks disappeared from the list after `/clear` until another task started or ended has been fixed. In cloud sessions on mobile and web, hidden commands that should not be public no longer mistakenly appear in the slash command menu. In addition, typing `/usage` in cloud sessions where plan limits cannot be directly displayed now proactively provides a hyperlink to the website settings page to view usage. ⟦Just as erasing an office whiteboard only wipes away outdated notes, the production lines and gauge monitors running in the factory behind it continue operating, and the board list stays connected and in sync across departments.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/clear` killing running commands of background agents, teammates and workflows that keep running, and foreground subagents of background agents and teammates
Fixed background tasks that keep running after `/clear` disappearing from the task list in Claude Code on the web until another task started or ended
Fixed hidden commands appearing in the slash command menu of cloud sessions on mobile and web
Improved `/usage` in cloud sessions: it now links to Settings → Usage on claude.ai in a case where plan limits can't be shown

title.zh-TW: 解除 GitHub 組織連結會關閉「所有儲存庫」審查設定
title.en: Unlinking a GitHub organization turns off the "All repositories" review setting

body.zh-TW: 針對企業方案的管理者後台，權限保護與設定介面獲得多項強化。在程式碼審查服務中解除與 GitHub 組織的連結時，該組織底下的「所有儲存庫」審查設定會同步關閉，重新連結後也會維持關閉狀態，直到管理者手動開啟為止。在已連接 Claude Tag 的企業後台模型管理頁面中，新增了專屬列位並提供直達預設模型管理處的連結。進行 Claude Tag 初始化設定時，若無法完整載入頻道清單，管理員現在無須選取特定頻道即可直接啟動。此外，在儲存自動模式允許規則時加入了並行衝突防護，若偵測到其他管理員在此期間修改了設定，系統會拒絕儲存並跳出提示，避免設定遭到無聲覆蓋。
body.en: For enterprise plan admin backends, permission protections and settings interfaces have received multiple enhancements. When unlinking a GitHub organization in the code review service, the "All repositories" review setting under that organization turns off automatically, and it stays off after relinking until an admin manually turns it back on. On the Models admin page for enterprise backends with Claude Tag connected, a dedicated row has been added with a link pointing directly to where its model defaults are managed. During Claude Tag setup, if the channel list cannot fully load, admins can now launch directly without picking a specific channel. In addition, concurrency conflict protection has been added when saving auto mode allow rules. If the system detects that another admin modified settings in the meantime, the save is refused with a notice, preventing settings from being overwritten silently.

items.original:
[Code Review] Changed unlinking a GitHub organization to also turn off its All repositories setting in Code Review; it stays off after you relink until you turn it back on
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag setup blocking launch when the channel list couldn't fully load; admins can now launch without picking a channel
[Claude Tag] Added a Claude Tag row to the Models admin page for Enterprise orgs with Claude Tag connected, linking to where its model defaults are managed
[Claude Tag] Fixed saving auto mode allow rules in Claude Tag admin settings overwriting another admin's changes; the save is now refused with a message

title.zh-TW: VSCode 擴充套件輸入框長提示詞保護，修復聽寫與聊天面板效能
title.en: VSCode extension protects long prompts in the input box and improves dictation and chat panel performance

body.zh-TW: 在 Visual Studio Code 編輯器中使用 Claude 擴充套件時，聊天面板的互動效能獲得全方位改善。當輸入超過 50,000 個字元的超長提示詞時，內容不再遭到無聲截斷，而是會保留在對話框並給出提示，貼上超量文字時也會明確拒絕。點擊問卷或回報問題按鈕時，不再意外將未完成的草稿送出。執行聽寫指令 `claude-vscode.toggleDictation` 只會作用於目前使用的 Claude 檢視，再次按下即可關閉。拖曳路徑含有非常長的連續 `/` 的檔案時不再導致面板凍結，且回覆串流含大量未閉合、每個都比前一個短的 `$$` 數學區塊時也不再卡頓。此外，大型工作區的診斷工具現在會自動略過無問題檔案，支援指定嚴重程度門檻並回傳精簡 JSON 格式。
body.en: When using the Claude extension in the Visual Studio Code editor, interactive performance in the chat panel has received comprehensive improvements. When entering extra-long prompts exceeding 50,000 characters, the content is no longer cut off silently. Instead, it stays in the chat box with a notice, and pasting text over the limit is explicitly refused. Clicking the survey or "Report a problem" buttons no longer accidentally sends an unfinished draft. Running the dictation command `claude-vscode.toggleDictation` acts only on the currently used Claude view, and pressing it again stops it. Dragging a file whose path contains a very long run of consecutive `/` characters no longer freezes the panel, nor does the panel stutter while a reply streams in with many unclosed `$$` math blocks that are each shorter than the last. Furthermore, the diagnostics tool for large workspaces now automatically skips files with no problems, supports specifying a severity threshold, and returns compact JSON format.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed prompts over 50,000 characters being cut off silently: the prompt now stays in the chat box with a notice, and a paste over the limit is refused with a notice
[VSCode] Fixed a click on the survey or "Report a problem" buttons sending the unfinished prompt
[VSCode] Fixed a possible chat panel freeze when a dropped item's path contains a very long run of "/" characters
[VSCode] Fixed the `claude-vscode.toggleDictation` command starting dictation in every open Claude view at once; it now acts only in the view you are using, and a second press stops it
[VSCode] Fixed the chat panel slowing down while a reply with many unclosed `$$` math fences, each shorter than the last, streams in
[VSCode] Improved the chat panel's diagnostics tool for large workspaces: it leaves out files with no problems, returns compact JSON, and accepts an optional minimum severity

title.zh-TW: VSCode 擴充套件視窗重新載入計畫保護，完善工作階段與市集管理
title.en: VSCode extension protects plans on window reload, refining session and marketplace management

body.zh-TW: 在 Visual Studio Code 中重新載入視窗時，Claude 不再擅自執行未經批准的計畫。若先前在計畫模式中途打斷步驟，當工作階段在其他權限模式恢復時，執行會立刻停止並跳出提醒。從擴充套件的網頁分頁開啟雲端工作階段時，透過 `/clear`，或對已輸入的提示詞使用 Retry、Edit（重試、編輯）所移除的對話回合不再離奇重現；已刪除的工作階段重新命名時，檔案也不會再度復活。移除外掛市集時，確認畫面會即時清查該市集當前已安裝的外掛。在閘道環境下遇到未登入狀態時，提示訊息會以醒目的錯誤樣式呈現並附上登入連結。此外，回覆中指向 Claude 登入、連接器或 API 位址的連結，改以文字顯示該位址，不再於瀏覽器中開啟。
body.en: When reloading a window in Visual Studio Code, Claude no longer carries out unapproved plans without authorization. If a step was previously interrupted in plan mode, execution stops immediately with a notice when the session resumes in another permission mode. When opening cloud sessions from the extension's Web tab, conversation turns removed by `/clear`, or by Retry or Edit of an entered prompt, no longer bizarrely reappear. In addition, renaming a deleted session will not cause its file to come back. When removing a plugin marketplace, the confirmation screen now checks which of that marketplace's plugins are currently installed. When encountering an unauthenticated state behind a gateway, the prompt message appears in a prominent error style with a sign-in link. In addition, links in replies pointing to Claude sign-in, connector, or API addresses are now displayed as text showing the address instead of opening in a browser.

items.original:
[VSCode] Improved the confirmation for removing a plugin marketplace: it now checks which of its plugins are installed at that moment
[VSCode] Fixed cloud sessions opened from the extension's Web tab bringing back turns that `/clear`, or Retry or Edit of a typed prompt, had removed
[VSCode] Fixed a deleted session's file coming back when that session was renamed in the extension
[VSCode] Fixed Claude carrying out an unapproved plan after a window reload: a step interrupted in plan mode now stops with a notice when the session comes back in another permission mode
[VSCode] Improved the "not signed in" message behind a Claude apps gateway: it now looks like an error and has a Sign in link
[VSCode] Changed links in Claude's replies that point at Claude sign-in, connector or API addresses to show as text with the address, instead of opening in the browser

title.zh-TW: Vertex AI 工具更新預設改為增量傳送
title.en: Vertex AI tool updates are now sent incrementally by default

body.zh-TW:
當你在 Google Cloud 透過 Vertex AI 讓 Codex 串接工具作業時，現在只會同步有變動的部分，不必每次重新傳遞整份清單。⟦就像辦公室登記下午茶訂單，以前有人加點，就得把整張菜單重抄一遍；現在只要回報新增的品項，而且還可以設定關掉，換回原本的做法。⟧如果不想用增量傳送，就打開設定檔 `config.toml`，在 `[features]` 區塊下加入這一行：

```toml
[features]
incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false
```

如果不想用增量傳送，在 `config.toml` 的 `[features]` 下加入 `incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false` 即可關閉。
body.en:
When you connect Codex with tools through Vertex AI on Google Cloud, it now synchronizes only the parts that changed instead of resending the entire list each time. ⟦Picture taking afternoon tea orders in an office: previously, whenever someone added an item, you had to recopy the entire menu; now you only report the newly added items, and you can also configure it off to revert to the original method.⟧ If you do not want to use incremental sending, open the configuration file `config.toml` and add this line under the `[features]` section:

```toml
[features]
incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false
```

If you do not want to use incremental sending, you can turn it off by adding `incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false` under `[features]` in `config.toml`.

items.original: Codex now sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI. To opt out, set `incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false` under `[features]` in `config.toml`. ([#60617](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/60617), [#60848](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/60848))

title.zh-TW: 代理人指揮中心標記未讀結果，切換後端工作階段保留草稿
title.en: Agent command center marks unread results, and switching backend sessions preserves drafts

body.zh-TW: 平時如果習慣讓多個助理分頭調查專案，終端機現在能讓你清楚掌握每位幫手的最新進度。執行 `codex agents --no-daemon` 就能打開代理人指揮中心，指揮中心與終端機工作階段（session，正在進行中的對話作業）選取器現在都會主動標記出未讀的執行結果。⟦猶如總機櫃台的分機信箱，信件送達時格子會亮起提示燈，即使轉身前往另一張辦公桌交涉，手中寫到一半的便箋也不會遺失。⟧當你在工作階段選取器中切換不同的已連線後端時，輸入框中還沒送出的草稿會完整保留下來，不會因為更換後端就遭到清空。
body.en: If you regularly have several assistants investigate different parts of a project, the terminal now makes it easier to keep track of each helper’s latest progress. Run `codex agents --no-daemon` to open the agent command center. Both the command center and the terminal session picker (for ongoing conversations) now mark unread results. ⟦Like extension mailboxes at a switchboard desk, a compartment lights up when mail arrives, and even if you turn to another desk to discuss something, the note you are halfway through writing stays with you.⟧ When you switch between connected backends in the session picker, any unsent draft in the input box stays intact instead of being cleared.

items.original:
Open the agent command center with `codex agents --no-daemon`. The command center and session picker now mark unread results (#58238, #58239, #58263, #58264).
Switch between connected backends from the terminal session picker and keep your drafts when switching (#58280, #58457).

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入框即時預覽附加圖片，逐字稿路徑支援點擊開啟
title.en: Preview attached images in the terminal input box and click transcript paths to open them

body.zh-TW: 在終端機請模型排查版面外觀或分析架構圖時，最怕挑錯要送出的圖檔。現在只要使用支援的終端機，在輸入框撰寫內容時就能直接預覽附加的本機圖片。⟦彷彿在公文夾附上拍立得縮圖，夾上檔案的當下就能先瞄一眼畫面確認無誤，事後查閱歸檔清單時也能隨手按壓標籤快速調閱原圖。⟧而在對話逐字稿（transcript，記錄完整互動內容的文字檔）中，顯示的本機圖片路徑現在也支援點擊，輕點路徑就能直接開啟剛剛檢視過的圖片。
body.en: When asking a model in the terminal to troubleshoot a layout or analyze an architecture diagram, choosing the wrong image to send is a particular concern. On supported terminals, you can now preview attached local images directly while composing in the input box. ⟦Picture attaching a Polaroid thumbnail to a document folder: you can glance at the image as soon as you attach the file to check that it is right, then press its label while reviewing the archive list later to quickly retrieve the original image.⟧ Local image paths shown in the conversation transcript (a text file recording the full interaction) are now clickable too. Click a path to open the image you just viewed.

items.original: Preview local image attachments while composing on supported terminals, and open viewed local images from clickable transcript paths (#58261, #58446).

title.zh-TW: 登入選單支援 Vertex AI 設定精靈，切換模型提供者仍可查閱舊紀錄
title.en: Sign-in menu supports a Vertex AI setup wizard, and old chats remain accessible after switching providers

body.zh-TW: 需要連線到不同雲端平台調用模型時，設定登入與管理既有紀錄往往讓人傷腦筋。在「以其他方式登入（Sign in another way）」選單中，可以找到 API 金鑰與雲端提供者選項。只要啟用 `gcp_setup_wizard` 設定項，就能透過引導精靈以應用程式預設憑證（ADC，Google Cloud 用來自動驗證身分的機制）或憑證檔，串接 Google Cloud Vertex AI。⟦如同聘請不同事務所的顧問，櫃台提供制式表單幫你快速登記授權，而先前與上一家顧問往來的會議備忘錄依舊留在手邊，就算無法直接續約也能抄錄結論另開新專案。⟧切換模型提供者後，先前儲存的聊天紀錄依然會留在清單中。如果舊對話無法直接繼續執行，你也可以隨時閱讀歷史逐字稿，並把重點整理成可編輯的提示詞，在全新聊天中直接接續工作。
body.en: When connecting to different cloud platforms to use models, setting up sign-in and managing existing records can be a headache. You can find API key and cloud provider options under the “Sign in another way” menu. Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to connect to Google Cloud Vertex AI through a guided wizard using Application Default Credentials (Google Cloud’s mechanism for automatically authenticating your identity) or a credential file. ⟦Think of hiring consultants from different firms: the front desk supplies standard forms to quickly register your authorization, while meeting notes from your previous consultants remain at hand, so even if you cannot renew the engagement directly, you can copy the conclusions into a new project.⟧ After you switch model providers, previously saved chats remain in the list. If an old conversation cannot resume directly, you can still read its historical transcript and turn the key points into an editable prompt to continue working in a new chat.

items.original:
Find API key and cloud provider options under “Sign in another way.” Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to set up Google Cloud Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials or a credential file (#57857, #58427).
Saved chats stay visible after you switch model providers. If a chat can’t resume, you can read its transcript and prepare an editable prompt to continue in a new chat (#58202).

title.zh-TW: 審批提示下可展開修補細節，清螢幕保留紀錄且退格不跳指令模式
title.en: Expand patch details during approval, clear the screen while keeping history, and backspace without entering command mode

body.zh-TW:
在終端機審查程式碼修改並輸入回應時，細節檢視與打字體驗迎來了一批順手改進。

跳出審批提示（approval prompt）時，你現在能直接在對話逐字稿中展開修補程式細節。

在終端機整理畫面時，按下 `Ctrl+L` 會清空螢幕顯示內容，先前的對話訊息依然隨時能透過 `Ctrl+T` 叫出查閱。

在輸入框退格刪除文字時，就算露出開頭的驚嘆號 `!`，草稿依然會維持一般對話模式，不再被誤觸成執行外部指令的模式。
body.en:
Reviewing code changes and typing responses in the terminal now comes with several improvements to detail viewing and typing.

While an approval prompt is open, you can now expand patch details directly in the conversation transcript.

When tidying up the terminal view, pressing `Ctrl+L` clears the screen display. Earlier conversation messages remain available through `Ctrl+T` whenever you want to review them.

When backspacing in the input box exposes a leading exclamation mark `!`, the draft stays in ordinary chat mode instead of accidentally switching to the mode for running external commands.

items.original:
Expand patch details directly in the transcript while an approval prompt is open (#58281).
`Ctrl+L` clears the terminal display while keeping earlier messages available through `Ctrl+T` (#58266).
Deleting text that exposes a leading `!` keeps an ordinary draft in chat mode (#58412).

title.zh-TW: 支援系統網路代理設定，網路請求逐一排隊審批並明定權限規範
title.en: System proxy settings supported, network approvals queued individually, and permission rules documented

body.zh-TW:
在需要透過特定通道連線或對外部請求有嚴密資安管制的環境中，網路連線行為現在更容易掌握。

現在輸入 `/experimental` 就能選擇加入 macOS 或 Windows 的系統代理伺服器（proxy，協助轉發網路封包的中繼伺服器）設定，讓工具連線直接遵循作業系統的網路轉發規則。

遇到需要手動核准的網路連線時，網路審批提示會在請求結束時自動關閉。多個連往同一個端點的並行請求也不會再同時跳出干擾，而是依序逐一跳出提示讓你確認。

應用程式伺服器（app-server）的說明文件中，也正式補齊了設定檔 `[permissions.network]` 底下的受控網路限制說明，並明列了哪些 `prompt-user` 指令規則必須取得最新的人工審批才能放行。
body.en:
In environments that require connections through specific channels or tightly control external requests for security, network connection behavior is now easier to keep track of.

Enter `/experimental` to opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings (relay servers that help forward network packets), so tool connections directly follow the operating system’s network forwarding rules.

For network connections that require manual approval, the network approval prompt now closes automatically when the request ends. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint no longer interrupt you with simultaneous prompts. Instead, prompts appear one at a time for you to confirm.

The app-server (application server) documentation now also covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` in the configuration file and explicitly lists which `prompt-user` command rules require fresh human approval before they can proceed.

items.original:
Opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings from `/experimental` (#58157).
Network approval prompts close when their requests end. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint prompt one at a time (#58350, #58351).
The app-server README covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` and `prompt-user` command rules that require fresh human approval (#58045, #58182).

title.zh-TW: Realtime V3 語音自動存入對話歷史，上下文壓縮納入失敗回應產出
title.en: Realtime V3 speech saves automatically to chat history, and context compaction counts output from failed responses

body.zh-TW: 當你進行長時間的即時對話或複雜的多輪問答時，對話內容的完整記錄與記憶管理至關重要。在長期的 Realtime V3 即時語音對話中，隨著逐字稿長度增長，工具會即時將已結束的語音內容保存至聊天歷史記錄中。⟦好比速記員一邊開會一邊將說完的發言謄進議事錄，管帳人員在打包過長卷宗時，也會把印壞的草稿和漏蓋計費章的廢頁通通算入紙張重量。⟧在對話長度過長觸發自動上下文壓縮時，計算機制現在也會如實算入執行失敗回應留下的輸出，以及缺少 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量數據的回應。
body.en: When you have long real-time conversations or complex exchanges with multiple rounds of questions and answers, complete conversation records and memory management are essential. During long Realtime V3 voice conversations, the tool saves completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows. ⟦Imagine a stenographer transcribing completed remarks into the minutes as a meeting proceeds, while the bookkeeper packing up overly long files counts misprinted drafts and discarded pages missing billing stamps toward the total paper weight.⟧ When a conversation gets long enough to trigger automatic context compaction, the calculation now also counts retained output from failed responses and responses missing token usage data (the text units AI processes and bills for).

items.original:
Long realtime V3 conversations save completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows (#58221).
Automatic context compaction now accounts for retained output from failed responses and responses with missing token usage data (#58404).

title.zh-TW: 淘汰模型主動推薦替代方案，Linux musl 降低閒置記憶體佔用
title.en: Retiring models get replacement recommendations, and Linux musl reduces idle memory use

body.zh-TW:
開發者在維護長期專案或將工具部署在輕量環境時，模型升級與底層資源消耗現在都有更省心的安排。

如果正在使用的模型即將淘汰，內建的 `openai-docs` 技能（skill，擴充 AI 能力的指引包）在引導遷移時，會直接根據官方文件推薦合適的替代模型。

針對安裝部署，DotSlash（按平台自動下載對應執行檔的發布工具）的設定清單現在會直接參照本次版本隨附發布的 Cargo 套件。

若是在 Linux musl 環境編譯，底層改用較少的記憶體配置區（allocator arenas，底層向系統申請記憶體的緩衝區塊），有效降低對話工作階段卸載之後殘留的閒置記憶體。
body.en:
For developers maintaining long-running projects or deploying tools in lightweight environments, model upgrades and underlying resource use now require less attention.

If the model you are using is being retired, the built-in `openai-docs` skill (a package of instructions that extends AI capabilities) now recommends a suitable replacement directly from the official documentation when guiding migration.

For installation and deployment, DotSlash (a tool that downloads the right executable for each platform) manifests now directly reference the Cargo packages shipped with this release.

Builds for Linux musl now use fewer allocator arenas (buffer blocks used to request memory from the system), reducing idle memory left behind after conversation sessions unload.

items.original:
The `openai-docs` skill recommends the documented replacement when migrating away from a deprecated model (#58134).
DotSlash manifests now reference the Cargo packages shipped with the release (#58717, #58757).
Linux musl builds use fewer allocator arenas to reduce idle memory after conversations unload (#58399).

title.zh-TW: 鍵盤支援選取對話紀錄，按單字換行翻頁與內建搜尋
title.en: Keyboard Transcript Selection with Word, Line, and Page Motions and Integrated Search

body.zh-TW: 查閱終端機裡長串的除錯紀錄時，頻繁移開雙手去抓滑鼠反白文字常常打斷思緒。⟦宛若在厚重字典裡用檢索標籤翻查單字，以前只能用肉眼一行行硬找並手動標記，現在手指一撥就能按章節跳頁並直接定位字彙。⟧對話紀錄（終端機中保留的歷史問答內容）現在完整支援純鍵盤選取操作。你能使用鍵盤按單字、整行或整頁幅度移動游標，精準框選想複製的段落。介面內建搜尋功能，當你請 AI 檢查長篇日誌並想擷取特定段落時，直接鍵入關鍵字就能跳到該行。所有移動與選取的按鍵組合也開放自訂，方便你依照習慣配置個人快捷鍵。
body.en: When reviewing long debug logs in the terminal, frequently moving your hands away to grab the mouse and highlight text often breaks your train of thought. ⟦Think of looking up words in a thick dictionary using index tabs: in the past, you had to scan line by line with your eyes and mark text manually, whereas now a flick of the finger lets you skip across sections and pinpoint a vocabulary word directly.⟧ The transcript (historical question-and-answer exchanges kept in the terminal) now fully supports keyboard-only selection. You can use the keyboard to move the cursor by word, line, or page increments to precisely highlight the passages you want to copy. The interface features integrated search, so when you ask AI to inspect long logs and want to capture specific sections, typing keywords takes you straight to that line. All keybindings for motion and selection are also open to customization, making it easy to configure your personal shortcuts based on your habits.

items.original: Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts. (#57221, #57222, #57223, #57224)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面修復排版與離線退出，還原草稿保留附加圖片
title.en: Terminal Interface Fixes Rendering and Offline Exit While Preserving Image Attachments

body.zh-TW: 在終端機與 AI 密集互動時，文字排版錯亂或突發斷線往往會打亂操作節奏。非同步提問、選項清單、回答內容與對話紀錄回覆中的 Markdown（將文字標記為標題或粗體的輕量排版語法），現在皆能維持一致的渲染呈現。還原被清除的輸入框文字時，原本附加的本機圖片也會一起留下。終端介面也改善了重連後的復原，離線時輸入 `/quit` 或 `/exit` 也能正確處理。
body.en: When interacting intensively with AI in the terminal, garbled text formatting or sudden disconnections often disrupt the operational flow. Markdown (a lightweight markup syntax that formats text into headings or bold text) across asynchronous questions, choice lists, answers, and transcript replies is now consistently rendered. When restoring cleared composer text, original local image attachments are also preserved. The terminal interface also improves reconnection recovery, properly handling `/quit` or `/exit` even when offline.

items.original:
Rendered Markdown consistently in async questions, choices, answers, and transcript replies. (#57259, #57292)
Preserved local image attachments when restoring killed composer text. (#57502)
Improved TUI reconnection recovery, including offline `/quit` and `/exit` handling. (#57820)

title.zh-TW: 新增 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型，支援內建與兩大雲端目錄
title.en: GPT-6.1 Terra Model Added with Support for Bundled and Two Major Cloud Catalogs

body.zh-TW: 規劃專案架構並評估模型效能時，能否在自己習慣的雲端託管環境調用最新架構是關鍵考量。⟦好比連鎖量販店引進新型高效冷氣，以前想購買只能透過少數專門管道，現在官方型錄與各大特約通路貨架都同步補齊規格。⟧Codex 模型目錄現已正式加入 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型。除了本地內建的預載型錄外，使用 Google Cloud 的 Vertex AI 或 AWS 的 Amazon Bedrock 託管服務的團隊，也能在各自的模型清單中看到它。在這三份目錄的任一份裡，都能選到 GPT-6.1 Terra。
body.en: When planning project architectures and evaluating model performance, being able to invoke the latest architecture in your preferred cloud hosting environment is a critical consideration. ⟦Consider a retail chain stocking a new high-efficiency air conditioner: where buyers previously had to rely on a few specialized channels, both the official catalog and the shelves of major authorized partners now carry the model simultaneously.⟧ The Codex model catalog has now officially added the GPT-6.1 Terra model. In addition to the local bundled catalog, teams using hosting services such as Vertex AI on Google Cloud or Amazon Bedrock on AWS can also see it in their respective model listings. You can select GPT-6.1 Terra from any of these three catalogs.

items.original: Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs. (#57293)

title.zh-TW: 討論串回復與分支保留授權，佇列後可接續，子串一併復原
title.en: Thread Resuming and Forking Preserve Approvals with Queue Resume and Child Thread Restoration

body.zh-TW:
將中斷的工作階段重新接續或另開分支時，對話狀態與先前確認過的設定往往需要被妥善延續。

現在使用 `codex queue --resume` 指令，能在將新訊息加入佇列後，自動喚醒並接續已卸載的討論串。

當你回復既有進度或建立分支時，先前已經過確認的放行批准與權限設定會完整保留，不必在分支裡逐項重新授權。

回復與分支過程也會一併保留推理 token（AI 思考過程消耗的計費文字單位）的累計數據。這避免了系統因遺失思考紀錄而誤判對話長度，導致過早觸發上下文壓縮。

若先前將某個討論串封存，現在只要解封存該父討論串，所有由它衍生出的子討論串都會同步復原。以往分支後總要重新確認權限、子串在解封存時不知去向的麻煩，現在都不會再發生。
body.en:
When resuming an interrupted session or branching into a new fork, conversation state and previously confirmed settings often need to be properly carried forward.

Running the `codex queue --resume` command now automatically wakes and resumes unloaded threads after queueing a new message.

When you resume existing progress or create a fork, previously acknowledged approvals and permission settings are preserved in full, eliminating the need to reauthorize permissions item by item in the branch.

The resume and fork process also retains cumulative counts for reasoning tokens (billable text units consumed during an AI thought process). This prevents the system from misjudging conversation length due to lost deliberation records, which previously triggered premature context compaction.

If a thread was previously archived, unarchiving that parent thread now restores all child threads spawned from it simultaneously. The past annoyances of repeatedly re-confirming permissions after branching or losing track of child threads upon unarchiving no longer occur.

items.original:
Added `codex queue --resume` to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message. (#57232)
Preserved acknowledged approval and permission settings when resuming or forking threads. (#57227)
Restored spawned descendant threads when unarchiving their parent. (#57635)
Preserved reasoning-token accounting across resume and fork to avoid premature compaction. (#57839)

title.zh-TW: 安全防護阻擋提示更清晰，提供替代提示詞直接選取
title.en: Clearer Safety-Block Explanations with Direct Selection of Safer Follow-Up Prompts

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入特定提示詞若意外觸發安全防護，突然中斷的對話常讓人摸不著頭緒。⟦彷彿圖書館珍本庫的借閱櫃台，以前被拒絕調閱只得到一張空白退件單，現在館員會清楚說明受限章則，還會主動列出可借閱的替代篇章。⟧終端使用者介面（TUI，以文字選單排版的終端畫面）現在提供更清楚的安全攔截說明。當你的請求因安全原則遭到阻擋時，畫面會明確解釋被限制的具體原因，不再只丟出一行模糊的拒絕訊息。介面同時會自動生成數個調整過措辭的安全替代提示詞，你可以直接按鍵盤選取並重新送出。這讓你在探索程式碼防護或敏感測試情境時，能立刻知道邊界在哪，並快速調整詢問方向繼續工作。
body.en: When entering certain prompts in the terminal unexpectedly triggers safety guardrails, a sudden conversation halt often leaves users bewildered. ⟦Picture the circulation desk of a rare book library: where a denied request once yielded only a blank rejection slip, the librarian now clearly explains the restricted regulations and proactively suggests alternative chapters available for loan.⟧ The TUI (terminal interface formatted with text-based menus) now provides clearer safety-block explanations. When your request is blocked due to safety policies, the screen clearly explains the specific reason for the restriction instead of merely returning a vague rejection line. The interface simultaneously generates several rephrased, safe follow-up prompts that you can select directly with your keyboard and resubmit. When exploring code defenses or sensitive testing scenarios, this lets you immediately recognize boundaries and swiftly adjust your questioning direction to continue working.

items.original: Added clearer safety-block explanations and selectable safer follow-up prompts in the TUI. (#57363, #57365)

title.zh-TW: 診斷指令新增專注網路選項，快速檢測連線與協定狀態
title.en: Focused Network Option Added to Doctor Command for Rapid Diagnostics

body.zh-TW:
當終端機突然連不上伺服器或回覆中斷時，快速抓出是本機環境還是網路連線出問題至關重要。⟦如同音響工程師拿著導線專用測試儀，以前排查雜音得把整套擴大機與調音台拆開通盤安檢，現在只要接上線頭就能單獨測量訊號導通狀況。⟧現在診斷工具新增了 `codex doctor --network-only` 參數選項。這項指令只針對設定、連線能力與 WebSocket（雙向即時通訊的網路協定）狀態做診斷。當你在公司內部網路或代理伺服器環境下遭遇請求逾時，只要打：

```bash
codex doctor --network-only
```

終端機就會只回報設定、連線與 WebSocket 這三項的檢查結果。
body.en:
When the terminal suddenly loses connection to the server or replies are cut off, quickly pinpointing whether the issue lies in the local environment or the network connection is critical. ⟦An audio engineer uses a dedicated cable tester: whereas troubleshooting noise previously required dismantling and inspecting the entire amplifier and mixing console, plugging in the leads now immediately tests signal continuity on its own.⟧ The diagnostic tool has now added the `codex doctor --network-only` option. This command runs diagnostics exclusively on configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket (a networking protocol for bidirectional real-time communication) status. When encountering request timeouts in corporate intranets or proxy environments, you simply run:

```bash
codex doctor --network-only
```

The terminal then reports only the configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket checks.

items.original: Added `codex doctor --network-only` for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics. (#57606)

title.zh-TW: 獨立執行器隨附於正式安裝包，整頓背景服務與建置工具
title.en: Standalone Executor Shipped in Official Packages Alongside Service and Build Improvements

body.zh-TW: 在建置環境部署與升級工具時，底層架構的打包完整度與資源釋放直接影響執行穩定。正式釋出的命令列工具與 app-server（應用程式背景伺服器）安裝包中，現在已直接隨附獨立執行器。背景服務修復了執行緒啟動與關閉時的競爭衝突，執行完成後會即時釋放占用資源。同時，macOS 上若安裝路徑包含中文等非 ASCII 字元，或程式仍在使用中，獨立版本的清理錯誤也已修好。在專案建置方面，Bazel 改採原始碼自編譯的 V8 引擎，搭配相符的 Rust 綁定並支援 Windows 原生 MSVC 封裝；開發與正式發行版本也全面標準化至 Node.js 24.22.1 與 Rust 1.95.0。以往在特定路徑清理失敗或背景程序殘留資源的問題，現在都已排除。
body.en: When deploying and upgrading tools in build environments, the packaging integrity and resource release of underlying architectures directly dictate execution stability. Canonical CLI and app-server (application background server) release packages now bundle the standalone executor directly. The background service fixes thread startup and shutdown races, promptly releasing occupied resources upon completion. Meanwhile, standalone release cleanup errors on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters such as Chinese have also been resolved. For project builds, Bazel switches to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. Development and release builds are also standardized across the board on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. Past issues where cleanups failed on specific paths or background processes left lingering resources are now eliminated.

items.original:
Fixed standalone release cleanup on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters. (#57503)
Fixed app-server thread startup and shutdown races and released completed runtimes promptly. (#57787, #57788)
Switched Bazel to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. (#57164, #57269, #57644, #57832)
Shipped the standalone executor in canonical CLI and app-server release packages. (#57837)
Standardized development and release builds on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. (#57168, #57373)

title.zh-TW: /model 新增 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 與 Carbon 模型支援
title.en: /model Adds Support for Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Carbon Models

body.zh-TW: 當你想嘗試最新一代模型來處理日常任務時，現在可以直接切換到 Gemini 4 系列。⟦如同工具行進駐新一代動力機具，架上依照出力大小整齊陳列，只要憑會員卡或企業通行證就能隨時提領使用。⟧透過 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 連線時，`/model` 與 `--model` 迎來了 Gemini 4 Hydrogen（提供 Low、Medium、High 與 XHigh 四種思考強度）。選單也同步加入了 Gemini 4 Carbon（提供 Low、Medium 與 High 三種思考強度）。如果你習慣使用應用程式預設憑證（`AGY_ADC_AUTH`）登入，同樣可以使用這四種強度的 Hydrogen 模型。而在透過企業模型閘道連線的工作環境裡，也已經支援使用 Gemini 4 Hydrogen。
body.en: When you want to try the latest generation of models for everyday tasks, you can now switch straight to the Gemini 4 family. ⟦A hardware store stocks a new line of power tools, arranged neatly on the shelves by output size, ready to check out anytime with a membership card or corporate pass.⟧ When connecting with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `/model` and `--model` now include Gemini 4 Hydrogen (offering Low, Medium, High, and XHigh thinking levels). The menu also adds Gemini 4 Carbon (offering Low, Medium, and High thinking levels). If you prefer signing in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), you can use all four thinking levels of Hydrogen as well. Environments connecting through an enterprise model gateway also support Gemini 4 Hydrogen.

items.original: Added Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) and Gemini 4 Carbon (Low, Medium, and High) to `/model` and `--model` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, added Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), and added support for Gemini 4 Hydrogen through an enterprise model gateway.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕渲染模式支援點擊展開，免按快速鍵收合單一區塊
title.en: Click to Expand Single Blocks in Full Screen Rendering Mode Without Shortcuts

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡閱讀長篇回應與工具記錄時，若想確認某段內容，翻找起來常需要反覆切換檢視。⟦就像閱讀互動式摺疊目錄一樣，以前想看細節必須按下開關整批掀開，現在只要用滑鼠輕點目標，就能單獨展開或收起該段落。⟧在全螢幕 `full screen (altscreen)` 渲染模式下，終端機介面新增了滑鼠點擊展開機制。現在只要點擊工具分組、思考過程、提示詞隨附的圖片，或是多行指令輸出，就能直接展開或摺疊特定項目。你不必再透過 `Ctrl+O` 鍵來回切換。預設的渲染模式（Rendering Mode）則維持原樣。
body.en: When reading long responses and tool logs in the terminal, checking a specific section often meant toggling views back and forth. ⟦Picture an interactive folding catalog where you previously had to flip a switch to open everything at once for details, whereas now a click on one target expands or collapses just that section.⟧ In the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode, the terminal interface now supports click-to-expand. Clicking a tool group, a thought, images attached to a prompt, or multi-line command output now directly expands or collapses that specific item. You no longer need to toggle back and forth with `Ctrl+O`. The default `Rendering Mode` remains unchanged.

items.original: Added click-to-expand in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: clicking a tool group, a thought, a prompt's attached images, or multi-line command output now expands or collapses just that item, so you no longer have to use `Ctrl+O`. The default `Rendering Mode` is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: agy acp 即時回報上下文用量，編輯器可顯示使用比例
title.en: agy acp Reports Context Usage in Real Time for Editor Indicators

body.zh-TW: 當你在外部編輯器裡調用助手時，常想掌握對話佔據了模型多少記憶容量。⟦類似儀表板即時顯示油量，車輛啟動、行駛加速或變更檔位時指針都會更新，駕駛隨時能掌握剩餘行駛額度。⟧在 `agy acp` 建立的工作階段中，現在會主動回報上下文視窗（模型單次能容納的文字量）的使用進度。這讓 JetBrains AI Chat 等外接編輯器能夠即時顯示對話佔用的比例。該數值會在工作階段剛啟動或重新載入時送出。每當模型完成一次呼叫，或是你切換模型與調整思考層級時，終端機也會立即推送最新用量。
body.en: When calling the assistant from an external editor, it helps to know how much of the model's memory capacity your conversation is taking up. ⟦Like a dashboard fuel gauge updating in real time, the needle moves when the car starts, accelerates, or shifts gears so the driver always knows the remaining range.⟧ Sessions created by `agy acp` now actively report usage progress for the context window (the amount of text a model can hold at once). This lets external editors such as JetBrains AI Chat display the conversation's usage ratio in real time. The value is sent when a session starts or reloads. Whenever a model call finishes, or when you switch models or adjust the thinking level, the CLI also pushes the latest usage immediately.

items.original: Added context window usage updates to `agy acp` sessions, so editors such as JetBrains AI Chat can show how much of the model's context window the conversation is using; the value is sent when a session starts or is reloaded, after each model call, and after a model or thinking level change.

title.zh-TW: 新增企業管理員設定，可嚴格控管網頁讀取與停用遠端操控
title.en: New Enterprise Admin Settings Restrict Web Reads and Disable Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 企業在落實資安合規政策時，常需要集中管理員工終端對外連線與遠端存取權限。⟦宛若大樓管委會為辦公室出入口設定門禁規範，既能關閉遠端遙控門鎖，也能強制所有包裹必須經由指定櫃檯轉交。⟧新增的 `gateway.routeWebFetch` 設定鍵可防止代理人讀取網頁時繞過企業模型閘道。除非額外配置了 `proxy.address`，否則會直接停用讀取網址的功能。在搭配企業模型閘道的情況下，網頁會改由你的電腦直接抓取（有配置時走 `proxy.address` 轉發），不再經過 Google 的抓取服務。另一項 `featureControls.remoteControlEnabled` 則能讓組織停用遠端操控（Remote Control）功能。
body.en: When enforcing security compliance policies, enterprises often need centralized control over outbound terminal connections and remote access permissions. ⟦Think of a building management committee setting access rules for office entrances, able to disable remote-controlled locks while requiring every package to pass through a designated front desk.⟧ The new `gateway.routeWebFetch` setting prevents the agent from bypassing an enterprise model gateway when reading web pages. Unless `proxy.address` is also configured, URL reading is disabled outright. With an enterprise model gateway, web pages are now fetched directly from your machine (routed through `proxy.address` when configured) instead of through Google's fetch service. Another setting, `featureControls.remoteControlEnabled`, lets organizations turn off Remote Control.

items.original: Added support for two admin settings: `gateway.routeWebFetch` stops the agent's web page reads from going around an enterprise model gateway by disabling URL reading unless a `proxy.address` is configured, and `featureControls.remoteControlEnabled` lets an organization turn off Remote Control. With an enterprise model gateway, web pages are now fetched directly from your machine (through `proxy.address` when set) instead of through Google's fetch service.

title.zh-TW: --remote-agent 背景預先喚醒遠端環境，首則訊息零等待
title.en: --remote-agent Pre-Warms Remote Environments in the Background for Zero-Wait First Messages

body.zh-TW: 當你使用遠端代理人連線開發時，每次開啟對話往往要乾等遠端主機完成啟動。⟦猶如外勤駕駛在預約乘客抵達前就先暖好車輛，乘客一開門就能直接出發，不必坐在車內原地等待熱機。⟧在 `--remote-agent` 建立的工作階段中，送出首則訊息時不再需要停滯等待。只要確認了遠端專案，終端機就會立即在背景備妥新對話的執行環境。輸入 `/new` 或切換專案時也會再次提前準備。若透過 `--continue` 或 `--conversation=<id>` 恢復先前對話，閒置中的環境也會在對話開啟的瞬間於背景喚醒。
body.en: When developing with a remote agent connection, starting a conversation often meant waiting around for the remote host to boot up. ⟦A chauffeur warms up the car before the scheduled passenger arrives, so they can pull away the moment the door opens without sitting inside waiting for the engine.⟧ In sessions created with `--remote-agent`, sending the first message no longer stalls waiting. As soon as the remote project is known, the CLI prepares the new conversation's environment in the background right away. It prepares ahead again after `/new` or switching projects. When resuming an earlier conversation with `--continue` or `--conversation=<id>`, an idle environment also wakes up in the background the moment the conversation opens.

items.original: Improved the first message of a conversation in `--remote-agent` sessions, which no longer waits for its remote environment to start or resume: the CLI now prepares a new conversation's environment as soon as the session knows its remote project, and again after `/new` or switching projects, and starts a resumed conversation's idle environment in the background as soon as it opens with `--continue` or `--conversation=<id>`.

title.zh-TW: 修復多項權限與安全防護漏洞，阻斷繞過沙盒與指令白名單
title.en: Fix Permission and Security Gaps Blocking Sandbox and Allowlist Bypasses

body.zh-TW:
當你為代理人配置安全規則時，各層防護現在能確實阻截繞過行為。

終端機沙盒會檢查網址路徑的各種解析，阻擋 `%2F`、反斜線、`..` 繞過憑證與 API 限制，只傳送清理後的路徑。

Windows 的 `cmd`、`powershell` 指令須完全符合一律允許規則，夾帶額外陳述式不再放行。

預載 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具與 `/browser` 除錯工具會遵守拒絕或詢問規則。

`/plugin`、`agy plugin`、無頭模式（headless，無終端機畫面的執行模式）`-p` 均受組織管制：停用外掛後，安裝、匯入、啟用會報 `plugins are disabled by your organization`；停用市集則不抓目錄、不能從市集安裝。列出、停用、解除安裝仍可用。
body.en:
When you configure security rules for the agent, each layer of protection now reliably blocks bypass attempts.

The terminal sandbox checks every interpretation of a URL path, blocking `%2F`, backslashes, and `..` from bypassing credential and API restrictions, and sends only the cleaned-up path.

Windows `cmd` and `powershell` commands must now match always-allow rules exactly, so hidden extra statements are no longer permitted.

Eagerly loaded MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) tools and `/browser` DevTools now follow deny and ask rules.

`/plugin`, `agy plugin`, and headless (running without a terminal screen) `-p` runs all respect organization controls: when plugins are disabled, installing, importing, or enabling one fails with `plugins are disabled by your organization`; when the marketplace is disabled, catalogs are not fetched and marketplace installs fail. Listing, disabling, and uninstalling still work.

items.original:
Fixed a security issue in the terminal sandbox's network proxy where a command could get around path-based network rules, such as those limiting where credentials are sent or which Git and API paths are allowed, by using percent-encoded slashes (`%2F`), backslashes, or `..` segments in a URL path; every way of reading the path is now checked against the rules, and the cleaned-up path is the one sent upstream.
Fixed always-allow command rules on Windows so they can no longer be bypassed when the shell is `cmd`, `cmd.exe`, `powershell.exe`, `pwsh.exe`, or a full path to one of them.
