Built-in skills the model loads on its own now name tools the way the model is offered them, so it calls them by the right name
When more skills are installed than the startup skill list can show, the agent can still find the ones left out by looking one up with part of its name or description

title.zh-TW: 恢復原生 MP4 與 MOV 影片讀取，多媒體工作階段標題更易辨識
title.en: Native MP4 and MOV video reading restored with clearer multimedia session titles

body.zh-TW: 當你將影像或影音檔案交給模型分析時，支援的模型現在恢復直接讀取原生 MP4 與 MOV 格式影片。⟦看齊放映室的播映系統，只要放映機能解碼就直接播放膠捲，中途換成不支援影像的設備也不會卡死，片名更直接採用放映標題而非報關單據。⟧即使先前讀取過影片，後續切換到不支援影片的模型、提供者或停用影像設定，工作階段依然能正常延續而不被阻擋。由外部應用程式開立對話時，其標題與首則提示預覽會直接採用使用者看見的提示文字，不再出現整段原始 JSON 資料；以技能或純圖片開場的對話，也會以具體顯示文字或 `[Image 1]` 命名。
body.en: When you pass image or video files to a model for analysis, supported models now resume directly reading native MP4 and MOV videos. ⟦Matching a screening room's projection system, the projector plays the film reel directly whenever it can decode it, switching mid-show to equipment without video support never stalls playback, and the marquee uses the actual movie title rather than customs paperwork.⟧ Even if a video was read earlier, switching later to a model, provider, or setting that does not support video lets the session continue normally without being blocked. When an external app starts a conversation, its title and first-prompt preview directly use the prompt text as shown to the user instead of displaying raw JSON blocks; conversations starting with a skill or image-only input are also named with their display text or `[Image 1]`.

items.original:
Restore native MP4 and MOV video reading for supported models
Sessions with an earlier video read keep working when the current model, provider or video setting can't send that video
A session started by another app now takes its title and first-prompt preview from the prompt as it was shown, not the app's wrapper text, so it no longer appears with raw JSON as its name; a session that starts with a skill or image is titled by its display form (its typed form, or [Image 1] for an image-only start)

title.zh-TW: 支援刪除工作樹自動重建，修復 tmux 狀態回報與 Windows 終端體驗
title.en: Deleted worktrees rebuild automatically alongside tmux status and Windows terminal fixes

body.zh-TW: 當你喚醒先前工作階段卻發現工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）已被刪除時，只要來源儲存庫已受信任，即使主機沒有可強制執行的建立沙盒，也會自動重新建立該工作樹；未受信任的儲存庫仍會拒絕。⟦如同野外工作站重啟設備，若既有分支遭意外移除，只要母基地受信任就會就地重新搭建，控制台狀態燈號也會即時同步給遠端監視器。⟧在 tmux 環境中，工具能主動廣播運作狀態，方便外部終端掌握進度。在 Windows 系統中，沙盒指令在使用者資料夾內會正確將工作區當作起點，相對路徑不再誤對應至安裝目錄；傳統主控台中按 Ctrl+V 能正常貼上文字，對話分支時也不再出現寫入錯誤。執行 `/feedback` 回報問題時，畫面會預先標註工作階段紀錄容量與修剪提示。
body.en: When you resume a prior session and find its worktree (a Git feature that lets one project keep multiple parallel working copies) was deleted, it automatically recreates that worktree as long as the source repository is already trusted, even on hosts without an enforceable creation sandbox; untrusted repositories still refuse. ⟦Restarting gear at a field station works much the same way: if an existing outpost was accidentally removed, it is rebuilt on the spot as long as the home base is trusted, and console status lights sync immediately to remote monitors.⟧ Inside tmux, the tool proactively broadcasts its running status so external terminals can track progress. On Windows, sandboxed commands inside your user folder properly start in the workspace so relative paths no longer misresolve to the install directory; pressing Ctrl+V in classic consoles pastes text normally, and branching a conversation no longer hits write errors. When running `/feedback` to report an issue, the screen previews the session record size and notes when it will be trimmed.

items.original:
Inside tmux, Muse now reports its program status (OSC 7501) without waiting for the terminal to answer, so iTerm2's tmux integration (`tmux -CC`) shows whether a session is working, waiting for you, or done; a client that attaches later sees it once the attach resizes the window or the status next changes
`/feedback` shows how big the session record is before you agree to attach it, and notes when it will be trimmed
On Windows, sandboxed shell commands now start in the workspace when it is inside your user folder, so relative paths no longer resolve under the PowerShell install folder
On Windows, Ctrl+V pastes copied text into the prompt in consoles that pass the key to Muse, such as the classic PowerShell window, instead of reporting that no image could be attached
Resuming a session whose worktree was deleted now recreates it on hosts without an enforceable creation sandbox when you already trust the source repository; untrusted repositories still refuse
Branching a conversation on Windows no longer fails with a write error

title.zh-TW: 伺服模式預設集支援持久生效，詳細回報對話分支錯誤
title.en: Server mode presets persist across logins with detailed conversation branching errors

body.zh-TW: 以伺服端架構部署背景服務時，`muse serve --preset` 現在能完整套用預設集的提示詞與執行環境設定。⟦恰如郵件伺服器的派工設定，開機時指定好投遞範本與過濾規則，登入後依然貫徹到底，若派送信件失敗也會寫明卡在哪個路徑與系統代碼，不再只丟下一句傳送失敗。⟧除了支援由 `-c` 載入的自訂設定外，啟動時選定的預設集在使用者登入後也會持續保留。當透過 `muse serve` 分支對話因工作階段檔案寫入失敗而中斷時，錯誤訊息會指明失敗的具體步驟、路徑種類及作業系統原始代碼，不再只拋出抽象字眼。在 Linux 環境下建立對話分支不再因檔案建立時間問題而碰壁。連線初始化時，若客戶端名稱超出 64 個字元將明確回絕。應用程式若遭停用，會明確回傳伺服端原因，不再盲目要求重新登入。
body.en: When deploying background services with a server architecture, `muse serve --preset` now fully applies the preset's prompts and runtime environment settings. ⟦Imagine a mail server's dispatch configuration: delivery templates and filtering rules set at boot stay enforced after login, and any failed delivery spells out the exact path and system code where it stalled instead of merely saying send failed.⟧ In addition to supporting custom configs loaded via `-c`, the preset chosen at startup persists after user login. When branching a conversation via `muse serve` fails because a session file could not be written, the error message names the specific failed step, path kind, and raw operating-system error code instead of throwing only a vague label. Creating a conversation branch on Linux no longer hits file birth time errors. During connection initialization, a client name exceeding 64 characters is explicitly rejected. If the app is deactivated, it clearly returns the server reason instead of blindly prompting to log in again.

items.original:
`muse serve --preset` applies the preset's prompts and run settings, accepts presets defined with `-c`, and keeps the preset chosen at startup after login
When branching a conversation through `muse serve` fails because a session file could not be written, the error now names the step that failed, the kind of path and the operating-system error instead of only `WriteFailed`
`initialize` now refuses a `clientInfo.name` longer than 64 characters, with the same `invalidParams` error a malformed name already gets
Forking a chat with `muse serve` on Linux works again instead of failing with "file birth time is unavailable"
A deactivated Muse Code app now names the server reason instead of telling the user to log in again

title.zh-TW: 伺服端異常中斷安全復原，未完操作不再私自執行
title.en: Safe server crash recovery stops unfinished actions from running on their own

body.zh-TW: 伺服器若無預警當機重開，先前的未竟事務現在能安全清理。⟦就像工廠控制台在跳電重啟後，先前掛在半空中的加工指令一律先重設關閉，不會擅自動手運轉機台，新進的交接事項也會確實送達值班人員手中。⟧在 `muse serve` 異常退出後喚醒工作階段，中斷前正在執行的任務不會再顯示為進行中。對於當機前等待審批的工具呼叫，重啟後不會重複彈出詢問，更不會私自逕行執行；中斷的呼叫會直接結案，模型再次調用時才走正常審批。協調通道喚醒後若畫面需要時間重繪，交接摘要與回答依然能確實送達，不再陷入沉寂。若在運作期間刪除 `session-index.db` 索引檔，清單不會損壞或崩潰，會以現有檔案重新建立。透過工作階段協定建立旁軌對話時，也不再偶發回報對話已被占用。
body.en: When the server crashes and restarts unexpectedly, any unfinished work from before is now cleaned up safely. ⟦A factory console after a power trip resets and cancels any mid-air machining commands on restart instead of running the equipment on its own, while new handover notes still reach the on-duty operator.⟧ Resuming a session after `muse serve` exits unexpectedly no longer shows tasks from the interrupted run as still in progress. Tool calls that were waiting for approval before the crash no longer prompt again or run on their own after a restart; interrupted calls are closed out and go through normal approval only if the model invokes them again. When a coordinator lane takes a moment to redraw after waking, its handover brief and answers still arrive reliably instead of going silent. Deleting the `session-index.db` index file while running no longer breaks the list or crashes the app, and the index is rebuilt from existing files. Opening a side chat over the session protocol also no longer intermittently reports that the session is already in use.

items.original:
Resuming a `muse serve` session after Muse Code exited unexpectedly no longer shows the interrupted run's work as still in progress
After a crash, `muse serve` no longer asks again about tool calls that were waiting for approval and no longer runs an approved call by itself; the interrupted calls are closed and a call the model makes again gets the normal permission check
A resumed coordinator lane whose session takes a moment to redraw now still receives its handover brief and answers, instead of going silent
Deleting `session-index.db` while Muse Code runs no longer makes the session list fail or crashes the app; the index is rebuilt with fresh files
Opening a side chat over the session protocol no longer intermittently reports the new session is already in use

title.zh-TW: 工作流程強化中斷復原，正確釋放未用容量保留
title.en: Stronger Workflow crash recovery releases unused capacity reservations

body.zh-TW: 長時間跑自動化工作流程（Workflow）時，中斷後的接續與資源管理更為嚴密。⟦宛如自動化物流倉儲的軌道調度，搬運車遇到故障重開機時會主動退還佔用的通道額度，按下暫停鈕後立刻凍結動作，絕不會在停機後又偷偷吐出貨物。⟧在流程執行當下關閉應用程式或 `muse serve`，重新開啟後會重新儲存歷史紀錄。更正遺失的流程名稱後，背景工作狀態在重啟後依然保留；若在流程剛好完工時按下暫停，狀態會老實保持暫停，不再多報完工。重啟後復原的子流程會自動釋放未使用的容量保留，發生衝突時給出清晰的重啟錯誤；以相同指令識別碼重試跳過或執行時會返回原結果。在 Windows 上已儲存的工作流程能正常自本機指令稿路徑執行，舊版工作階段不再提供流程功能，建議建立新工作階段使用。
body.en: Long-running automated Workflows now handle resumption and resource management more tightly after an interruption. ⟦Automated warehouse rail dispatch works the same way: when a shuttle faults and reboots, it gives back its reserved lane quota, and pressing pause freezes motion immediately so nothing slips out after a stop.⟧ Closing the app or `muse serve` while a Workflow is running now saves history again once reopened. After correcting a missing Workflow name, background work status survives a restart, and pausing a Workflow right as it finishes keeps its status paused without also reporting completion. Child Workflows recovered after a restart automatically release unused capacity reservations and return a clear restart error on conflicts, while retrying a skip or run with the same command ID returns the original result. Saved Workflows run properly from local script paths on Windows, and older sessions no longer offer Workflow support, so starting a new session is recommended.

items.original:
Resuming a session saved by an older version no longer offers Workflow; start a new session to use it
Background work status survives a restart after correcting a missing Workflow name
A chat in the app or `muse serve` that was closed while a workflow was running saves its history again after it is reopened
A Workflow paused just as it finishes now stays paused, instead of also reporting a finished result after the pause
Saved Workflows can run again from their local script paths on Windows
Retrying a workflow child skip or retry with the same command id after a restart returns its original result; chats whose checkpoint holds such a result require a compatible app update, and older versions cannot open them
Recovered Workflow children release unused capacity reservations, and conflicting attempts get a clear restart error

title.zh-TW: 要求主代理閱讀完整流程報告，保留長篇背景工作復原指引
title.en: Main agent reads full Workflow reports and keeps long-run recovery guidance

body.zh-TW: 當工作流程產出長篇報告時，若預覽畫面被系統自動縮短，主代理現在會先被要求調閱完整的報告內容，再對你做出回答。⟦好比專案負責人審閱結案簡報，目錄頁雖然只放精簡要點，但拍板定案前必須調閱完整附件，突發狀況的排除步驟也整頁留存，不會因為頁面摺疊而遺漏。⟧即使預覽經過裁減，完整的工作流程報告依然維持可讀性，長篇背景工作結果中的錯誤復原指引也會完整保留。遇到未知的流程結果引用時保持原樣不變；修正了指令與當前工作階段不符的問題。若工作流程中的代理經歷頻繁跳過或重試超過 128 次，工作階段在壓縮歷史後仍會正常存檔，確保後續隨時能從該檢查點接續。
body.en: When a Workflow produces a long report whose preview is shortened automatically, the main agent is now instructed to read the full report before answering you. ⟦Much like a project lead reviewing a closing deck, the summary slide shows only highlights, yet the full appendix is pulled before making a call and troubleshooting steps stay intact on their own page instead of getting lost in collapsed sections.⟧ Complete Workflow reports remain readable even when their preview is trimmed, and error recovery guidance in long background results stays intact. Unknown Workflow result references are left unchanged, and a mismatch between instructions and the current session has been fixed. If agents in a Workflow are skipped or retried more than 128 times, the session still saves its history after compaction so you can resume from that checkpoint anytime.

items.original:
Fixed workflow instructions that did not match the current session
A session saves its history again when it compacts after a Workflow's agents were skipped or retried more than 128 times, so it can be resumed from that point
Keep unknown Workflow result references unchanged
Complete Workflow reports remain readable when their preview is shortened
Keep recovery guidance intact in long background Workflow results
Tell the main agent to read complete Workflow reports before answering from a shortened preview

title.zh-TW: 背景工作完成即時喚醒對話，狀態清單精簡識別碼
title.en: Finished background tasks wake chats immediately with cleaner status IDs

body.zh-TW: 當主對話正在等待耗時的背景工作時，現在背景任務一旦完成或產出資料，就會立刻自動喚醒等待中的工作階段，不必等你手動輸入打斷。⟦猶如餐廳後廚完成特製餐點，取餐鈴響起時前台立刻主動通知顧客，不必等客人親自走到櫃台詢問，螢幕看板也只顯示簡短取餐號碼，不再塞滿長串內部訂單條碼。⟧即使早先的喚醒訊號偶發遺失，完工事件依然能成功促發喚醒。從 `/tasks` 停止剛好完成的背景工作或監視器時，會立刻登記停止，不再空等 30 秒後被拋棄。查詢工作狀態時，標題與卡片僅顯示一次短識別碼，清單優先展示項目標籤而非原始 JSON。即便背景指令遭遇紀錄錯誤，其執行結果仍會保留在歷史中；跨越多次歷史壓縮持續運作的背景任務，重新開啟對話時也不會被誤判為無效。
body.en: When the main chat is waiting on a long background task, the waiting session now wakes automatically as soon as the task finishes or produces output, without waiting for your manual input. ⟦Once a restaurant kitchen finishes a special order, the pager buzzes so the counter alerts the guest right away instead of making them walk up to ask, and the display board shows only a short pickup number rather than a long internal order barcode.⟧ Even if an earlier wake signal is lost, the completion event still triggers a wake. Stopping a background task or monitor from `/tasks` right as it finishes now records the stop immediately instead of dropping it after a 30-second wait. Work status checks show a short ID once across the header and card, and listings prefer item labels over raw JSON. Background command results stay in history even after a recording error, and background tasks that keep running across multiple compactions are no longer marked invalid when you reopen the chat.

items.original:
A session waiting on a finished background task now wakes when the task finishes instead of staying stuck until you intervene
Stopping a background task or Monitor from `/tasks` just as it finishes now records the stop right away instead of dropping it after a 30-second wait
Background task output now wakes a waiting session instead of staying queued until you intervene
A finished background task now wakes a waiting session even when an earlier wake was lost
Work status checks now show a short work ID once instead of repeating the full ID in the header and the status card, and listing background work shows item labels when present (else a short work ID) instead of raw JSON
Preserve background command results in session history after a recording error
A background task that keeps running through several compactions no longer shows as invalid after you reopen the chat

title.zh-TW: 父代理支援讀取子代理完整回覆，終止任務確實等待背景清理
title.en: Parent agents read full subagent replies and wait for background cleanup

body.zh-TW: 母代理調用子代理處理獨立工作時，現在可以直接讀取子代理完整的最終回答。⟦就像專案主管調閱外派調查員的調查手冊，現在能一次看完整本報告，不必為了閱讀後半段又派出第二位助理，收到撤隊指令時也必須等現場人員確實撤離才能回報結案。⟧以前系統只能讀取前 512 個字元，常導致母代理為了讀取剩餘內容而無端增開額外代理。當取消、強制封裝或停止仍在清理背景工作的子代理時，不會再提早虛報完畢，取消會等背景結束才回報，停止期間會明確回應正在停止中。子代理執行失敗時會忠實保留具體錯誤原因；重啟子代理對話時能保留早先產生的回覆；當機後復原的客戶端不會將已收尾的子代理顯示為執行中，並將編輯區標為唯讀以防送出被拒請求。
body.en: When a parent agent delegates independent work to a subagent, it can now read the subagent's entire final reply directly. ⟦Rather than sending a second assistant just to fetch the back half of a field investigator's notebook, a project manager can read the whole report at once, and a stand-down order closes out only after the field team has actually cleared out.⟧ Previously only the first 512 characters were readable, which often caused parent agents to spawn extra agents just to read the rest. Cancelling, force-sealing, or stopping a subagent that is still cleaning up background work no longer reports done early; cancel waits for background work to finish, and stop explicitly reports that it is stopping in the meantime. Subagent failures preserve the specific error reason, reopening a subagent chat keeps earlier replies, and a client recovered after a crash no longer shows finished subagents as running while marking the composer read-only to prevent rejected sends.

items.original:
Cancelling, force-sealing or stopping a subagent whose own background work is still being killed no longer reports it done early: the result arrives once that work has ended, a cancel that cannot finish yet fails with a typed error naming the task, a stop answers `stopping` until then and is recorded once the jobs are dead
Preserve the specific failure reason when a subagent fails
Reopening a subagent chat keeps replies from earlier work
A parent agent can now read a subagent's whole final answer instead of only its first 512 characters, so it no longer spawns extra agents just to read the rest
After a crash, a resumed client's subagent rows no longer show a recovered child as running, and its child-view composer correctly reports the thread as read-only instead of attempting a send the host rejects

title.zh-TW: 強化子代理跨重啟連線與歸屬權限，長目標對話壓縮更輕快
title.en: Subagents stay connected across restarts with lighter goal compaction

body.zh-TW: 執行需要分派子代理的長篇 `/goal` 對話時，重啟檢查點不再背負開工以來的所有瑣碎步驟，體積更小且喚醒更迅速。⟦恰如工地現場的班長名冊，即使總部重啟或工作日誌重新裝訂，派駐在各區的工班隊長依然保有完整的聯絡管道與指揮權，交班紀錄也不用把開工第一天的大小瑣事全數背在身上。⟧在對話經過壓縮後，向先前啟動的子代理指派後續任務或等待回應，不會再因執行過 Shell 指令或缺少所有權而回報失蹤。由 `/goal` 啟動的子代理在自我壓縮時會正確存檔以供接續；因重啟中斷的子代理通訊紀錄，會在母對話喚醒時自動重讀。在配置 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的環境下，伺服器重啟前完成的子代理能順利接收後續任務；使用 `tbh exec --session-id` 喚醒對話時，也不會再弄丟子代理關聯。
body.en: In long `/goal` sessions that dispatch subagents, restart checkpoints no longer carry every minor step from the start, making them smaller and faster to wake. ⟦Compare it to a construction site foreman roster: even if headquarters restarts or the site log is rebound, section leads keep their communication lines and authority intact without hauling every tiny detail from day one in the handover notes.⟧ After a conversation is compacted, sending follow-up tasks to or waiting on previously started subagents no longer reports them missing due to prior shell commands or missing ownership. Subagents started from `/goal` save properly when self-compacting so they can resume, and subagent transcripts cut off by a restart are reread automatically when the parent chat wakes. With MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) configured, subagents that finished before a server restart can receive follow-up tasks smoothly, and waking a chat with `tbh exec --session-id` no longer drops subagent links.

items.original:
Long `/goal` sessions that start sub-agents keep their resume checkpoints small and resume quickly, instead of carrying every step since the first sub-agent started
A follow-up task sent to a subagent that finished before `muse serve` restarted no longer stops before reaching the model when MCP servers are configured
A sub-agent started from a `/goal` chat saves its history again when it compacts, so it can be resumed from that point
After resuming a compacted session, follow-ups and waits on a subagent no longer fail once a shell command ran after the compaction
A subagent's transcript that a restart cut off reads again as soon as its parent session resumes, with no action on the subagent
Resuming a compacted session with `tbh exec --session-id` keeps its subagents, so following up with, waiting on or checking a subagent no longer reports it missing
After a resumed session, following up with a subagent started before the conversation was compacted works again instead of failing the subagent with a missing ownership error

title.zh-TW: 歷史壓縮完整保留常駐指令，折疊早期紀錄避免重複重播
title.en: Compaction preserves standing duties verbatim and collapses older history

body.zh-TW: 對話太長觸發上下文壓縮時，交接摘要現在會逐字保留常駐待命的操作觸發條件與完整指令，例如「獲得審批即刻啟動機器人」，防止關鍵指令在摘要過程中被淡化忽略。⟦仿照航海日誌的階段性結算，舊航程濃縮成單一封存捲軸，但遇敵反擊的標準作業準則逐字抄寫在現役手冊上，不必每翻一頁就重複推敲前文。⟧透過 `muse serve` 重新開啟壓縮後的工作階段，早期歷史會整齊收納為單一折疊項目，不認識該項目的客戶端會顯示備援文字，後面直接銜接最新進展，不再從頭重播一遍。超長工作階段壓縮時不再卡死；背景摘要若失敗或容量超標，系統不會每輪白花額度重算，改等內容明顯增長後才再次嘗試。若技能內容在壓縮時被帶走，提醒機制會在有需要時重新提供該技能，自動備忘錄也不再重複抄錄使用者訊息。
body.en: When a long conversation triggers context compaction, handover summaries now keep standing operational triggers and exact commands verbatim—such as starting a bot once approval arrives—so key instructions are not watered down or overlooked. ⟦A ship's log settles each leg the same way: past voyages are rolled into a single archive scroll, while standard combat procedures are copied word for word into the active manual so nobody has to re-read earlier pages on every turn.⟧ Reopening a compacted session through `muse serve` neatly folds earlier history into a single collapsed item—clients that do not recognize it display fallback text—followed directly by recent progress instead of replaying from the beginning. Very long sessions no longer stall during compaction, and if a background summary fails or exceeds capacity, the system stops spending quota every turn and waits until the conversation grows noticeably before retrying. If a skill's content is summarized away during compaction, the reminder offers that skill again when needed, and automatic history notes no longer copy preserved user messages repeatedly.

items.original:
Reopening a compacted session through `muse serve` (`session/read`, or `session/resume` when it returns inline or snapshot history) now shows the earlier conversation as one collapsed earlierHistory item holding the checkpoint's recent messages, followed by what came after, instead of replaying history from before the checkpoint. Clients that do not know the item kind show its fallback line
When a background context summary fails or is too large to use, Muse Code no longer pays for a new one every turn; it retries only after the conversation has grown well past the failed attempt, including after the session is reopened
Very long sessions no longer stall while compacting a conversation too large to summarize at once
Compaction avoids copying preserved user messages into its automatic history notes
Compaction handoff summaries now preserve operational state-to-action triggers (standing duties with their exact command) verbatim, so a duty like starting a bot once an approval arrives survives context compaction instead of being summarized away
After context compaction summarizes a skill body away, the skill reminder can offer that skill again instead of treating it as already read for the rest of the session

title.zh-TW: 檢查點精簡收錄拒絕指令，壓縮時完整保留進行中任務
title.en: Checkpoints store rejected commands compactly and keep active tasks

body.zh-TW: 工作階段長時間運作建立重啟檢查點時，現在不再保留已完工工作流程的子容量紀錄，檢查點更為輕巧。⟦看齊精簡檔案館的典藏作業，結案的工作流程移出日常備查抽屜，曾被退回的申請案也改以微縮膠片歸檔，節省空間的同時依然維持現役公文的完整度。⟧被使用者拒絕執行的指令在檢查點中會以精簡格式收錄，開啟這類檢查點需更新至相容版本。對話經歷多次壓縮時，進行中的任務會確實保留；曾由舊版修復中斷流程的工作階段，重新恢復儲存上下文檢查點。重新開啟工作階段時，若壓縮後的輪次重用了壓縮前的規則或指示，不再跳出錯誤。在上下文壓縮後重新寫入工具執行結果時，不再因權限校驗報錯；已壓縮的分支或旁軌對話不會再被後續檢查點掩蓋壓縮狀態。
body.en: When long-running sessions create restart checkpoints, child capacity records from finished Workflows are no longer kept, keeping checkpoints lighter. ⟦Borrowing from a streamlined archive's filing routine, closed Workflows move out of the daily reference drawer and rejected applications go onto microfilm, saving space while keeping active paperwork intact.⟧ Commands rejected by the user are stored in a compact format in checkpoints, and opening such checkpoints requires updating to a compatible version. Active tasks are preserved across multiple compactions, and sessions whose interrupted Workflows were recovered by an older version resume saving context checkpoints. Reopening a session no longer throws an error when a post-compaction turn reuses rules or instructions from before compaction. Rewriting tool results after context compaction no longer fails permission validation, and compacted forks or side chats no longer have their compacted state hidden by later checkpoints.

items.original:
Resume checkpoints of long sessions no longer keep every finished Workflow's child-capacity records, so they stay smaller; opening a session compacted this way needs this app version or later
Compaction checkpoints keep rejected commands in a smaller form; chats whose checkpoint holds one require a compatible app update, and older versions cannot open them
Preserve active tasks when compacting a conversation more than once
Sessions where an older Muse Code (1.4.5 or earlier) recovered an interrupted workflow save context checkpoints again, so compaction is no longer skipped or dropped in them
Reopening a session no longer fails when a turn after a compaction reuses rules or instructions from before it
A long run no longer fails with "Origin read requires valid checkpoint-suffix or origin-preserved full-replay authority" when a tool result's saved copy has to be re-written after context compaction
A fork or side chat that compacted no longer writes later checkpoints that hide the compaction, so its next resume still starts from the checkpoint

title.zh-TW: 歷史回滾不再受待處理訊息卡死，審批決策重試直接回傳原結果
title.en: Rewind avoids queued-message locks and approval retries return original results

body.zh-TW: 當你想倒帶回滾（rewind）至先前的對話輪次時，若倒帶點落在代理忙碌時送出的排隊訊息之前，新分支不會再被卡在排隊狀態並拒絕所有後續輸入。⟦猶如時光機倒帶至關鍵分岔路口，原本在路上塞住的郵件直接清空，曾蓋章通過的公文調出原存根核對，不會因為中途改道而將整座車站鎖死。⟧即使在背景任務結果尚未送達期間曾觸發上下文壓縮，回滾到早期輪次也能順暢執行不報錯。從壓縮歷史重新載入工作階段後，若重試先前的審批決策、回答問題或移除排隊訊息，系統會直接返回先前的處理結果，不再重新處理。在自檢查點喚醒的對話中，若在對話進行中執行 `/goal set`，新目標能正常啟動，徹底排除儲存失敗導致後續訊息皆被拒送的問題。
body.en: When you rewind to an earlier conversation turn before a queued message sent while the agent was busy, the new branch no longer gets stuck in a queued state and refuses all further input. ⟦Setting a time machine back to a key junction clears out any mail jammed in transit and pulls original stamped stubs for verification, so switching tracks never locks down the whole station.⟧ Rewinding to an earlier turn also succeeds without error even if context compaction ran while a background task result was still waiting to be delivered. After reloading a session from compacted history, retrying an earlier approval decision, question answer, or queued-message removal returns the original result directly instead of processing it again. In a session resumed from a checkpoint, running `/goal set` mid-conversation starts the new goal normally, eliminating the save failure that blocked all subsequent messages.

items.original:
Rewinding past a message you sent while the agent was busy no longer leaves the new branch stuck refusing every message and showing that message as still queued
After a session reopens from a compacted history, retrying an approval decision, a question answer or a queued-message removal returns the original result instead of handling it again
Rewinding to an earlier turn no longer fails after a compaction that ran while a finished background task's result was still waiting to be delivered
In a session resumed from a checkpoint, running `/goal set` while a turn was running could cancel the new goal turn and then refuse every later message with "Message not sent — saving failed"; the goal turn now starts and later messages go through

title.zh-TW: 背景儲存遇到磁碟異常具備容錯，短暫錯誤不再卡死後續存檔
title.en: Fault-tolerant background saves recover cleanly from brief disk errors

body.zh-TW: 當背景儲存因短暫磁碟錯誤受阻時，系統現在能在下一輪自動解除異常並完成寫入，不必重啟工具才能解鎖。⟦就像收銀機碰上印表機短暫缺紙，系統會先將略過紀錄記在日誌中並繼續為顧客結帳，等下一批發票裝上後立刻恢復列印，不必整台關機重啟。⟧遇到磁碟異常導致定期存檔被迫略過時，即使連略過註記都無法寫入，對話也不會被強行中斷，而是記錄錯誤後繼續當前輪次。若因磁碟已滿導致任務連結或監視器未存檔，壓縮檢查點依然能持續運作。取消執行後立即輸入 `/new` 或 `/clear` 不再跳出檔案遺失錯誤；檢視落後的對話重新開啟時會正確展示最新一輪；長時間伺服對話在重啟後，能持續儲存檢查點而不被拒絕。
body.en: When a background save is blocked by a brief disk error, the system now clears the error and completes the write on the next turn without needing a restart. ⟦When a cash register's receipt printer briefly runs out of paper, it logs the skipped print and keeps checking out customers, then resumes printing as soon as a new roll is loaded instead of rebooting the whole register.⟧ If a disk error forces a periodic save to be skipped and even the skip note cannot be written, the conversation continues the current turn after logging the error instead of aborting. Compaction checkpoints continue working even when a full disk prevented saving a task link or monitor. Running `/new` or `/clear` right after cancelling a run no longer raises a missing-file error, reopening a chat whose view fell behind shows the latest turn properly, and long-running served chats keep saving checkpoints after a restart without being refused.

items.original:
After a brief disk error interrupts one background save, the next save on the same chat clears it and goes through, instead of being refused until restart
While a storage error lasts, a periodic save that has to be skipped no longer ends the turn when the note recording the skip cannot be written either; the error is logged and the turn goes on
`/new` or `/clear` right after cancelling a run no longer exits with a missing-file error
Reopening a chat whose saved view fell behind, for example after a cancelled turn, shows its latest turn instead of an older one
When a full disk could not save a task link, a monitor line or, in most cases, a named workflow launch, compaction checkpoints now keep working without restarting the chat
A chat reopened on an older build, whose log saved two background-result notices at the same spot, keeps saving compaction checkpoints in the running process instead of refusing them until the next reopen
A long-running served chat whose earlier checkpoint was saved together with a compaction keeps saving checkpoints instead of refusing every one after a reopen

title.zh-TW: 旁軌與分支支援跳過損毀輪次，自動重建可讀歷史
title.en: Side Chats and Branches Skip Corrupted Turns and Rebuild Readable History

body.zh-TW: 當對話因磁碟爆滿導致某一輪紀錄無法寫入時，以往整條對話都會癱瘓。⟦宛如書籍有一兩頁受潮沾黏，影印時影印機會主動略過無法辨識的那幾頁並註明缺漏，讓你順利裝訂出其餘完整的章節，不必把整本書作廢丟棄。⟧現在這類對話能重新進行分支、建立旁軌或執行回滾；系統會自動跳過無法讀取或寫入失敗的輪次，並在開場清楚提示一次。即使對話包含兩筆不同寫入失敗紀錄、提醒遺失或檢查點受損，分支也能自動重建可讀歷史並順暢開啟。舊版建立的旁軌對話現在能正確喚醒並保留歷史與權限設定；旁軌對話在壓縮後重開，不再每輪重讀全部舊紀錄，舊資料損壞也不會阻礙當前對話。
body.en: Previously, when a full disk prevented a turn's record from being written, the entire chat would break down. ⟦A photocopier scanning a book with a couple of damp, stuck pages actively skips the unreadable sheets and notes the gaps, letting you bind the remaining complete chapters instead of discarding the entire volume.⟧ Now, these chats can be branched, side-chatted, or rewound again; the system automatically skips turns that cannot be read or failed to write, and clearly notes this once at the start. Even if a chat contains two different failed write records, a missing reminder, or a damaged checkpoint, branching automatically rebuilds a readable history and opens smoothly. Side chats created in older builds now resume properly while preserving their history and permission settings; when reopened after compaction, side chats no longer re-read their entire old history each turn, so damage in older data no longer blocks the current chat.

items.original:
Restore resume for older Side chats while preserving their history and permission settings
A chat in which one record of a turn could not be written to disk, even after a retry (for example on a full disk that stayed full), can be forked, side-chatted and rewound again; that turn is left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once
A forked chat whose saved history has an unreadable part, and where the start of one of its own turns could not be written to disk, no longer refuses every message after it is reopened, forked or side-chatted; that turn is left out, and Muse says so once
A chat in which a reminder for one turn could not be written to disk, even after a retry, can be forked and side-chatted again; that turn is left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once. Rewinding such a chat is still refused
A forked chat whose copied checkpoint can no longer be replayed (written by an older build, or slightly damaged) opens, forks and side-chats again with its copied history rebuilt; only history that truly cannot be read is left out, and Muse says so once
A chat in which a reminder for one turn could not be written to disk, even after a retry, can be rewound again; that turn is left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once
A chat in which two different kinds of record could not be written to disk can be forked and side-chatted again; both turns are left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once for each
A side chat reopened after it compacted no longer re-reads its whole history each turn, so damage in older history no longer stops it

title.zh-TW: 支援 MCP 伺服器登入與壓縮後重啟，工具調用衝突自動重試
title.en: MCP Server Login, Post-Compaction Restarts, and Automatic Tool-Call Retries

body.zh-TW: 在對話中連接外部擴充時，經過審查核准的外掛 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，現在可透過 `muse serve` 或 `muse mcp login` 完成登入。⟦恰如總機轉接外線電話，當前端安全檢查還在核對來電身分時會先亮起保留燈號，就算通話紀錄中途封存，重啟時也能自動重新接通專線。⟧在歷史壓縮後喚醒對話，MCP 伺服器會正常重啟，不再跳出啟動稽核失敗或工具遺失的錯誤。外部工具活動介面在呼叫前置掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）評估時，能看到該次呼叫並標記為保留中。當模型的工具呼叫訊號出現名稱或識別碼分歧時，會自動重試該輪嘗試而非中斷對話。遭拒絕的跨來源重新導向不再覆寫已存的工作階段，重新導向的授權也不再套用到非 HTTP(S) 的來源；模型請求被拒時會帶有專門標記，方便介面顯示精確的拒絕說明。
body.en: When connecting external extensions in a chat, review-approved plugin MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers can now sign in via `muse serve` or `muse mcp login`. ⟦Operators at a switchboard transferring an outside call keep the hold light lit while front-end security checks verify the caller's identity, and even if the call log is archived midway, the dedicated line reconnects automatically upon restart.⟧ When resuming a chat after history compaction, MCP servers restart properly instead of throwing startup audit failures or missing-tool errors. Interfaces showing external tool activity can now see a tool call while a pre-tool hook (a small program triggered when specific events occur) is still evaluating it, marked as held. When a model's tool-call signals disagree on the tool name or call ID, that attempt is automatically retried instead of ending the chat. Denied cross-origin redirects no longer overwrite the stored session, and redirect grants no longer apply to non-HTTP(S) origins. When a model request is denied, it carries a dedicated flag so the interface can display an accurate denial message.

items.original:
A failed turn's error now carries `requestDenied: true` when the provider refused the request, so session protocol clients can show "Request denied" instead of a generic model failure
Apps that show tool activity now see a tool call while a pre-tool hook is still deciding on it, marked as held
MCP servers start again when you resume a session after it was compacted, instead of every turn failing with "MCP startup audit failed" or the MCP tools going missing
A denied cross-origin redirect no longer replaces the stored session for an Agent plugin's MCP server, and redirect grants no longer match non-HTTP(S) origins
Plugin MCP servers approved in review can now sign in through `muse serve` as well as `muse mcp login`, instead of being refused as plugin-managed
A model response whose tool-call signals disagree on the tool name or call id now retries that attempt instead of ending the whole run

title.zh-TW: 降低長對話記憶體消耗，打字輸入不再因背景檢查卡頓
title.en: Lower Memory Usage in Long Sessions, Eliminating Typing Jank

body.zh-TW: 在包含多個子代理任務的長工作階段中打字時，介面不再發生輸入卡頓。⟦仿照現代倉儲的空間管理，大型貨架將相同規格的說明書共用一份存檔，不再每箱重複塞入厚重手冊，通道巡檢也改為按需抽查，讓現場搬運與紀錄始終靈活流暢。⟧以往每幀畫面都會將所有回傳結果與每次執行逐一比對，現在調整比對機制後打字反應依然敏捷。長工作階段的記憶體佔用顯著降低，結構化工作階段紀錄以緊湊文字常駐於記憶體中，每次執行的事件容量更小，模型指示與上下文設定也改為單一複本共用。喚醒包含子代理的工作階段時，不再重新讀取其壓縮前的舊紀錄；子代理多、又沒存檢查點的長工作階段，喚醒時逐一檢查子代理紀錄不必再解析每一筆，所以更快；閒置工作階段更取消了每兩秒讀取一次磁碟索引的常態行為。
body.en: Typing in long sessions with multiple subagent tasks no longer suffers from input jank. ⟦Modern warehouses manage space by keeping a single shared copy of each spec manual on main shelves instead of stuffing heavy booklets into every box, and shifting aisle inspections to on-demand spot checks so on-site handling and logging stay agile and smooth.⟧ Previously, every delivered result was checked against every run on each frame; adjusting this comparison keeps typing responsive. Memory usage in long sessions is significantly reduced: structured session records stay in memory as compact text, each run's events take less space, and model instructions and context settings are shared as a single copy. Resuming a session with subagents no longer re-reads their old history from before compaction. Long sessions with many subagents and no saved checkpoints also resume faster because checking each subagent record no longer parses every entry, and idle sessions no longer perform a constant disk-index read every two seconds.

items.original:
Resumed and long-running sessions use less memory, because saved copies of session records made mostly of structured data are kept as compact text instead of an expanded in-memory form
Long sessions use less memory, because each saved run event takes less space in memory
Resumed long sessions use less memory, because each run's model instructions and context settings are kept once in memory instead of being copied for every run
Resuming a session with subagents no longer re-reads a subagent's history from before its last compaction
Typing in long sessions with many subagent runs stays responsive, because the subagent tree no longer re-checks every delivered result against every run on each frame
An idle session no longer re-reads the whole session index every two seconds, which removes a constant background disk read on machines with many saved sessions
Resuming a long session that has many subagents and no saved context checkpoint is faster, because checking each subagent log for a checkpoint no longer parses every record

title.zh-TW: macOS 與 Linux 支援檔案系統拒絕規則，嚴格阻擋敏感路徑讀寫
title.en: Filesystem Deny Rules Supported on macOS and Linux to Strictly Block Sensitive Path Access

body.zh-TW: 當你在權限設定檔中擴充 `:ask-me` 並加入檔案系統 `deny` 規則時，系統現在會在 macOS 與 Linux 上確實強制執行。無論是工作區根目錄的萬用字元（如 `**/*.pem`），還是絕對路徑與家目錄 `~/` 的拒絕規則，都會直接拒絕符合條件的讀寫請求，並限制沙盒 Shell 存取指令啟動時已存在的符合路徑。⟦跟金庫的門禁感應卡一樣，原本只交代警衛口頭留意，現在閘門讀卡機直接鎖定黑名單區域，非許可人員碰觸感應區就立刻鳴笛拒絕。⟧在 Linux 上，指令執行中途於萬用字元下新建的檔案不受保護；macOS 則透過 Seatbelt 正規表達式（用符號匹配字串的語法）即時防堵且無快照空窗。至於尚未存在的路徑，會在第一個缺失層級先行遮蔽，而設定檔在其他位置的寫入授權則維持不變。
body.en: When you extend `:ask-me` in a permission profile with filesystem `deny` rules, the system now enforces them on macOS and Linux. Whether using workspace-root deny globs (such as `**/*.pem`) or absolute and home directory `~/` deny rules, matching read and write requests are directly refused, and sandboxed shell access to matching paths that exist when each shell command starts is blocked. ⟦Just as a vault card reader secures restricted areas, where guards were previously only told to keep watch verbally, the card reader now actively locks down blacklisted zones and sounds an alarm whenever unauthorized personnel touch the sensor.⟧ On Linux, files created mid-command under a deny glob are not covered. macOS prevents them live through Seatbelt regex (syntax for matching text patterns with symbols) with no snapshot window. Denies on not-yet-existing paths are masked at their first missing component, while the profile keeps its write grants elsewhere.

items.original: On macOS and Linux, permission profiles extending `:ask-me` with filesystem `deny` rules now enforce them: workspace-root deny globs (`**/*.pem`) and absolute/`~/` denies refuse matching reads and writes, and sandboxed shell access to matching paths that exist when each shell command starts (files created mid-command under a deny glob are not covered on Linux — macOS enforces globs live through Seatbelt regex with no snapshot window; a deny on a not-yet-existing path is masked at its first missing component), instead of being silently ignored, while the profile keeps its write grants elsewhere

title.zh-TW: 支援獨立查詢訂閱額度，用量接近上限時主動警示
title.en: Standalone Subscription Allowance Queries Supported with Proactive Warnings Near Limits

body.zh-TW: 如果你想確認自己剩餘的模型使用次數，現在不必發送訊息觸發模型就能直接掌握。執行 `muse usage` 會顯示訂閱額度（包含時間區間、每週用量、重設時間與方案等級）；當指令沒有產生新的用量更新時，`muse exec --json` 也會同步讀取該資訊。⟦恰似手機隨時打開電信公司帳務頁面，以前非得打通電話才能在帳單看到剩餘網路流量，現在打開面板就能直接查餘額。⟧當你快達到用量上限時，訊息佇列上方會跳出警告，標示剩餘可用額度與重設時間。一旦觸發用量限制而中斷，畫面會明確說明何時能繼續發問，被拒絕的請求也會保留完整的錯誤細節供你排查。
body.en: If you want to check your remaining model usage, you can now check it directly without sending a message to run a model turn. Running `muse usage` displays your subscription allowance (including window, weekly use, reset times, and tier). When a run sees no new usage updates, `muse exec --json` reads that information as well. ⟦Think of opening your mobile carrier billing page on your phone at any time: instead of having to place a call to see remaining data on your bill, you can now open the panel and check your balance directly.⟧ When you are near your usage limit, a warning appears above the message queue showing your remaining allowance and reset time. If execution stops due to a usage limit, the interface clearly explains when you can continue asking questions, and denied requests retain full error details for troubleshooting.

items.original:
`muse usage` shows your subscription allowance (window and weekly use, reset times, tier) without running a model turn; `muse exec --json` reads it too when the run saw no usage update
Warnings near your usage limit show the remaining allowance and reset time above the message queue
Usage limit stops explain when you can continue, and denied requests retain useful error details

title.zh-TW: 內建視覺程式設計技能引導分流，3D 遊戲管線分步回報待辦清單
title.en: Built-In Visual Coding Skill Guides Triage as 3D Game Pipeline Posts Steps to Todo List

body.zh-TW: 當你要求代理人製作 3D 網頁、瀏覽器遊戲或處理 Blender 專案時，現在內建的 `visual-coding` 技能會在動筆寫程式前，主動引導代理人使用負責該領域的單一內建技能，避免單次請求同時啟動兩套相互衝突的建置流程。⟦宛如醫院的分診服務台，病患剛進門就先依症狀指引至專屬診間，不再讓兩個科別同時搶著收治同一位病人。⟧針對 `/game-3d-visuals` 指令，現在會依序拆分為規劃、建置與審查三個步驟執行，並在每步完成後向待辦清單回報單行結果。該技能現在也會明確為每次管線執行命名，首次啟動不再遭到拒絕或被迫重新嘗試。
body.en: When you ask an agent to build a 3D page, a browser game, or handle a Blender project, the built-in `visual-coding` skill now actively directs the agent to the single built-in skill responsible for that domain before writing any code, preventing one request from launching two competing build processes. ⟦Picture a hospital triage desk directing incoming patients to designated specialty rooms based on symptoms, stopping two departments from competing to treat the same patient.⟧ For the `/game-3d-visuals` command, execution is now split into three sequential steps: planning, building, and reviewing, posting a one-line result to the todo list after each step finishes. The skill also explicitly names each pipeline run, so its first launch is no longer refused or forced to retry.

items.original:
Added a built-in `visual-coding` skill: for a 3D page, a browser game or Blender work, it points the agent to the one built-in skill that owns that kind of work before any code is written, so one request no longer runs two competing build processes
`/game-3d-visuals` now runs its plan, build and review as three steps and posts a one-line result to the todo list after each
The `game-3d-visuals` skill now names each of its pipeline runs, so its first launch is no longer refused and retried

title.zh-TW: YOLO 模式保留提問工具，支援非同步向使用者確認需求
title.en: YOLO Mode Retains Question Tool and Supports Async Inquiries to Confirm Requirements

body.zh-TW: 平時使用 `--yolo` 參數讓工具自動執行任務時，往往既希望節省確認步驟，又擔心重要決策缺乏溝通。現在 `--yolo` 不再全面扣留提問，而是保留了 `request_user_input` 提問工具，並啟用非同步提問機制，讓代理人在背景運作時仍能提出關鍵問題。⟦好比全自動導航的貨運卡車，平常維持自主駕駛，遇到收件地址不清楚時能在儀表板發出非同步通知等你確認，不必被迫停在路中央發呆。⟧如果你希望執行過程完全不被打擾、不詢問任何問題，只要額外加上 `--disable-request-user-input` 參數，就能徹底關閉提問。
body.en: When using the `--yolo` flag to let tools execute tasks automatically, you often want to save confirmation steps without missing important decisions. The `--yolo` flag no longer withholds questions completely; instead, it keeps the `request_user_input` question tool and enables an async questioning mechanism, allowing the agent to ask essential questions while running in the background. ⟦Like an autonomous delivery truck driving smoothly on its own, it can post an async notification on the dashboard for your confirmation whenever a delivery address is unclear, rather than stalling out in the middle of the road.⟧ If you prefer the execution process to run entirely uninterrupted without asking anything, pass `--disable-request-user-input` to disable questions completely.

items.original: `--yolo` keeps the `request_user_input` question tool and enables async questions instead of withholding them; pass `--disable-request-user-input` for runs that should ask nothing

title.zh-TW: 嚴格隔離未受信任工作區，伺服端權限異常時主動降級重設
title.en: Strict Isolation for Untrusted Workspaces with Proactive Reset on Server Permission Anomalies

body.zh-TW: 打開未知來源的專案資料夾時，安全性設定會更嚴密地劃清界線。未受信任工作區的工作階段不再接收先前受信任工作階段記錄的專案規則；工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）復原也遵守相同的保護路徑。未受信任工作區的託管工作階段不再執行工作區狀態檢查或 Sapling 快照，未建立信任就拒絕繼續。⟦猶如訪客不再繼承前人的通行鑰匙，門禁紀錄有缺漏時，也不能沿用舊鑰匙放行。⟧`muse serve` 恢復、分支或開啟側邊對話時，若歷史遺失權限變更，不再沿用較寬鬆的舊權限：會重設為預設值，保留較嚴格的已存設定，只有兩組設定無法安全合併才轉唯讀。遺失前「允許此工作階段」的授權失效。恢復時選擇的權限設定檔在重設後套用；若不允許重設，就取代重設。無安全重設途徑或管理原則禁止時，會拒絕開啟並要求另開新對話。
body.en: When opening project folders from unknown sources, security settings draw a stricter boundary. Sessions in untrusted workspaces no longer receive project rules recorded by earlier trusted sessions. Session worktree (Git's feature for running multiple parallel copies of the same project) recovery now enforces the same protected paths. Hosted sessions in untrusted workspaces no longer run workspace status checks or Sapling snapshots, refusing to continue if trust is never established. ⟦A visitor no longer inherits access keys left behind by a predecessor, and missing log entries also prevent old keys from granting admission.⟧ When `muse serve` resumes, forks, or opens a side chat from history that lost a permission change, it no longer reopens with older, wider permissions: it resets to defaults, keeps your saved settings when they were stricter, or switches to read-only when the two cannot be safely combined. Prior approvals for "allow for this session" given before the loss stop applying. A permission profile chosen when resuming applies after the reset, or replaces the reset when resetting is not allowed. When no safe reset exists or managed policy forbids it, the chat refuses to open and asks you to start a new chat.

items.original:
Security: Sessions in untrusted workspaces no longer receive project rules recorded by an earlier trusted session
Security: Session worktree recovery now enforces the same protected paths as the rest of the session
Security: Served sessions in workspaces you have not trusted no longer run workspace status checks or Sapling snapshots, and sessions that never establish trust now fail closed instead of inheriting trusted behavior
Security: When `muse serve` resumes, forks or opens a side chat from a chat whose saved history lost a permission change, the chat no longer reopens with older, wider permissions: it resets to your defaults, keeps your saved settings when they were stricter, or switches to read-only when the two cannot be safely combined, and "allow for this session" approvals given before the loss stop applying. A permission profile you choose when resuming such a chat applies after the reset, or in its place when the reset is not allowed. When no safe reset exists, or managed policy forbids it, the chat refuses and asks you to start a new chat

title.zh-TW: 分支對話遇磁碟寫入失敗不中斷，重啟自動略過異常回合
title.en: Forked Chats Continue Through Disk Write Failures and Skip Abnormal Turns on Reopen

body.zh-TW: 在磁碟空間不足的環境下建立分支對話，若是某次回合開頭未能成功寫入硬碟，現在不會再卡死整體流程。這類分支對話在完成壓縮並重新開啟後仍可正常運作，重啟時也會再度儲存檢查點；應用程式或其他客戶端載入時，不再阻擋後續檢查點儲存，即使是從已壓縮對話建立的分支也能順利接續。⟦就跟搭乘區間火車碰上某節車廂門鎖損壞一樣，站務員會將該車廂清空並在發車時廣播通知一次，其餘車廂與列車排班依舊準時行駛。⟧系統會將未能成功寫入的回合排除在紀錄之外，並在每次重新載入時清楚提醒你一次，確保對話能持續進行而不中斷。
body.en: Creating a forked chat in low-disk-space environments no longer blocks the entire flow if the start of one of its turns cannot be written to disk. Such forked chats continue working normally after compacting and reopening, saving checkpoints again upon restart. Loading them in an application or another client no longer blocks subsequent checkpoints, allowing forks from compacted chats to continue smoothly. ⟦When a commuter train encounters a damaged carriage door lock, station staff clear that carriage and make a single announcement before departure, while the rest of the train keeps running on schedule.⟧ The system leaves unwritten turns out of the record and reminds you once per reopen, ensuring the chat can proceed without interruption.

items.original:
A forked chat where the start of one of its own turns could not be written to disk keeps working after it compacts and is reopened; that turn stays left out, and Muse says so once per reopen
A forked chat where the start of one of its own turns could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) saves checkpoints again after a restart; that turn is left out, and Muse says so once
Loading a forked chat in the app or another client, where the start of one of its own turns could not be written to disk, no longer blocks its checkpoints; that turn is left out, and Muse says so once
A chat forked from a compacted chat, where the start of one of its own turns could not be written to disk, can be reopened and continued; that turn is left out, and Muse says so once

title.zh-TW: 磁碟滿載或存取中斷自動復原，錯誤排除即刻接續儲存進度
title.en: Automatic Recovery from Full Disks or Interrupted Storage Resumes Progress Immediately

body.zh-TW: 面對暫時性的硬碟存取異常，工作階段現在具備更靈活的自我復原能力。工具執行結果若因磁碟已滿等原因儲存失敗，對話依然能立即執行壓縮，重啟後該回合會完整保留並標註結果已遺失，不再無故消失。當讀取對話檔案因短暫輸入輸出錯誤受阻，一旦讀取恢復正常，對話便會重新儲存進度，不必被迫重啟。即便子代理訊息或背景紀錄因磁碟空間不足存檔失敗，壓縮檢查點無須重啟即可恢復運作。任務中途或背景儲存遭遇短暫磁碟故障時，只要錯誤排除，在下個檢查點便會接續存檔，範圍亦涵蓋側邊對話與已寫入磁碟的紀錄。在寫入持續失敗期間，系統也會減少重複的工作階段日誌登記，避免資源耗損。
body.en: Sessions now feature more resilient self-recovery when encountering temporary storage access errors. If saving a tool result fails due to a full disk or similar issue, the chat can still compact immediately; after a restart, that turn is preserved with the result marked as lost instead of disappearing. When reading a chat file is blocked by a brief I/O error, the chat resumes saving progress once the read succeeds, without requiring a restart. Compaction checkpoints continue working without a chat restart even if saving a subagent message or background record fails due to lack of disk space. When a brief disk error occurs mid-task or interrupts a background save, progress saving resumes at the next checkpoint once the error clears, covering side chats and records already written to disk. While disk writes keep failing, the system also reduces repeated session-log bookkeeping to avoid consuming resources.

items.original:
A chat whose tool result could not be saved (for example on a full disk) can compact again right away, and after a restart that turn is kept with the result shown as lost, instead of disappearing
When a chat's file could not be read while loading it for a save (a brief I/O error), the chat goes back to saving its progress once the read works again, instead of staying unable to save until restart
After a subagent message or other background record could not be saved to a full disk, compaction checkpoints work again without restarting the chat
After a brief storage error in the middle of a task, the chat goes back to saving its progress at the next checkpoint once the error clears, instead of waiting for the task's next tool call or its end
After a brief disk error interrupts one background save, the chat goes back to saving its progress once the error clears, also when the save had fully reached the disk or belonged to a side chat
Reduce repeated session-log bookkeeping while disk writes are failing

title.zh-TW: 長期目標與對話壓縮穩定保存，回合清理失敗會顯示警告
title.en: Long-Running Goals and Chat Compactions Save Reliably with Warnings on Cleanup Failures

body.zh-TW: 長時間執行複雜任務時，對話歷史與檢查點的保存機制能維持正常節奏。漫長的 `/goal` 任務會正常儲存恢復檢查點，使內容維持精簡並迅速恢復，不再每次壓縮後逐漸變慢。對話呼叫子代理再同時執行多項工具後，後續檢查點不再停止儲存；提示詞格式神似訊息封套，也不會阻礙後續工作階段儲存恢復檢查點。模型回應提早結束時，自動壓縮不再遺失監視器訊息；背景任務尚未確認儲存時觸發壓縮，也會儲存檢查點，並保留舊歷史直到背景儲存結果確定，不再跳過儲存。如果回合結束後的清理持續失敗（例如目標計帳或即時狀態），對話會在該回合後顯示一次警告，指名失敗項目；若已進入另一回合，則下次開啟對話時顯示。若警告本身未能存檔，就只在你仍停留於該回合時顯示。
body.en: When executing complex tasks over long durations, the saving mechanism for chat history and checkpoints maintains a steady cadence. Long `/goal` sessions reliably save resume checkpoints again, keeping content compact and restoring quickly instead of slowing down after every compaction. After a chat messages a subagent and runs multiple tools at once, subsequent checkpoints no longer stop saving. Prompts formatted like session-message envelopes also no longer prevent future sessions from saving resume checkpoints. Automatic compaction no longer loses Monitor messages when a model response ends early. Triggering compaction while a background task save remains unconfirmed still saves checkpoints, keeping older history until the background save resolves instead of skipping the save. If cleanup after a finished turn keeps failing (such as goal accounting or live turn state), the chat displays one warning naming the failed item right after that turn, or the next time you open the chat if you have moved on to another turn. If the warning itself cannot be saved, it appears only while you remain on that turn.

items.original:
When cleanup after a finished turn keeps failing (goal accounting or the live turn state), the chat now shows one "cleanup failed after this turn" warning naming what gave up, instead of failing silently. It shows right after that turn, or the next time you open the chat if you have already moved on to another turn (in the rare case that the warning itself could not be saved, it shows only while you are still on that turn)
Long `/goal` sessions save their resume checkpoints again, so they stay compact and resume quickly instead of slowing down after every compaction
A chat that messaged a subagent and then ran several tools at once no longer stops saving checkpoints for the rest of the session
Fixed automatic compaction losing Monitor messages after a model response ended early
A prompt that looks like a session-message envelope no longer stops later sessions from saving resume checkpoints
A compaction that runs while a background task's save is still unconfirmed now saves its checkpoint (keeping the older history until the task's save resolves) instead of skipping it

title.zh-TW: 背景工作流程保留待辦清單，終止與暫停狀態回報更明確
title.en: Background Workflows Retain Todo Lists with Clearer Stopping and Pausing Reports

body.zh-TW: 讓代理人在背景執行長時間任務時，你能更清楚掌握各項流程的即時動態。啟動背景工作流程後，待辦清單在該流程運作期間會持續保留在螢幕上，不再隨著觸發它的對話回合結束而立刻消失。當你手動中斷操作時，停止訊息會明確標註停下的是工作流程還是背景指令。⟦就像工廠中央監控台的流水線看板，即便操作員切換畫面，組裝進度依然常駐顯示，按下急停鈕時也會清楚標明停機的是輸送帶還是檢驗站。⟧若工作流程剛好執行完畢才按下暫停，畫面會直接回報已完成並顯示執行結果，避免卡在無結果的暫停狀態。使用帶有 `stop: true` 的 `session/leave` 時，若工作流程因停止紀錄衝突而無法停止，離開操作會失敗，工作階段仍留在原主機。已知限制是：即使用新的指令識別碼重試，也會持續失敗，直到主機程序重啟。
body.en: When letting an agent run long-running tasks in the background, you get clearer visibility into the real-time status of each process. After launching a background workflow, the todo list remains on screen while the workflow runs, rather than disappearing as soon as the turn that triggered it ends. When you manually stop an operation, the stopping message clearly indicates whether a workflow or a background command was stopped. ⟦Much like a central assembly dashboard in a factory, progress remains visible on screen even when operators switch views, and pressing an emergency stop clarifies whether the conveyor belt or the inspection station was paused.⟧ If you pause a workflow right after it finishes, the interface directly reports that it has completed and displays the execution result, avoiding getting stuck in a paused state with no result. When using `session/leave` with `stop: true`, if a workflow cannot be stopped due to a conflicting stop record, the leave fails and the session remains with its host. As a known limitation, such leaves continue to fail even when retried with a new command id, until the host process restarts.

items.original:
Stopping messages say whether a workflow or a background command was stopped
`session/leave` with `stop: true` no longer releases a session while one of its workflows cannot be stopped (its stop record is in conflict); the leave fails and the session stays with its host, including when you retry it with a new command id; until the host process restarts, such a leave keeps failing (a known limitation)
The todo list now stays on screen while a background workflow is still running, instead of disappearing as soon as the turn that launched it ends
Pausing a Workflow that has just finished now reports that it already finished and shows its result, instead of leaving the Workflow paused with no result

title.zh-TW: 子代理通訊保留文字摘要，取消佇列與對等時間軸正常運作
title.en: Subagent Communication Preserves Plain Summaries as Unqueue and Peer Timelines Function Normally

body.zh-TW: 在多代理人協同運作的環境中，訊息傳遞與佇列排程的管理更加井然有序。透過遠端工作階段向子代理發送便籤時，文字摘要會完整保留，不再遺失原貌；當子代理正忙於處理其他事務，等待中的便籤會明確標記為排隊中，方便追蹤派工狀況。⟦如同辦公室的專案交接留言板，交代給助理的便條紙會整齊貼在排隊欄位並保留原始重點，想抽回尚未處理的留言也能隨時撤下。⟧使用 `turn/unqueue` 撤回排隊訊息時，即便訊息排在內部回合後方，也能順利取消，不再誤報找不到執行個體而強制執行。工作階段自動接收訊息後，對等節點的訊息時間軸亦會正常顯示，不再出現無法使用的錯誤提示。
body.en: In multi-agent collaborative environments, message routing and queue scheduling are organized more cleanly. Notes sent to a subagent over a remote session preserve their plain summary rather than losing their original appearance. When a subagent is busy handling other tasks, waiting notes clearly show Queued rows to facilitate tracking dispatch status. ⟦In an office handover board, notes assigned to an assistant stay neatly in the queue column with their original takeaways intact, and pending messages can be pulled back at any time.⟧ When revoking a queued message using `turn/unqueue`, the cancellation succeeds even if the message waits behind an internal turn, instead of incorrectly failing with `missing_run` and running the message anyway. After a session accepts a message automatically, the peer message timeline also displays normally, without showing an unavailable error.

items.original:
Notes sent to a subagent over a remote session keep their plain summary
Removing a queued message with `turn/unqueue` now works when the message is waiting behind an internal turn, instead of failing with `missing_run` and running the message anyway
Notes waiting on a busy subagent now show Queued rows while they wait
The peer message timeline no longer shows as unavailable after a session accepts a message automatically

title.zh-TW: 桌面端同步第三方模型選單，工作階段命名回歸且降低記憶體
title.en: Desktop Syncs Third-Party Models, Restoring Session Names and Reducing Memory

body.zh-TW: 切換使用不同介面時，模型選單與工作階段清單現在具備一致的體驗。桌面端與其他連線客戶端現在提供與終端機模型選單完全相同的第三方模型選項。你先前為工作階段自訂的名稱會重新列在清單中，並能依據自己的歷史紀錄直接使用 `muse resume <name>` 恢復對話。⟦仿照商品目錄的輕量索引設計，展架上只陳列品名與貨號，不必把整批庫存貨物堆在走道上。⟧其他工作階段仍在執行時，啟動應用程式或 `muse serve` 會減少記憶體用量，因為列出工作階段清單不再保留每個執行中工作階段的完整歷史副本。使用 `/feedback` 回報問題時，若紀錄過於龐大，系統會自動縮減至合適大小並附上標註，不再因檔案過大而失敗。
body.en: When switching between different interfaces, the model menu and session list now provide a consistent experience. Desktop and other connected clients now offer the exact same third-party model options as the terminal model picker. Session names you customized earlier show up again in the list and can directly resume conversations with `muse resume <name>`, read from each session's own history. ⟦Following a lightweight catalog index design, display shelves only present item names and item numbers without stacking the entire inventory stock in the aisles.⟧ Starting the app or `muse serve` while other sessions are running uses less memory, because listing sessions no longer keeps a full copy of each running session's history. When reporting issues with `/feedback`, if a record is very large, the system automatically shortens it to fit and adds a note, so it no longer fails due to oversized files.

items.original:
Desktop and other connected clients offer the same third-party models as the terminal model picker
Session names you gave earlier show up again in the session list and work with `muse resume <name>`, read from each session's own history
`/feedback` uploads with a very large session record no longer fail; the record is shortened to fit and the shortening is noted
Starting the app or `muse serve` while other sessions are running uses much less memory, because listing sessions no longer keeps a full copy of each running session's history

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤注入資訊限制於當前對話，避免模型重新處理完整歷史
title.en: Hook Context Stays in Current Conversation, Preventing Full History Reprocessing

body.zh-TW: 如果你平時利用自動化腳本擴充提示詞或工具結果，現在資料注入的範圍劃分得更為明確。在提示詞或工具呼叫後，透過掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）加入的上下文資訊，現在會被嚴格限制在該資訊抵達的對話之中。⟦看齊公文批閱的浮貼便籤機制，新加上的審核意見只貼在當前公文夾，不必把整份歷史檔案抽出來從頭到尾重審一遍。⟧新增掛鉤規則後，下次呼叫模型不再重新處理整段對話。
body.en: If you typically use automation scripts to augment prompts or tool results, the scope of data injection is now more clearly defined. After a prompt or tool call, context added through hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) is now strictly confined to the conversation where that information arrived. ⟦Adopting the sticky-note mechanism used in document review, newly added review comments are attached solely to the current folder instead of pulling out the entire historical archive to re-examine from start to finish.⟧ After adding a new hook rule, the next model call no longer re-processes the entire conversation.

items.original: Context that hooks add after a prompt or tool call now stays in the conversation where it arrived, so a new hook rule no longer makes the whole conversation re-process on the next model call

title.zh-TW: 內建瀏覽器遊戲技能，依設計需求自動試玩與多輪驗證
title.en: Built-in Browser Game Skill Tests Playability and Runs Multi-Round Verification Based on Design Needs

body.zh-TW: 當你想把腦中的遊戲點子快速變成可玩的網頁原型時，現在能直接叫用內建的 `browser-game` 技能。它會依據需求規模自動調整工作份量，並在交付成品前以真實輸入親自試玩遊戲。⟦好比獨立玩具工坊製作新公仔，交件前師傅會親手按壓關節確認手感，面對複雜機關還會請全新試玩員逐項核對說明書，修正問題後才包裝出貨。⟧若是遇到長篇的遊戲設計文件，最多進行三輪，每輪由新的審查員試玩副本，對照檢查清單與需求規則，修正該輪發現的問題。
body.en: When you want to quickly turn a game concept into a playable web prototype, you can now directly invoke the built-in `browser-game` skill. It automatically sizes the workload to the request's scale and personally tests the game with real input before handoff. ⟦Picture an independent toy workshop crafting a new action figure: before handoff, the artisan personally presses every joint to check the feel, and for complex mechanisms calls in a fresh tester to verify each item against the manual, fixing issues before packaging and delivery.⟧ When dealing with a long game design document, it runs up to three rounds, with a fresh reviewer testing a copy of the game against a checklist and the brief's rules in each round to fix whatever issues that round uncovers.

items.original: Added a built-in `browser-game` skill for building playable browser games from a brief: it sizes the work to the request, plays the game with real input before handoff, and for a long design document runs up to three rounds in which a fresh critic plays a copy of the game against a checklist and the brief's rules, fixing what each round finds

title.zh-TW: 3D 視覺技能耗時減半，精緻專案才觸發多代理人管線
title.en: 3D Visual Skill Runs Twice as Fast, Triggering Multi-Agent Pipelines Only for Polished Projects

body.zh-TW: 建構立體場景或 3D 網頁時，最怕簡單模型也硬塞進繁複的審查流程而拖慢節奏。現在 `/game-3d-visuals` 預設跳過額外的視覺計畫審查，改為只跑一輪渲染與參考圖對照修復，執行時間縮短約一半。⟦宛如相館沖印照片，一般生活快照直接過機列印，只有拿出底片精修或指名沙龍質感的作品，才會送進暗房讓師傅分工調色。⟧這項技能也不再凡事介入，只有遇到需要精緻成果的工作（例如提供參考圖片、Blender 模型，或明確要求高畫質）才會自動啟動。快速建置的 3D 頁面與小型遊戲會直接生成，不必在多代理人管線中空等。
body.en: When building three-dimensional scenes or 3D web pages, the biggest worry is having simple models forced through a tedious review process that drags out progress. Now `/game-3d-visuals` skips the separate visual-plan review by default and runs only one render-versus-reference fix round, cutting execution time roughly in half. ⟦Like a photo studio developing prints, everyday snapshots run straight through the printer, while only film brought in for retouching or fine-art salon portraits gets sent into the darkroom for artisans to color-grade.⟧ The skill no longer intervenes across the board, starting automatically only for tasks requiring polished results (such as providing a reference image, Blender models, or an explicit high-fidelity request). Quick 3D pages and small games are built directly without waiting in a multi-agent pipeline.

items.original:
`/game-3d-visuals` finishes in about half the time: it skips the separate visual-plan review and runs one render-vs-reference fix round by default
`/game-3d-visuals` now starts on its own only for polished 3D work (a reference image, Blender, or an explicit high-fidelity ask); quick 3D pages and games are built directly instead of waiting on its multi-agent pipeline

title.zh-TW: 微型修改略過前置測試，規劃指令與審查關卡界線更分明
title.en: Micro-Edits Skip Upfront Tests, Sharpening Boundaries for Planning Commands and Review Gates

body.zh-TW:
只是想改個按鈕顏色或微調一行設定，如果每次都要先寫一個失敗的測試案例，往往讓人感到多此一舉。現在微小的文字、樣式、設定修改、拋棄式原型、單檔腳本或網頁，或要求快速結果的任務，都不會再強制先寫失敗測試。其他常規修復改在最後一次編輯後跑一次完整測試套件，並在長測試期間於 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）回報進度。⟦就跟裁縫店換顆扣子不必大費周章畫版型一樣，以前動一針就要走完整套驗收，現在小修補俐落交件，大工程在送出門前也一定等客人點頭才寄出。⟧

對小變更輸入 `/plan` 時，Muse 會認真規劃步驟而非直接實作。這項技能會辨識內容來源，把看似要實作的任務文字當成規劃對象。使用者審查關卡也明確推遲對外操作，在檢視核准前暫停執行，防止步驟超前寫入追蹤器或對話紀錄。
body.en:
When you only want to change a button color or tweak a single config line, being forced to write a failing test case first often feels unnecessary. Now tiny text, style, or config changes, throwaway prototypes, one-file scripts or pages, and requests for a quick result no longer start by writing a failing test. Other routine fixes run the full test suite once after the last edit, reporting progress on the status line (the status bar displayed at the bottom of the terminal) during long test runs. ⟦Think of a tailor replacing a single button without drafting an entire pattern: while every single stitch used to require a full inspection, small mends are now handed over promptly, and major alterations wait for the client's approval before being delivered.⟧

When entering `/plan` for a small change, Muse carefully plans out the steps instead of implementing them directly. The skill identifies how the content arrived, reading implement-shaped task text as the planning subject rather than an implementation request. A user review gate also explicitly defers outward-facing actions, pausing execution until post-inspection approval to prevent bounded steps from running ahead into tracker and chat writes.

items.original:
Tiny text, style, or config changes, throwaway prototypes, one-file scripts or pages, and requests for a quick result no longer start by writing a failing test; other fixes run the broad test suite once after the last edit and post a status line during long test runs
A user review gate now explicitly defers outward-facing actions until post-inspection approval, so bounded steps stop instead of running ahead into tracker and chat writes
`/plan` on a small change now plans instead of implementing it — the skill keys the explicit case on how its body arrived, so implement-shaped task text is read as the planning subject, not an implement request

title.zh-TW: 強化研究筆記整合報告指引，重要成果細節優先排列
title.en: Enhanced Research Note Guidance Puts Critical Result Details First in Final Reports

body.zh-TW: 當你請助理執行多方調研時，繁雜的背景調查筆記往往會淹沒最終報告中的核心結論。新版強化了引導規則，協助代理人更有條理地把調研成果與筆記整理進最終成果報告中。⟦好比資深主編排版晨報，讀者最關心的重大數據與頭條結論直接印在頭版最上方，滿滿十幾頁的採訪草稿則整齊收在後頭備查。⟧在工作流程的指導原則中，產出大型結果的重要細節現在會固定排在冗長的研究筆記之前。這讓你打開報告就能立刻掌握最具分量的關鍵產出，不必再費力翻越整大段的參考筆記才找到重點。
body.en: When asking an assistant to carry out multi-faceted research, sprawling background investigation notes often drown out the core findings in the final report. The new release strengthens guidance rules to help agents organize research findings and notes into the final report with greater structure. ⟦A veteran editor lays out the morning paper by printing the key figures and headline takeaways right at the top of page one, keeping dozens of pages of interview drafts filed neatly in the back for reference.⟧ In workflow guidance, key details for large results are now consistently placed ahead of lengthy research notes. This allows you to grasp the most substantial findings immediately upon opening the report without wading through large blocks of reference notes to find the point.

items.original:
Better guidance for carrying research findings and notes into final reports
Workflow guidance keeps large-result details ahead of lengthy research notes

title.zh-TW: 本機通訊埠權限獨立設定，同指令重複網路請求不再反覆確認
title.en: Local Port Permissions Configure Independently, Ending Repeated Confirmations for Same-Command Network Requests

body.zh-TW:
在沙盒裡執行本機網頁伺服器或測試 API 時，以往的網路規則很難精準控制開放哪些本機連接埠。現在權限設定檔能透過 `network.local_ports` 開放指定連接埠，個別設為 `allow`、`ask` 或 `deny`。Linux 選 `ask` 每次連線提示，macOS 每個工作階段詢問一次。`network.targets` 的環回項目現在會遭拒絕，必須遷移至 `network.local_ports`。舊版無法開啟儲存本機連接埠規則或受管理連接埠限制的對話，須更新；其他對話不受影響。⟦就像園區警衛換上專用閘門，各庫房個別發卡；送貨員登記一次後，同趟往返不再反覆盤查。⟧

核准非互動式指令的網路請求後，同一指令執行期間，對相同主機、連接埠與協定的後續請求不再重複詢問。若 `/permissions` 變更失敗，也會直接列出無法儲存的原因。
body.en:
When running local web servers or testing APIs inside a sandbox, previous network rules made it difficult to precisely control which local ports were opened. Permission profiles can now open chosen ports to sandboxed commands via `network.local_ports`, setting each port individually to `allow`, `ask`, or `deny`. Selecting `ask` prompts on each connection under Linux and once per session under macOS. Loopback entries in `network.targets` are now rejected and must be migrated to `network.local_ports`. Older builds cannot open chats that saved local-port rules or managed local-port limits and require an update, though other chats are unaffected. ⟦Security guards at a corporate campus install dedicated gates and issue access cards for individual storerooms; once a courier logs in, subsequent trips during the same run are no longer questioned repeatedly.⟧

After you approve a network request for a non-interactive command once, subsequent requests to the exact same host, port, and protocol no longer prompt for confirmation while that command runs. If a `/permissions` change fails, it also directly names why the update could not be saved.

items.original:
Permission profiles can open chosen local development ports to sandboxed commands with `network.local_ports` (`allow`, `ask`, or `deny` per port); `ask` prompts for each connection on Linux and once per session on macOS; a loopback entry in `network.targets` is now rejected, so move it to `network.local_ports`; an older Muse build cannot open a chat that saved local-port rules or a managed local-port limit, so update the app to open it (other chats are unaffected)
After you allow a network request once, the same non-interactive command's later requests to that exact host, port, and protocol no longer ask you again while it runs
`/permissions` now names why a permission change could not be saved

title.zh-TW: 沙盒禁止規則涵蓋未存在路徑，寫入受阻明確提示解法
title.en: Sandbox Deny Rules Cover Nonexistent Paths, Clearly Explaining Fixes When Writes Are Blocked

body.zh-TW:
面對沙盒環境跳出的唯讀檔案系統錯誤，以往常讓人摸不著頭緒。當沙盒指令嘗試寫入工作階段的可寫根目錄之外（例如家目錄下把算過結果暫存起來的快取路徑），介面不再只丟出冰冷的檔案系統錯誤，而是會明確說明受到沙盒阻擋，並主動列出解法：包含透過 `workspace_roots` 授權、以非沙盒模式單次執行，或是將快取路徑指向工作區或 `/tmp` 目錄。⟦如同大樓嚴格管制裝修，未經核准的新增隔間在動工前就被直接擋下，走錯出口時保全會附上通行指引，施工半途中斷也會將空箱清理乾淨。⟧

安全防護也進一步加固：拒絕規則現在完整覆蓋沙盒指令中尚未存在的路徑，徹底封鎖建立行為且不留痕跡。若指令在執行中途被強制終止，殘留的空白佔位檔會自動清理，不再干擾下一個套用相同拒絕規則的指令。
body.en:
Running into a read-only filesystem error inside a sandbox environment often used to leave developers puzzled. When a sandboxed command attempts to write outside the session's writable roots (such as a cache path under the home directory that temporarily stores computed results), the interface no longer just throws a raw filesystem error. Instead, it clearly explains that the sandbox blocked the write and proactively lists remedies: granting access via `workspace_roots`, running unsandboxed for a single run, or pointing the cache path to the workspace or the `/tmp` directory. ⟦Strict building management regulates renovations by blocking unauthorized partitions before work begins, offering detour directions when someone heads toward the wrong exit, and clearing away empty boxes if construction halts midway.⟧

Security defenses have also been reinforced: deny rules now fully cover paths that do not exist yet in sandboxed shell commands, blocking creation outright without leaving any trace behind. If a command is killed mid-run, leftover empty placeholder files are cleaned up automatically, preventing them from interfering with the next command that applies the same deny rules.

items.original:
Security: Deny rules now cover paths that do not exist yet in sandboxed shell commands, blocking their creation without leaving anything behind
When a sandboxed shell command fails writing outside the session's writable roots (for example a cache under the home directory failing with `Read-only file system`), the failure now explains that the sandbox blocked it and names the `workspace_roots` grant, a one-time unsandboxed run, and workspace-or-`/tmp` cache options, instead of the raw filesystem error
A sandboxed shell command killed mid-run no longer breaks the next command with the same deny rules; its leftover empty placeholder is now cleaned up automatically

title.zh-TW: 工作區授權支援多根目錄，版本控制指令納入沙盒防護
title.en: Workspace Grants Support Multiple Roots While Sandboxing Version Control Commands

body.zh-TW:
處理跨多個程式庫的大型專案時，檔案工具與版本控制指令的防護邊界至關重要。現在 Shell 指令可寫入用戶端以 `workspaceRoots` 授權的每個工作區根目錄，不再受限於主目錄；Shell 與檔案工具都會拒絕存取不再指向原位置的根目錄。降級工作階段復原遺失最新目錄清單的問題也已修復。⟦跟多庫房聯外通道管制一樣，以往只鎖定主倉庫，現在副庫全數列入許可清單，巡檢推車也一律在隔離防護網內作業。⟧

自動執行的 Sapling 指令（快照與工作階段工作樹）全數移入沙盒內執行；工作階段工作樹也會拒絕在尚未信任的工作區執行 Sapling。無特權容器中工作樹（平行開多份副本的功能）的建立與清理都維持沙盒化；EdenFS 簽出中的 `sl`、`hg` 必須透過啟動器並停用沙盒，才能存取 Eden 狀態；原生沙盒不再開放 Eden 檔案系統與通訊端。
body.en:
When working on large projects spanning multiple repositories, the security boundaries of file tools and version control commands are critical. Shell commands can now write under every workspace root a client grants with `workspaceRoots`, no longer restricted to the primary root. Both shell and file tools refuse access to roots that no longer resolve to their recorded locations. An issue where degraded session recovery lost the latest workspace root list has also been fixed. ⟦Consider access control across multiple warehouses: while only the main building used to be guarded, auxiliary facilities are now fully added to the allowlist, and inspection carts operate strictly within an isolated security perimeter.⟧

Sapling commands executed automatically (workspace snapshots and session worktrees) now run entirely inside the sandbox. Session worktrees also refuse to run Sapling in a workspace that has not been trusted yet. Worktree (a feature that lets you open multiple parallel copies of a project) creation and cleanup remain sandboxed inside unprivileged containers. On EdenFS checkouts, `sl` and `hg` must go through the launcher with the sandbox disabled to access Eden state. The native sandbox no longer grants access to the Eden filesystem or sockets.

items.original:
Security: Shell and file tools refuse a workspace root that no longer resolves to its recorded location instead of following it to a new target
Security: The Sapling commands the harness runs for you (workspace snapshots, session worktrees) now run inside the sandbox instead of directly on your machine, and session worktrees refuse to run Sapling in a workspace you have not trusted
Shell commands can write under every workspace root a session protocol client grants with `workspaceRoots`, not only the primary root
On EdenFS checkouts, `sl` and `hg` commands need the launcher (sandbox disabled) to reach Eden state; the native sandbox no longer grants Eden filesystem or socket access
Fixed degraded session recovery losing the latest workspace root set
Worktree creation and cleanup stay sandboxed in unprivileged containers, using an empty read-only process view where the container refuses a fresh one

title.zh-TW: 沙盒啟動異常即時警示，中斷流程不再殘留半成品
title.en: Sandbox Startup Anomalies Alert Promptly, Preventing Interrupted Flows from Leaving Half-Baked Sessions

body.zh-TW: 啟動指令列工具時，若背景安全防護失靈卻毫無聲息，很容易在無保護的狀態下執行危險指令。現在若設定的 Bubblewrap 路徑無法使用，啟動時會恢復顯示沙盒不可用的警告；若設定的 Linux 沙盒輔助程式路徑無法使用，則會明確報錯並停止啟動，不再靜默改以非沙盒模式啟動。⟦恰似汽車發動時的儀表板自我檢測，以前故障通知可能被藏起來，現在該亮的警示燈會亮起，遇到必須阻止發動的故障才鎖住點火。⟧啟動程序如果在中途意外遭到中斷，Muse 也不會再留下只建立到一半的工作階段。
body.en: When launching command-line tools, silent failures in background security defenses make it easy to run dangerous commands without protection. Now, if the configured Bubblewrap path is unusable, startup resumes showing a warning that the sandbox is unavailable. If the configured Linux sandbox helper path is unusable, startup fails with a clear error and halts, rather than silently falling back to unsandboxed mode. ⟦Much like an automobile dashboard running a self-test at ignition, warning lights now illuminate instead of hiding trouble notices, locking the ignition only when encountering faults that must prevent engine start.⟧ If the startup process is interrupted mid-flight, Muse also no longer leaves behind a partially created session.

items.original:
Startup warns again when the configured Bubblewrap path is unusable instead of hiding the sandbox-unavailable notice
Keep interrupted startup from leaving a partially created session
Startup fails with a clear error when the configured Linux sandbox helper path is unusable instead of silently starting unsandboxed

title.zh-TW: 對話倒帶支援邊界狀態，壓縮後與儲存中斷皆可回溯
title.en: Chat Rewinds Handle Edge States, Restoring History Even After Compaction or Save Failures

body.zh-TW:
若想放棄先前的對話走向並回溯到前幾輪，一旦遇到儲存異常或壓縮紀錄，以前常會被整張拒絕。現在對話倒帶（rewind）功能在各種極端邊界狀態下都能順利執行。如果你想倒帶至失敗或結尾未儲存（例如磁碟滿載）的輪次之前，操作已能正常生效；永遠無法倒帶的輪次會直接標記為無法使用，不再出現在選項中。⟦猶如卡帶錄音機倒帶，碰上磁帶接合處或部分雜音段落不再咬帶卡死，而是順暢跳過損壞點並精確停在想重錄的時間點。⟧

如果對話已經過上下文壓縮，或是儲存檢查點時前一輪仍在執行，確認後倒帶也不會再遭拒絕。即使遇到某一輪開頭因磁碟已滿未能寫入，現在依然能執行倒帶，流程會自動略過該受損輪次並主動提示一次。
body.en:
When you want to abandon a conversational path and step back to previous turns, encountering storage errors or compacted history used to trigger outright refusals. Now the chat rewind feature works smoothly across various edge cases. Rewinding to before a turn that failed, or whose end could not be saved (for example on a full disk), now succeeds instead of being refused. Turns that can never be rewound are clearly shown as unavailable instead of being offered in the options. ⟦An audio cassette deck rewinding past tape splices or noisy segments no longer snags and jams, smoothly skipping over damaged spots to stop precisely where re-recording should begin.⟧

If a conversation has undergone context compaction, or if the preceding turn was still running when a checkpoint was saved, rewinding is no longer refused after you confirm it.
